In The Balance.name: In The Balance
In The Balance.description: Hang an assortment of differently weighted items on a stand that has several unbalanced limbs. First to balance all items and hit their buzzer wins.

Sequence Explosion.name: Sequence Explosion
Sequence Explosion.description: Listen to a dialogue or watch a video containing what you are tracking. At the end of the media presented, you will be asked a question about what just happened. These questions may be about what frequency of being mentioned, back to back mentions, after a specific entry got mentioned, and probably more. The last person to enter the question correctly is eliminated. Last person standing wins.

Verticle Puzzle.name: Verticle Puzzle
Verticle Puzzle.description: Build a puzzle out of an assortment of pieces. This puzzle is built vertically by stacking the pieces on top of each other. The first person to complete their puzzle and hit their buzzer wins.

New Rule.name: New Rule
New Rule.description: Go through a series of rounds where a new rule gets added every round. The rules could be: form into teams or partnersand anyone left out is eliminated, the team that score the highest advances and everyone else is eliminated, play against your team and whoever scores the highest advance and everyone else is eliminated, play against remaining competators and whoever scores the highest wins.

bb28-event-01.name: Find the BB-tonium
bb28-event-01.description: Find any of the twelve BB-tonium capsulses hidden throughout the house  that add up to the number on Enzo's jacket (it was 28)
bb28-event-01.strategy: Be fast an be able to do math

bb28-event-02.name: 1988 Long Beach, CA
bb28-event-02.description: Balance all eight of your objects on four unstable beams. Once it is stable for at least 10 seconds, you win. Objects weigh differently.
bb28-event-02.strategy: At the start of the competition, feel for how heavy each of the items are. Try to put similarly weighing items on the same levels. Use what I will call "intuative torque" to balance them. Try to balace as close to the center as possible. Start for the top and work your way down. Heavier items first because inertia. Rome put heaviest items at the top and worked his way downwards and he won.
bb28-event-02.guest_appearances: Cecelia Diamond (not a former big brother contestant)

bb28-event-03.name: 2018 Fiji
bb28-event-03.description: Cross a simulated river using two planks of different lengths. Place and reposition the planks between supports to create a route without stepping into the river. The first player to reach the far side and press the button wins.
bb28-event-03.strategy: Everyone has the same supports layout. If you're behind you can look at someone else's path for help. Take your time and plan your path. Going fast is important, but going the correct path is even more important.

bb28-event-04.name: 2010 Las Vegas, NV
bb28-event-04.description: Listen to conversations and count mentions of three drinks: Bahama Mama, Fuzzy Navel, and Purple Hooter. Each round asks which drink was mentioned most, second-most, or least. Choose an answer and buzz in. If everyone answers correctly, the slowest player is eliminated. The last player remaining wins.
bb28-event-04.strategy: You are given your question before the dialogue starts. Once the conversation is coming to a close and you have a clear correct answer, buzz in early. It was not difficult to track the correct answer, but trying to buzz in after the prompt has finished just results in you being the slowest. For keeping track of how many times each item was said, count with fingers and point at the button they correspond with. This isn't a surefire winning strategy, but it should get you through the majority of each round. Jason did this and he rang in the fastest in each of the rounds, giving him the win.

bb28-event-05.name: 175 Million BC
bb28-event-05.description: Each returning reality player assembles a fire-shaped puzzle, building vertically, on a suspended platform while the four houseguests that "brought them back" balance on an elevated surface and hold steady the platform with ropes. A collapse or the platform touching the ground requires rebuilding. Finish the puzzle, press the button, and keep it balanced for five seconds to win HOH. The helpers with the fewest pieces stacked become Have-Nots.
bb28-event-05.strategy: For the builder: At the start of the competition, gather your pieces and assemble them on the ground (or at least roughly assemble them). Pay attention to colors, outlines, designs, and shapes. Looking for these will allow you to connect the puzzle pieces to each other fastest. Build outside in so you have a strong base to minimize risk of the puzzle from falling and having to start over. For the ones holding the platform with the rope: Do not overwhelm your builder. Hold the rope taught at a low height. Let the beuilder be in a comfortable position. This competition shouldn't last too long, so do not worry about preserving strength.
bb28-event-05.guest_appearances: Rachel Riley (seasons 12, 13, 27) falling into a valcano

bb28-event-06.name: Back From the Future
bb28-event-06.description: Connect differently shaped and sized tubes to form one continuous route from the time-machine dining table to Dr. Will's throne. The route must pass through all eleven amplifier rings, with every connection joined correctly. There may be more than one solution, and there may be extra tubes. The first player to complete a valid tube network wins.
bb28-event-06.strategy: Stay objective oriented. Look at how you will traverse through all rings. See how the tubing will get you there. Start from both the front and the back and fill in the middle. Make sure you study all the time tubes you have and see how they could  work together.

bb28-event-07.name: Do Over
bb28-event-07.description: Watch screens cycling through houseguest photographs with hairstyles from different decades. Count the appearances to identify the person shown most often, then return to the podium and lock in that person's photograph. Not all photos appear on all screens. Players have two minutes; the fastest correct answer wins safety and removes that nominee from the block.

bb28-event-08.name: Achy Breaky HOH
bb28-event-08.description: Slide a disc across a country-themed dance floor into numbered cowboy-hat scoring areas. A disc off the floor scores zero; one crossing scoring boundaries receives the highest applicable score. Players first form pairs, with an unpaired player receiving a bye. Partners then compete against each other. Survivors form new pairs and combine scores; the strongest pair reaches an individual final, where the higher score wins HOH.

bb28-event-09.name: BB Time Capsule
bb28-event-09.description: A fan-selected houseguest plays alone in a spinning chair while powers and punishments shuffle across monitors. Time a button press to stop the moving illuminated frame on a screen; that selection determines the reward or punishment. In this visit, Angela receives the Hard-Boiled Detective punishment, requiring an egg-themed costume.

bb28-event-10.name: Flower Power
bb28-event-10.description: In a 1967 music-festival setting, search for pieces of a concert-poster puzzle and assemble the complete picture inside its frame. The pieces must fit together without extending beyond the border. The first player to finish the poster correctly wins the Power of Veto.

bb28-event-11.name: Pirate's Booty
bb28-event-11.description: Four posts hold mixed pieces of pirate treasure. Move one piece at a time to sort the treasure into matching stacks: three doubloons, three rubies, three pearls, and three emeralds, each treasure type on its own post. Pieces cannot be placed on the ground. The first nominee to finish sorting and buzz in wins safety.

bb28-event-12.name: Wrestlegasm 85
bb28-event-12.description: Watch a staged wrestling match and remember its visual and spoken details. Then answer true-or-false questions about what happened. An incorrect answer eliminates a player. Continue through the questions until one houseguest remains; that player becomes HOH.

bb28-event-13.name: BB Time Capsule
bb28-event-13.description: Devens takes a solo turn in the spinning chair, facing monitors with six powers and five punishments. The options shuffle as an illuminated frame moves between screens. Press the button at the chosen moment to stop the selection. The highlighted screen determines the outcome; Devens receives the Diamond Power of Veto.

bb28-event-14.name: The Pickle Ball
bb28-event-14.description: Compete in head-to-head pickleball-themed rounds. First spin with a giant pickle partner, then use a paddle to send balls into scoring areas while recovering from the dizziness. The higher-scoring player advances and the opponent is eliminated. The last player remaining after the five matchups wins the Power of Veto.

bb28-event-15.name: Video Tape Tumble
bb28-event-15.description: Remove VHS tapes from a stacked tower one at a time and carry them to the collection point at the end of the lane. Players have two minutes to return as many as possible. Dropped tapes do not count, and a collapsed tower freezes that player's score. Players may adjust the stack and touch its base. Most returned tapes wins safety, with speed breaking a tie.

bb28-event-16.name: Jack the Ripper
bb28-event-16.description: Spend five minutes examining six themed rooms and their contents. Each round, a clue indicates where Jack the Ripper will strike. Choose and lock in a room believed to be safe, then enter it. Anyone in the attacked room is eliminated. The last surviving houseguest wins HOH.

bb28-event-17.name: BB Time Capsule
bb28-event-17.description: Dee plays the solo spinning-chair timing challenge with five powers and five punishments still available. Watch the monitors shuffle and press the button to stop the moving illuminated frame. Its final screen determines the outcome. Dee lands on the BB Bribe power, which supplies a one-time $5,000 bribe.

bb28-event-18.name: Murder at the Masquerade
bb28-event-18.description: In a murder-mystery drinking game, players take turns in a randomly determined order. The active player brings two glasses, one containing pretend poison, and tries to influence an opponent's choice. Both drink; a foaming reaction reveals the poisoned glass. Receiving poison twice eliminates a player. The last player remaining wins the Power of Veto.

bb28-event-19.name: The Paw Patrol Dino Puzzle
bb28-event-19.description: Race to assemble an oversized puzzle promoting PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie. Fit the pieces together to complete the picture correctly. The first nominee to finish wins the Block Buster, earns safety, and is removed from the nomination block; the other two nominees remain eligible for eviction.

bb28-event-20.name: Sasquatch Watch
bb28-event-20.description: In a Bigfoot-themed wall endurance challenge, stand on small footholds and hold onto tree-shaped stations. Maintain your grip and balance as the wall's changing position makes hanging on increasingly difficult. Falling eliminates a player. The last houseguest still holding on wins HOH.

bb28-event-21.name: BB Time Capsule
bb28-event-21.description: Mallory plays the solo spinning-chair timing challenge with four powers and five punishments available. Press the button to stop the moving illuminated frame as the monitor options shuffle. Mallory lands on the Adam and Eve punishment and chooses Melody as her partner; they wear themed costumes and remain tethered together for 48 hours.

bb28-event-22.name: Saturday Night Veto
bb28-event-22.description: Compete head-to-head to discover a safe route across a disco dance floor. A correct step lights a tile green; an incorrect step turns it red and sends the player back to the start. Remember the successful steps and keep testing the route. The first player across wins the matchup, eliminating the opponent. The final survivor wins the Power of Veto.

bb28-event-23.name: Newton's Apples
bb28-event-23.description: Roll five apple-shaped balls up a ramp so they remain on the upper platform and turn all five indicator lights green. Once all five are in place, switch to stone balls and use them to knock every apple off. The first nominee to complete both stages and press the button wins safety.

bb28-event-24.name: Bugs in the System
bb28-event-24.description: Two players face a computer image divided into areas A, B, and C. Count the bugs and buzz in with the area containing the most. A correct first response eliminates the opponent; an incorrect response eliminates the player who buzzed. The winner chooses the next pair. The last houseguest remaining after ten rounds becomes HOH.

bb28-event-25.name: BB Time Capsule
bb28-event-25.description: Melody plays the solo spinning-chair timing challenge with four powers and four punishments available. Stop the moving illuminated frame with the button while the screen options shuffle. Melody receives the Lord of the Latrine punishment: act as a costumed restroom attendant for 24 hours and unlock the bathroom for other houseguests.

bb28-event-26.name: OTEV the Belligerent B-Movie Blob
bb28-event-26.description: OTEV gives a clue whose answer is a houseguest. Slide down the ramp, search the messy set for that person's photograph, then climb back up and claim a stump to present the answer. Each round provides one fewer stump than there are players. A wrong answer or failure to secure a stump causes elimination. The last player remaining wins the Power of Veto.

bb28-event-27.name: Space Race
bb28-event-27.description: Enter a wind-filled chamber containing hundreds of colored balls. Catch ten red balls and ten yellow balls and place them in their matching collection tubes while the air keeps the balls moving. The first nominee to collect all twenty required balls correctly and press the button wins safety and leaves the nomination block.

bb28-event-28.name: Norse By Norsewest
bb28-event-28.description: Run an individually timed Viking-themed balance course. Follow the narrow paths to activate six buttons, then return to the starting point to stop the clock. Falling resets the buttons and forces a restart. The houseguest who completes a valid run in the shortest time wins HOH.

bb28-event-29.name: BB Time Capsule
bb28-event-29.description: Drew takes a solo turn in the spinning chair with four powers and three punishments available. Time the button press to stop the moving illuminated frame on one of the shuffling monitor options. Drew receives the Never-Not Pass, making him exempt from Have-Not duties for the remainder of the season.

bb28-event-30.name: Feel The Burn
bb28-event-30.description: Complete as many repetitions as possible on three novelty exercise machines across timed elimination rounds. The first two stages use hip movements; the final uses the tongue to move a lever from side to side. The two lowest scorers leave after the first round, and the lowest scorer leaves after the second. The most repetitions in the 60-second final wins the Power of Veto.

bb28-event-31.name: BB Grand Cliptacular
bb28-event-31.description: Study sixty past Big Brother moments divided among sections A, B, and C, and compare them with clues in a separate area. Determine which section satisfies every clue, return to the booth, and lock in its letter. A selected answer becomes unavailable to the other players. The nominee choosing the correct section wins safety.

bb28-event-32.name: Stones of Safety
bb28-event-32.description: Build four candles, each with six segments and a flame piece. Rebuild anything that falls. Once all four stand correctly, place a ring around the central torch. The first to finish earns safety, grants safety to one other houseguest, and uses two sacrifice stones to choose the players for the next challenge.

bb28-event-33.name: Fit the Crops
bb28-event-33.description: Two selected houseguests race to pack a cart with corn- and carrot-shaped puzzle pieces so that every piece fits. Complete the arrangement and place the ring to finish. The first player earns safety, gives safety to another houseguest, and chooses who will face the losing player in the next challenge.

bb28-event-34.name: Deliver the Grapes
bb28-event-34.description: Carry two grape-shaped balls at a time in a crystal container across a balance beam and deposit them into a winepress. Falling or dropping a grape requires restarting that trip. The first player to deliver all 28 grapes and place the ring wins safety and chooses two houseguests to join the loser in the final challenge.

bb28-event-35.name: Adorn the Crown
bb28-event-35.description: Three players race to balance ornaments from three bags on a crown. Every piece from the first bag must be placed before opening the second, and the same rule applies before the third. Finish stacking all pieces, then claim the scepter. The winner earns safety and alone chooses which of the other two players is evicted.

bb28-event-36.name: 2026: A Zing Odyssey
bb28-event-36.description: Watch two mock documentary videos featuring Zingbot, then answer true-or-false questions about their details: four questions after the first video and three after the second. Each correct answer earns one point. The highest total wins HOH. A numerical tiebreaker, scored by the closest answer without going over, resolves a tie.

bb28-event-37.name: The Gold, the Bad, and the Ugly
bb28-event-37.family: The Gold, the Bad, and the Ugly
bb28-event-37.description: Move 25 gold nuggets from a minecart to a collection pan, carrying only one per trip while crossing a teetering, handle-shaped balance beam. Falling off or letting any nugget touch the ground resets all progress, requiring every nugget to return to the start. The first player to transfer all 25 successfully and press the button wins the Power of Veto.
families: The Gold, the Bad, and the Ugly

bb28-event-38.name: Your Game in Ruins
bb28-event-38.description: Search a quarry bin of colored spheres for your assigned color. Carry one matching sphere at a time to a balcony and drop it toward your collection tube below. Players have four minutes to land four spheres in the tube. The first nominee to complete the target wins safety and is removed from the nomination block.

bb28-event-39.name: Rainbow Rollers
bb28-event-39.description: Roll seven colored balls, one at a time, along a rippled lane into their matching colored target zones. A ball in the wrong zone must be retrieved and retried; advance to the next color only after a correct placement. If a misplaced ball enters an already occupied zone, remove both balls. The first player to place all seven correctly and press the button wins HOH.

bb27-event-01.name: Save Julie
bb27-event-01.description: Cross the bridge-puzzle course to reach eight doors, then use Julie's clues to identify where she is hidden. The first player to find her earns $10,000 and the secret BB Buy-Off power, which can later purchase removal from the block before jury begins.

bb27-event-02.name: Reclaim the Relic
bb27-event-02.description: Search a room full of decoy relics for the one matching the genuine HOH Relic. The first correct finder wins the right to select the four houseguests eligible to enter the first HOH competition; the winner may include themselves.

bb27-event-03.name: Destroy the Lair
bb27-event-03.description: Arrange six cores on an unstable BB Blaster so their weights balance. Keep the completed arrangement standing for ten seconds without a collapse. The first of the four eligible players to meet the balance requirement becomes HOH.

bb27-event-04.name: Campsite Caper
bb27-event-04.description: Investigate three mock campsites and compare shoeprints, tire tracks, and smells with the available suspects. Use the evidence to identify each campsite's culprit. Correctly solve all three crime scenes in the shortest time to win the Power of Veto.

bb27-event-05.name: Ransom Note
bb27-event-05.description: Unscramble the words in a ransom message to work out which item the Mastermind wants stolen. Decode the instruction and retrieve the correct item before the other nominees. The successful first finisher wins safety and leaves the block.

bb27-event-06.name: BB Break In
bb27-event-06.description: Search a pitch-black sewer course for items stolen from the hotel safe. The HOH key and three separate power tokens are hidden inside. Finding the HOH key wins the week's Head of Household; the other discoveries award secret advantages instead.

bb27-event-07.name: BB Break In
bb27-event-07.description: During the same dark-sewer search used for BB Break In, locate the Mystery Competitor token. Its finder earns the ability to summon a former houseguest to play a veto on their behalf when nominated. This row records an advantage awarded within that shared challenge, not a separate race.

bb27-event-08.name: BB Break In
bb27-event-08.description: Search the dark BB Break In course for the Mystery Veto token. Finding it grants access to a later private, timed veto challenge after a regular veto ceremony. Completing that later challenge earns an additional veto; finding the token alone does not award the veto itself.

bb27-event-09.name: BB Break In
bb27-event-09.description: Locate the HOH Interrogation token while searching the pitch-black BB Break In course. The secret power allows an attempted takeover of another player's HOH. The original HOH can prevent the takeover by correctly identifying the person using it. This is a reward from the shared search competition.

bb27-event-10.name: Caught Creepin
bb27-event-10.description: Keep both buttons held until Felicia says the designated code word, Creeper, then sprint down the lane and hit the finish buzzer. A false start or the slowest valid finish causes elimination. The final survivor wins veto. Kaycee competed for Keanu and gave him the veto after winning.

bb27-event-11.name: The Case of the Mystery Veto
bb27-event-11.description: After activating the Mystery Veto power, play a private puzzle challenge. Assemble the required puzzle successfully to earn a second Power of Veto for the week. The opportunity belongs only to the power holder; it is separate from the regular six-player veto competition.

bb27-event-12.name: Puzzling Prints
bb27-event-12.description: Fit twelve puzzle pieces into their correct arrangement to complete the fingerprint-themed design. Race directly against the other nominees; the first correct completion earns safety and removes that player from the nomination block.

bb27-event-13.name: Twin Witness News
bb27-event-13.description: Watch a staged news report featuring twins Liz and Julia Nolan, then answer true-or-false questions about the details presented. Accurate recall determines who advances through the quiz and ultimately wins HOH.

bb27-event-14.name: Basement Break In
bb27-event-14.description: Navigate a laser-maze course to retrieve a crystal and bring it through the obstacles. Each player completes a timed run. The fastest successful run wins the Power of Veto and the associated movie-screening reward.

bb27-event-15.name: Study The Study
bb27-event-15.description: Compare two nearly identical study rooms and count their differences. Players have ninety seconds to inspect the displays and submit a number. The closest estimate wins the Block Buster and earns safety from eviction.

bb27-event-16.name: Killer Carnival
bb27-event-16.description: Race across a balance-beam network to activate four buttons. The format changes across three rounds: teams of four send one runner, new teams of three compete as a relay, and the finalists race individually. Fastest qualifying performances advance; the quickest final run wins HOH.

bb27-event-17.name: Flee the Scene
bb27-event-17.description: Race across a bridge of paired tiles, discovering which tile in each pair is safe. Green allows progress; red sends the player back to the beginning. Remember the route and cross faster than the opponent to advance through the head-to-head rounds. The final winner receives veto.

bb27-event-18.name: Safe Crackers
bb27-event-18.description: Guide a ball through a tabletop maze and land it in each of three required target holes. Control its speed and direction through the winding course. The first nominee to complete all three targets and buzz in wins safety.

bb27-event-19.name: Jack the Dipper
bb27-event-19.description: In head-to-head rounds, watch Jack dip into three bowls and identify the bowl used most often. The first correct response eliminates the opponent, while an incorrect buzz eliminates the responder. Each winner selects the next pair. The last player left becomes HOH.

bb27-event-20.name: Elusive Target
bb27-event-20.description: Slide a disc into scoring zones, trying to avoid the lowest score each round. An eliminated player opens a prize or punishment and may keep it or exchange it for an already revealed item. The person holding the veto after the final exchange wins it, regardless of who won the last scoring round.

bb27-event-21.name: Jumbo Gemstones
bb27-event-21.description: Rearrange mixed colored gemstones into four color-matched stacks. Move only one gemstone at a time while sorting the piles. The first nominee to complete all four correctly organized stacks wins the Block Buster and comes off the block.

bb27-event-22.name: The Party Slasher
bb27-event-22.description: Study the available hiding places, then use each round's clue to decide where the party slasher will not strike. Choose a location satisfying the safety clue; an unsafe choice eliminates the player. The final survivor wins HOH.

bb27-event-23.name: OTEV the Hog Father
bb27-event-23.description: Listen to OTEV's clue, search for the matching houseguest's name, and return up the ramp to claim a limited spot. Wrong answers or the last return can cause elimination. Continue until one correct player remains; multiple wrong answers can end the competition before the scheduled final round.

bb27-event-24.name: Settle the Score
bb27-event-24.description: Roll a ball along a long ramp toward numbered scoring areas. Within two minutes, decide when to stop trying and lock in a score. The highest locked score wins safety; repeated attempts offer another chance but consume the remaining time.

bb27-event-25.name: Mystere Express
bb27-event-25.description: Remain on a narrow ledge while gripping a tilting train-themed wall through water and slime. Falling ends the player's run. The first three to fall become Have-Nots, and the last houseguest still holding on wins HOH.

bb27-event-26.name: Wine to Die For
bb27-event-26.description: Offer a chosen opponent two glasses, one containing pretend poison and one safe. The opponent selects a glass and the presenter drinks the other. Bluffing may influence that choice. Two poisoned drinks eliminate a player; the final survivor wins veto.

bb27-event-27.name: Hilltop Heist
bb27-event-27.description: Guide a ball down a puzzle-like ramp, arranging and using the route so it reaches the destination. Race against the other two nominees to finish the course correctly. The fastest successful completion earns safety and removal from the block.

bb27-event-28.name: Mystere Moments
bb27-event-28.description: Study video clips shown on the Memory Wall, then answer true-or-false questions about their details. Recall the clips accurately through the quiz to earn the winning result and become HOH.

bb27-event-29.name: Charcuterie Protection Agency
bb27-event-29.description: Stack thirty-five charcuterie pieces of different sizes into a stable arrangement. Build the complete stack without letting it collapse, correcting any unstable placement as needed. The fastest successful completion wins the Power of Veto.

bb27-event-30.name: Forensic Frenzy
bb27-event-30.description: Catch colored balls swirling inside an air chamber and load them into a collection tube in the specified color order. The task is to complete the sequence correctly, not merely collect the largest total. The first nominee to finish wins safety.

bb27-event-31.name: Survive the White Locust
bb27-event-31.description: Slide three totems along a game board so each stops within its designated green zone. Complete all three placements in the shortest time to earn safety for the night. The winner then chooses the first houseguest who must face the elimination maze.

bb27-event-32.name: Mastermind's Maniacal Maze
bb27-event-32.description: Guide the object through the Mastermind's maze before the individual time limit expires. The first selected player gets six minutes thirty seconds; each successful player chooses the next competitor, whose allowance is one minute shorter. Failure causes immediate eviction. The fastest successful finisher also earns HOH.

bb27-event-33.name: Mastermind's Maniacal Maze
bb27-event-33.description: This row records the same maze challenge's HOH outcome. Each called-out player must complete the maze within a shrinking time allowance to survive; the first failure is evicted. Among the players who finish successfully, the quickest completion wins Head of Household for the ensuing week.

bb27-event-34.name: BB Comics
bb27-event-34.description: Zipline past a display of houseguest comic-book covers, then recreate the display on a board below. Choose between subtly different versions of each cover and reproduce the correct order. Revisit the display as needed; the fastest completely correct board wins veto.

bb27-event-35.name: Key to Safety
bb27-event-35.description: Work free of the tangled rope attached to your body, following it through its twists and obstacles. The first nominee to untangle the required length and finish the course wins safety and is removed from the block.

bb27-event-36.name: The Last Zing: The True Story of Zingbot's Demise
bb27-event-36.family: Zingbot Competition, What Did They Just Do?
bb27-event-36.description: Watch Zingbot's mock documentary, then answer true-or-false questions testing memory of its details. Correct answers determine the leading score. A numerical tiebreaker resolves a tie for first place; the winning player becomes HOH.

bb27-event-37.name: BB CSI
bb27-event-37.description: Carry twenty-five pieces of evidence across a giant magnifying-glass balance structure and deposit them on its lens. Keep both yourself and the collected evidence balanced while making repeated trips. The first player to complete the transfer wins veto.

bb27-event-38.name: Steal Power Orbs for the Mastermind So He Can Bring His Lair On-Line
bb27-event-38.description: Collect power-orb balls and drop them from above into a crystal jar. Accurate drops are needed to build the required collection of four. The first nominee to land all four wins the final Block Buster and earns safety for that eviction vote.

bb27-event-39.name: Wretched Reactor
bb27-event-39.description: Roll balls up a long ramp so they remain on the flat platform at the top. Accumulate five successfully landed balls before the other players. The first to meet the target wins the live double-eviction HOH competition.

bb27-event-40.name: Masterfind
bb27-event-40.description: Study the displayed scene and identify which of the three labeled areas, A, B, or C, contains the Mastermind. Correct answers build a score across rounds. The highest score, with a tiebreaker if needed, wins the double-eviction veto.

bb27-event-41.name: Torturous Trial
bb27-event-41.description: Use a sword to keep the Mastermind's mask held against its support. Maintain the required position as fatigue builds; dropping the mask ends that player's attempt. The last houseguest still holding the mask up wins HOH.

bb27-event-42.name: Masterpieces
bb27-event-42.description: Use tweezers to position tiny pieces and assemble a miniature picture puzzle. The challenge requires precise placement on the small work surface. The first correctly completed picture wins the Power of Veto; this version is a puzzle rather than a stacking tower.

bb27-event-43.name: ForensiScope
bb27-event-43.description: Move from inside a giant cube, rolling it across the course until the required face points upward on the finishing platform. Each correct orientation earns a point. The first player to reach three points wins HOH.

bb27-event-44.name: Organized Crime
bb27-event-44.description: Arrange important events from the season according to the days they occurred, producing a fully correct chronological sequence. Check and correct misplaced events while racing the clock. The first player to complete the ordering correctly wins the final veto.

bb27-event-45.name: Locate the Lair
bb27-event-45.description: Hang onto a flying-drone apparatus as it moves, holding on longer than the other two finalists. Falling ends the attempt. The last remaining player wins Part 1 of the final HOH and advances directly to Part 3, not immediately to the overall HOH title.

bb27-event-46.name: Unmask the Mastermind
bb27-event-46.description: Ride a zipline to knock down three block displays, recover the special pieces, and rebuild puzzles showing six houseguests. Then use an envelope of clues to decode the password. The faster successful player wins Part 2 and advances to the final HOH quiz.

bb27-event-47.name: Perjury Duty
bb27-event-47.description: The Part 1 and Part 2 winners answer factual questions based on jury-member statements about the season. Correct responses earn points. The higher final score wins the last HOH, guarantees a place in the Final Two, and controls the final eviction.

bb26-event-01.name: Color Calibration
bb26-event-01.description: Watch a sequence of colored lights while seated in a spinning chair. After it stops, use the colored buttons to reproduce the sequence within thirty seconds. The longest correct sequence wins, with speed breaking a tie. The winner receives the America's Veto upgrade.

bb26-event-02.name: Fear Facer
bb26-event-02.description: Put your head into four fear boxes containing unsettling props and scrambled letters. Decode each emotion word and label the matching box within ninety seconds. The fewest correct labels, with slower time breaking a tie, determines who receives the downgrade punishment.

bb26-event-03.name: AI Chip Install
bb26-event-03.description: Fit four foam computer chips into the mainframe while the room rotates and shifts around you. Complete every installation correctly as quickly as possible. The faster successful player earns the Deepfake HOH upgrade.

bb26-event-04.name: Facial Recognition
bb26-event-04.description: Transfer three discs into their holders using your face, shoulders, and chest, without using your hands or arms. Work within a sixty-second limit. The worst performance receives the downgrade, losing eligibility for the first HOH, veto, and eviction vote.

bb26-event-05.name: New Rule
bb26-event-05.family: New Rule, As Close As You Can, Shootout
bb26-event-05.description: Compete in a target-scoring contest whose grouping and advancement rules change each round. Players must adapt as the format moves through teams and smaller groups. Members of the final surviving group compete individually to determine the first HOH.

bb26-event-06.name: BB AI Spelling Bee
bb26-event-06.description: Search for letter tiles and assemble the longest correctly spelled word. Delete tiles can remove letters from play. Word length determines the winner, with faster completion breaking a tie. The winning word earns the Power of Veto.

bb26-event-07.name: Glitch in the System
bb26-event-07.description: Study sixteen simultaneous, glitching video displays and identify the houseguest appearing most often. Submit the correct name faster than the other nominees to win the AI Arena and leave the nomination block.

bb26-event-08.name: Animal Obsession
bb26-event-08.description: Watch animal videos, then answer true-or-false questions about their details. Correct responses keep a player in the contest; incorrect responses eliminate them. The last houseguest remaining wins HOH.

bb26-event-09.name: Code Tower
bb26-event-09.description: Arrange and balance the supplied pieces into a standing code tower. Work quickly without allowing the structure to collapse; fallen sections must be rebuilt. Completing the required tower first earns the Power of Veto.

bb26-event-10.name: Security Race
bb26-event-10.description: Fit the supplied geometric pieces together inside the required outline. The entire security-themed puzzle must be correctly assembled. The first nominee to finish wins safety, leaving the other two on the block.

bb26-event-11.name: Ainsley Land
bb26-event-11.description: Move across a life-size board game's balance-beam paths and activate buttons to collect points. Each player has forty-five seconds. The greatest point total wins HOH, with the quickest time breaking a tie.

bb26-event-12.name: Recharge My Core
bb26-event-12.description: Carry a charged power core through a jungle-like obstacle maze. Each contact with a vine removes five percentage points from the core's charge. Preserve as much energy as possible while completing the course; the best remaining charge wins veto.

bb26-event-13.name: Data Dump
bb26-event-13.description: Catch the required colored balls while they swirl inside an air machine and place them into a collection tube. Complete the required collection before the other nominees to win the AI Arena and gain safety.

bb26-event-14.name: Bad AI
bb26-event-14.description: Face an opponent and inspect three AI-generated pictures for the one containing an error. The first correct answer wins the matchup and allows selection of the next two players. An incorrect buzz eliminates its player. The final survivor becomes HOH.

bb26-event-15.name: Binary Bridge
bb26-event-15.description: Discover a safe path across paired bridge tiles. A green tile allows progress; a red tile sends the player back to the beginning. Remember the successful route and outrun the opponent through elimination heats. The final matchup winner earns veto.

bb26-event-16.name: Upload, Download
bb26-event-16.description: First roll five balls onto the ramp's holding area. Then send five additional balls across the ramp to dislodge the original five. The first nominee to get all ten balls to the far side wins safety.

bb26-event-17.name: Firewall
bb26-event-17.description: Grip a narrow ledge on a tilting wall while enduring water and slime. Falling eliminates a player. The first three to fall become Have-Nots, while the last player remaining on the wall wins HOH.

bb26-event-18.name: Hide-N-Go Veto
bb26-event-18.description: Individually hide a memory card somewhere in the house. After all cards are hidden, take timed turns searching for other players' cards. The owner of the only card left undiscovered wins the Power of Veto.

bb26-event-19.name: Digital Decryption
bb26-event-19.description: Unscramble the displayed words to decode a hidden instruction. Work out the message and carry out the required action correctly before the other nominees. The successful first finisher wins the AI Arena and is removed from the block.

bb26-event-20.name: Sound Bites
bb26-event-20.description: Study the presented audio/video material and answer questions testing recall of its details. Correct responses determine who survives the memory quiz. The winning houseguest earns Head of Household for the week.

bb26-event-21.name: A.I. Apocalypse
bb26-event-21.description: Compete in a target-shooting contest with eliminations and prize exchanges. Each eliminated player claims a reward or punishment and can exchange it for an already revealed item. The player holding the veto after all exchanges receives it; winning the final shooting round does not automatically award the veto.

bb26-event-22.name: Puzzling Password
bb26-event-22.description: Assemble a puzzle revealing a ten-digit password, then identify the encryption key matching that completed code. Both the construction and code selection must be correct. The first nominee to finish wins safety.

bb26-event-23.name: What Came First?
bb26-event-23.description: Use your fingers through a wire barrier to maneuver an egg along the course to its destination without dropping it. Complete the egg-transfer objective first to win HOH. Early dropped eggs can result in Have-Not penalties.

bb26-event-24.name: Bot Builders
bb26-event-24.description: Build an eleven-piece robot in complete darkness. Locate and identify the parts by touch, then fit them into the correct positions. The first fully correct robot wins the Power of Veto.

bb26-event-25.name: Bandwidth Boosters
bb26-event-25.description: Untangle the cable or rope threaded through the course and free enough length to reach the finishing point. The first nominee to complete the untangling task wins the last AI Arena and comes off the block.

bb26-event-26.name: Ding Cam
bb26-event-26.description: Compare pairs of season events and decide which happened earlier. Answer the before-or-after questions correctly through the memory quiz. The winning score determines HOH, with a tiebreaker if necessary.

bb26-event-27.name: OTEV the Trash-Talking Trash Panda
bb26-event-27.description: Listen to OTEV's clue, retrieve the matching answer from the search area, and return up the ramp to a limited kneeling spot. Incorrect answers and the last valid return cause elimination. This edition ended in its opening round because only one player returned with the correct answer.

bb26-event-28.name: Getting Toasted
bb26-event-28.description: Keep a marshmallow-shaped piece held in place using a long support stick. Maintain the required position without dropping the piece as fatigue increases. The last houseguest still successfully holding it up wins HOH.

bb26-event-29.name: Too Much of a Good Thing
bb26-event-29.description: Fit all the candy-shaped puzzle pieces into the required outline. The first correct completion wins the regular Power of Veto. The contest continues for second place, which earns a separate JANKIE veto opportunity.

bb26-event-30.name: Too Much of a Good Thing
bb26-event-30.family: Too Much of a Good Thing
bb26-event-30.description: This row records the runner-up reward from the same candy-fitting puzzle. Finish second to earn the JANKIE veto, which remains inactive unless its holder also succeeds at a separate carnival task during the veto ceremony.
families: Too Much of a Good Thing

bb26-event-31.name: JANKIE's Knock-Em Down
bb26-event-31.description: At the veto ceremony, the JANKIE veto holder gets three throws to knock down at least five bottles. Reaching the target activates that veto; failure means it cannot be used. This is an activation task, not another open veto competition.

bb26-event-32.name: Eye Candy
bb26-event-32.description: Within one hour, build a stable stack of candy pieces and choose when to lock in the score. More successfully stacked pieces beat fewer; faster completion breaks a tied total. This version uses a fixed overall limit rather than a timer that must repeatedly be refilled.

bb26-event-33.name: The Wild Robot
bb26-event-33.description: Listen to the forest creatures' sounds, use a translation station to determine what each wants, and bring each creature the correct item. Complete all deliveries accurately in the shortest individual time to win veto and an advance movie screening.

bb26-event-34.name: Warning Messages
bb26-event-34.description: Recall the warning messages shown to the house and answer questions about their content. Correct answers build a score. The highest total, resolved by a numerical tiebreaker if needed, wins the double-eviction HOH.

bb26-event-35.name: Eye in the Sky
bb26-event-35.description: Guide balls down a winding tabletop course into the required target holes. Control the ball's speed and avoid losing it along the route. The first player to complete the target arrangement wins the double-eviction veto.

bb26-event-36.name: Killer Keycard
bb26-event-36.description: Use oversized tweezers to position miniature puzzle pieces and construct the required keycard. Complete the tiny structure accurately before the other players. The first correct completion wins HOH.

bb26-event-37.name: BB Comics
bb26-event-37.description: Zipline past a display of comic covers and reconstruct it on a board. Select the correct artwork from subtly different versions and reproduce the display order. The fastest fully correct board wins veto.

bb26-event-38.name: Hidden Agenda
bb26-event-38.description: Search computer-code displays for hidden messages and identify the correct phrase. The quickest correct answer earns a point each round. After seven rounds, the highest total wins the final-four HOH.

bb26-event-39.name: Passcode Protectors
bb26-event-39.description: Answer questions about the day on which season events occurred. Enter the correct day quickly enough to avoid a strike; three strikes eliminate a player. The last remaining houseguest wins the season's final veto.

bb26-event-40.name: Sever the Source
bb26-event-40.description: Hold onto the moving apparatus representing AINSLEY's power source for as long as possible. Falling ends the attempt. The last finalist remaining wins Part 1 and advances directly to Part 3 of the final HOH.

bb26-event-41.name: Cerebral Shutdown
bb26-event-41.description: Complete the maze-based neuro-magnetic device and activate it to shut down AINSLEY. The two players who lost Part 1 compete for the faster successful completion. The winner advances to the final HOH quiz.

bb26-event-42.name: Data Destruction
bb26-event-42.description: The winners of Parts 1 and 2 answer factual questions about the jury members and events of the season. Correct responses earn points. The higher score wins the final HOH, guarantees a Final Two place, and controls the last eviction.

bb25-event-01.name: Puzzling Headlines
bb25-event-01.description: Disassemble a large headline puzzle and pack all of its pieces back into the box so they fit correctly. Finish before the other players in the group; the last to complete the task becomes an opening-night nominee.

bb25-event-02.name: Kicking Butt
bb25-event-02.description: Operate a rowing-style lever to make a mechanical boot kick your seat one hundred times. Complete the required repetitions as quickly as possible. The last player to reach one hundred is nominated for eviction.

bb25-event-03.name: Goo-Pocalypse
bb25-event-03.description: Connect the required wires to a mock goo bomb, then press the detonator to test the setup. A correct arrangement triggers the explosion. The last player to complete the wiring and detonation becomes a nominee.

bb25-event-04.name: Hold On Fright
bb25-event-04.description: Hold onto the grips while tethered hands pull you backward toward the darkness. This is an endurance race to avoid being the first to release. The first player pulled away loses and is nominated.

bb25-event-05.name: Crash Course in Comics
bb25-event-05.description: Cross the comic-themed balance-beam course and reach the finishing buzzer as quickly as possible. The fastest successful player wins HOH. For this opening week, the HOH removes two of four existing nominees instead of selecting two new ones.

bb25-event-06.name: Atomic Wedgie
bb25-event-06.description: Build a freestanding stack of thirty-five differently shaped flower pieces. The harness can unexpectedly yank you upward for an atomic wedgie, interrupting construction. Rebuild fallen pieces and complete the full stack before hitting the buzzer to win veto.

bb25-event-07.name: Escape The Nether Region
bb25-event-07.description: Study the themed hiding places and use the clues to choose a safe location each round. Choosing an unsafe area eliminates a player. The last survivor wins HOH; the runner-up receives the Nether Region consequence attached to this challenge.

bb25-event-08.name: Twisted Tasks
bb25-event-08.description: Listen to distorted audio clues through headphones and manipulate the playback to decipher the words. Combine the clues to determine and complete the required tasks. The quickest successful individual run wins veto.

bb25-event-09.name: Snot-a-Winner
bb25-event-09.description: Launch a ball into the nose-themed scoring course and try to land in the highest-value target. Scores depend on where the shot finishes. The best qualifying shot wins HOH.

bb25-event-10.name: Cock-a-Doodle Zoom
bb25-event-10.description: Crawl repeatedly through the sticky chicken-themed course to collect the required items and return them to the starting area. The first player to complete the collection wins the Power of Veto.

bb25-event-11.name: Revenge of the Pressure Cooker
bb25-event-11.description: Keep a button continuously pressed inside the enclosed competition room. Releasing it eliminates the player, who may receive the prize or punishment associated with that exit position. The final person still pressing their button wins HOH.

bb25-event-12.name: Artifact Stack
bb25-event-12.description: Balance pairs of differently weighted artifacts on three pillars until each pillar aligns with its marked height. Correct balancing unlocks letter tiles in a chest. Unscramble the tiles to solve the temple riddle; the quickest successful two-stage run wins veto.

bb25-event-13.name: Power Path
bb25-event-13.description: Four viewer-selected players separately guide a ball through a winding course to its destination. The fastest successful run earns the Power of Invincibility, which can cancel one of the next two evictions.

bb25-event-14.name: BB Odd Couples
bb25-event-14.description: Face an opponent and identify the correct answer from a displayed pair or composite image. Buzzing correctly first eliminates the opponent; a wrong answer eliminates the responder. The winner selects the next pair, and the last player standing becomes HOH.

bb25-event-15.name: Sludge Stackers
bb25-event-15.description: Use large tweezers to arrange tiny containers into the required standing stack. Precision is essential because fallen pieces must be rebuilt. The first completed miniature structure wins the Power of Veto.

bb25-event-16.name: Name That Toot
bb25-event-16.description: Study the presented musical performance and distinguish its sound details, including the deliberately inserted toots. Answer the resulting memory questions correctly to build the winning score and become HOH.

bb25-event-17.name: Buddy Ball
bb25-event-17.description: Spin to earn a brief opportunity to bowl at targets, then repeat when the barrier closes. Low scores lead to elimination and prize exchanges. Each eliminated player may keep a revealed item or swap it; the eventual veto holder wins that power.

bb25-event-18.name: Attack of the 50 Foot Meatball
bb25-event-18.description: Hold onto the narrow ledge of a moving wall while enduring the meatball-themed obstacles and sprays. Falling ends the player's attempt. The last remaining houseguest wins HOH.

bb25-event-19.name: Sweaty Scrimmage
bb25-event-19.description: Carry liquid back and forth along a slippery lane to fill a collection container. Avoid losing too much liquid during each crossing. Fill the container sufficiently to release the required object before the other players and win veto.

bb25-event-20.name: Soul Mates
bb25-event-20.description: Compete in head-to-head question rounds. The first correct answer eliminates the opponent, while an incorrect buzz eliminates its player. Winners choose the next matchup. The final survivor wins the double-eviction HOH.

bb25-event-21.name: Monster Kill
bb25-event-21.description: Search the obstacle-filled collection area for the required objects and return them to the finishing station. Complete the full collection and buzz in before the other players to win the live double-eviction veto.

bb25-event-22.name: Resurrection Rumble
bb25-event-22.description: Dig up balls and carry them across a teetering balance structure, leaving them on its far end. The first player to balance all thirty wins; a spill forces a reset. The winner chooses who attempts the later solo re-entry task.

bb25-event-23.name: Do or Die
bb25-event-23.description: Use two ropes to guide a golden ball up the large vertical board and into the target hole, then hit the buzzer before time expires. The chosen player returns to the game by succeeding; if they fail, the other zombie returns instead.

bb25-event-24.name: Do or Die
bb25-event-24.description: This row records the same solo re-entry task's outcome for the other zombie. Only the selected player operates the pulley board. Success returns that competitor to the game; failure returns the waiting opponent. It is not a second separately played challenge.

bb25-event-25.name: We Come in Pieces
bb25-event-25.description: Collect and assemble the pieces of the large themed puzzle. Every piece must fit correctly before the finish is accepted. The first houseguest to complete the puzzle wins HOH.

bb25-event-26.name: BB Exorcism
bb25-event-26.description: Complete a haunted-house search in the dark, navigating rooms and locating the required items or exit while enduring distractions. Finish the assigned route successfully in the shortest individual time to win veto.

bb25-event-27.name: Humili-Gram
bb25-event-27.description: Study the humiliating clips shown to the house and answer questions about what appeared in them. Correct recall builds the score. The winning total, with a tiebreaker if necessary, earns HOH.

bb25-event-28.name: OTEV the Zinging Robot
bb25-event-28.description: Listen to the combined OTEV and Zingbot clues, search for the correct answer photograph, and race back up the ramp to a limited spot. Incorrect answers or the last valid return cause elimination. The last correct player remaining wins veto.

bb25-event-29.name: BB Comics
bb25-event-29.description: Observe houseguest comic covers while riding a zipline, then recreate their artwork and order on a board. Reject the subtly altered duplicate covers. The fastest fully correct board wins the secret, invisible HOH.

bb25-event-30.name: Superhero Training Academy
bb25-event-30.description: Stand on a suspended disc and hold its rope while the apparatus spins. Remain on the disc longer than the other houseguests to win the first veto. Falling or releasing the apparatus ends the attempt.

bb25-event-31.name: Time to Take Flight
bb25-event-31.description: The first veto winner attempts a further timed hanging challenge while the other players predict the duration. The hanging player's performance earns a cash reward. This row records that reward from the same event whose closest prediction awards the second veto.

bb25-event-32.name: Time to Take Flight
bb25-event-32.description: Predict how long the first veto winner can hold a second suspended rope. The closest estimate to the actual duration wins the second Power of Veto. Other prediction results can assign punishments; the person hanging is not competing for this second veto.

bb25-event-33.name: Johnny Mac: Demented Dentist
bb25-event-33.description: Use Johnny Mac's clues to identify which skull belongs in each dental scenario. Match all five skulls to their correct stations. The first fully correct set wins HOH.

bb25-event-34.name: Embarrassing Expedition
bb25-event-34.description: Examine the photographs and infer the order in which the depicted events occurred. Arrange them into the correct chronological sequence. The fastest completely correct arrangement wins the Power of Veto.

bb25-event-35.name: Triple Feature
bb25-event-35.description: Study sets of mock movie posters and use the clues to select the matching title. Correct answers determine the winning score in the live quiz. The winner becomes HOH for the double-eviction round.

bb25-event-36.name: Drive-In Drop
bb25-event-36.description: Collect balls and drop them from above into the required tube or container. Accuracy matters because missed drops do not fill the target. The first player to complete the required collection wins the double-eviction veto.

bb25-event-37.name: Superhero Smackdown
bb25-event-37.description: Take turns rolling at houseguest targets. Declare the intended target before shooting; an uncalled hit does not count. Eliminating all of a player's targets removes them from the competition. The last player with targets remaining wins HOH.

bb25-event-38.name: Swamp Slasher
bb25-event-38.description: Collect and stack the supplied pieces on the small platform to build the required stable structure. Continue adding pieces without allowing the stack to collapse. The best completed stacking performance wins veto.

bb25-event-39.name: Trick or Treat
bb25-event-39.description: Over five rounds, choose whether to add candy to another player's bucket or remove candy from it. The houseguest with the largest final candy total wins $5,000. This is a luxury prize and does not grant HOH, veto, or immunity.

bb25-event-40.name: Chenbot Volume #1
bb25-event-40.description: Study the Chenbot comic material and answer questions by choosing which page contains the relevant detail. Correct responses earn points. The highest score, with a numerical tiebreaker if necessary, wins the final-four HOH.

bb25-event-41.name: Scrambled Timeline
bb25-event-41.description: Recall the days of key events and correctly organize the scrambled timeline. Enter accurate day information quickly while avoiding the competition's elimination penalties. The final surviving player wins the season's last veto.

bb25-event-42.name: When Universes Collide
bb25-event-42.description: Hold onto the suspended support as it swings and collides with padded obstacles themed to the season's universes. Falling eliminates a finalist. The last remaining player wins Part 1 and advances directly to Part 3 of the final HOH.

bb25-event-43.name: Multiverse Mix-Up
bb25-event-43.description: Ride a short zipline to retrieve competition-name tiles, taking only the permitted number at once. Sort the tiles onto their correct multiverse boards in chronological order. The faster fully correct arrangement wins Part 2 and a place in the final HOH quiz.

bb25-event-44.name: Jury Verse
bb25-event-44.description: Answer factual questions based on the jury members' season experiences. Correct responses earn points; a numerical tiebreaker resolves an equal score. The winner becomes final HOH, reaches the Final Two, and chooses whom to evict.

bb24-event-01.name: Drumming for Power
bb24-event-01.description: The three preliminary winners race to assemble a large drum-themed puzzle. The first to finish correctly becomes Head of Household.

bb24-event-02.name: Ren Fest
bb24-event-02.description: Players duel on artificial horses, collecting metal rings with a lance. The higher ring total advances from each matchup; the final winner earns the veto.

bb24-event-03.name: The BB Pie Fest
bb24-event-03.description: After qualifying through an obstacle course, players answer true-or-false questions about the house by finding the matching answer in a pie using their mouths. Winning the final round earns HOH.

bb24-event-04.name: Mermaid Fest
bb24-event-04.description: Wearing mermaid costumes, players push pearls with their heads through a course and into three target holes. The first to put a pearl in every target wins the veto.

bb24-event-05.name: Get Lit
bb24-event-05.description: Players hold down buttons until the music stops, then race to claim a seat. Releasing early or sitting last causes elimination. The last remaining player becomes HOH and their Festie Bestie receives safety.

bb24-event-06.name: Woodstack
bb24-event-06.description: Each pair assembles a puzzle on a raised platform. A tether links the builder to the partner retrieving pieces, so movement must be coordinated. The first pair to finish earns shared veto power.

bb24-event-07.name: The Invitation
bb24-event-07.family: As Close As You Can, Shootout
bb24-event-07.description: Players first search falling envelopes for invitations to qualify. Finalists slide glasses along a scoring table, aiming for the highest value. The top score earns HOH.

bb24-event-08.name: Trippy Watch Party
bb24-event-08.description: Festie Bestie teams take a memory test about a colorful video story. One partner watches while another answers questions about it. The highest-scoring team earns shared veto power.

bb24-event-09.name: Mind Your Step
bb24-event-09.description: Players race along a balance-beam maze to reach the finish without falling. The fastest successful run wins HOH.

bb24-event-10.name: OTEV the Singing Stageroach
bb24-event-10.description: OTEV gives clues identifying former houseguests. Players search for the matching sauce bottle and race up the ramp to claim a spot; incorrect answers and the last returner are eliminated. The winner and their Festie Bestie receive shared veto power.

bb24-event-11.name: Conspiracy Fest
bb24-event-11.description: Players cling to a tilting wall while enduring sprays and other distractions. Letting go or falling ends a player's attempt; the last remaining player wins HOH.

bb24-event-12.name: Punkaroo
bb24-event-12.description: Players score points with a ball in elimination rounds. Each eliminated player opens a reward and can trade for an already revealed prize or punishment. Whoever holds the veto after the final exchange wins it.

bb24-event-13.name: Do You See The VIP?
bb24-event-13.description: Two players at a time search crowded festival pictures for an evicted houseguest holding a VIP sign, then identify the correct section. Round winners choose the next matchup. The overall winner becomes the indoor Big BroChella HOH.

bb24-event-14.name: Do You See The VIP?
bb24-event-14.description: This is the runner-up reward from the same VIP picture-search tournament, not a separate challenge. Players identify the section containing an evicted houseguest with a VIP sign. The second-place finisher becomes HOH of the outdoor Dyre Fest group.

bb24-event-15.name: One, Two, Three, VIP
bb24-event-15.description: Players estimate quantities of objects and decide whether to stay in each round or fold. Among those staying, the closest estimate earns a point and the farthest risks elimination. The first to reach the required score wins the indoor veto.

bb24-event-16.name: Lunch is Served
bb24-event-16.description: Players move 50 lightweight food containers from the starting area to their platform without dropping them. The fastest successful completion wins the outdoor veto.

bb24-event-17.name: Carni-Small
bb24-event-17.description: Using tweezers, players stack 21 miniature energy-drink cans in the required arrangement. The first to complete the tiny structure correctly wins HOH.

bb24-event-18.name: Pride Slide
bb24-event-18.description: Players carry liquid back and forth along a slippery lane, filling a container until they can retrieve its floating object. The first to complete the task wins the veto and a movie-screening reward.

bb24-event-19.name: Burning Bot
bb24-event-19.description: Players transport puzzle pieces across the yard and assemble a large Zingbot-themed puzzle on a platform. The first correct completion wins HOH.

bb24-event-20.name: BB Comics
bb24-event-20.description: Players use a zipline to inspect a display of houseguest comic covers. They must select the correct versions, reject subtly altered copies, and reproduce the display's order. The quickest correct board wins the veto.

bb24-event-21.name: Laser Focus
bb24-event-21.description: Players watch sequences of colored lasers and answer questions about what appeared. Correct answers earn points; the highest score wins this double-eviction HOH.

bb24-event-22.name: Amp It Up
bb24-event-22.description: Players maneuver through a large turntable to untangle their cable. The first to free enough length to plug the cable into an amplifier wins the double-eviction veto.

bb24-event-23.name: Horror Fest Lockdown
bb24-event-23.description: Working in complete darkness, players search the space and barricade six doors. The fastest successful completion wins HOH.

bb24-event-24.name: Snooze Fest
bb24-event-24.description: Players must report to the backyard within the short wake-up deadline to remain eligible. They then arrange 27 interlocking gears to operate a cuckoo clock. The fastest working clock wins the veto.

bb24-event-25.name: Fashion Fest
bb24-event-25.description: Players study videos of Julie's outfits and answer seven questions about what they saw. Each correct response earns a point. The highest score wins HOH, with a numerical tiebreaker if needed.

bb24-event-26.name: Mathletes
bb24-event-26.description: Players identify the days on which pictured events occurred and add those day numbers to answer each problem. Accurate event recall and arithmetic determine the final veto winner.

bb24-event-27.name: Wiener-Palooza
bb24-event-27.description: In Part 1 of the final HOH, players cling to oversized hot dogs that move and rotate. The last person holding on advances directly to Part 3; this does not yet award the final HOH.

bb24-event-28.name: Festival Lineup
bb24-event-28.description: In Part 2 of the final HOH, the two remaining players arrange competition information in chronological order. The faster correct completion advances to Part 3.

bb24-event-29.name: Jury Fest
bb24-event-29.description: The Part 1 and Part 2 winners answer factual questions about the jurors' games. Correct responses earn points; the higher score wins the final HOH and decides whom to take to the final two.

bb23-event-01.name: House of Cards
bb23-event-01.description: Each team balances a platform while its captain builds a pyramid of cards. The first captain to finish and buzz in becomes HOH, with teammates also receiving safety.

bb23-event-02.name: Do Not Disturb
bb23-event-02.description: Players search a messy room for keys, a wallet, and a phone while minimizing noise. Sound and overtime add penalty points; the lowest total wins the Wildcard competition and a chance to extend safety to teammates.

bb23-event-03.name: Massive Cocktails
bb23-event-03.description: Players position oversized fruit on a sloping board to guide a ball into a target box. The first successful shot wins the veto.

bb23-event-04.name: Pool Sharks
bb23-event-04.description: Players choose a numbered shooting position, with higher numbers making the shot harder. They try to sink a ball into a shark's mouth; the successful shot from the highest-numbered position wins HOH.

bb23-event-05.name: BB Flying Colors
bb23-event-05.description: Players study colorful images, then answer questions by identifying the correct color. The first to earn three points wins, with safety offered in exchange for changing teams.

bb23-event-06.name: Fun Tan Lotion
bb23-event-06.description: Players fill a container with suntan oil until they can retrieve its whistle. Each competes against the clock; the fastest completion wins the veto.

bb23-event-07.name: Tom Talks BB
bb23-event-07.description: Players watch Tom Green interview members of the public, then answer true-or-false questions about the videos. Wrong answers cause elimination; the last remaining player wins HOH.

bb23-event-08.name: Unlucky 13
bb23-event-08.description: Players carry numbered cards across a balance beam and place them in opponents' slots. A total of thirteen eliminates that opponent. The survivor wins the Wildcard game and may accept a safety offer with consequences for other teams.

bb23-event-09.name: Room Key Rumble
bb23-event-09.description: In head-to-head matches, players spin to lower a barrier, then bowl away selected pins so the remaining numbers form the required room number. The final matchup winner receives the veto.

bb23-event-10.name: Pier Pressure
bb23-event-10.description: Teams take turns building a surfboard puzzle while keeping a countdown from expiring. The person who places the final piece and buzzes in for the first successful team becomes HOH.

bb23-event-11.name: Olive Shook-Up
bb23-event-11.description: Players guide olive-shaped balls down a martini-glass ramp into a straw. The winner chooses between short-term safety for the team and longer safety for themselves.

bb23-event-12.name: Bump, Set, Veto
bb23-event-12.description: Players roll a volleyball along a curved ramp and catch it repeatedly. Dropping it resets their count; the first to complete 100 consecutive catches wins the veto.

bb23-event-13.name: Whale of a Time
bb23-event-13.description: Players cling to a moving wall as water and distractions make holding on harder. The last person remaining wins HOH.

bb23-event-14.name: Kingdom of Curl-A-Lot
bb23-event-14.description: Players perform repetitions on an exercise apparatus in successive rounds. Low scorers are eliminated and select rewards that can be traded for previously revealed prizes or punishments. The person holding the veto at the end wins it.

bb23-event-15.name: Name That Croon
bb23-event-15.description: Players face off to identify whether musical clues refer to HOH, veto, or Wildcard competitions. A correct first answer advances; a wrong answer eliminates the responder. Round winners choose the next matchup, and the survivor becomes HOH.

bb23-event-16.name: Veto Derby
bb23-event-16.description: Players spend BB Bucks to slide drinks down a scoring table. Their scores determine priority when betting on the upcoming veto winner. A correct bet awards a second veto; the sliding game itself does not immediately award one.

bb23-event-17.name: OTEV the Jacked Jellyfish
bb23-event-17.description: OTEV gives clues identifying pairs of houseguests. Players retrieve the matching jelly plaque and race up the ramp; incorrect answers and the last returner are eliminated. The final survivor wins the veto.

bb23-event-18.name: OTEV the Jacked Jellyfish
bb23-event-18.description: This row represents the bonus veto awarded through Veto Derby during the same OTEV challenge. The bettor who correctly selected OTEV's winner receives a second veto; no additional physical competition is played.

bb23-event-19.name: Dash to Dinner
bb23-event-19.description: Players choose a route across a balance-beam maze and race to the buzzer without falling. The fastest successful run earns HOH.

bb23-event-20.name: Chopping Block Roulette
bb23-event-20.description: After paying BB Bucks, players rotate a ball around a handheld roulette wheel for two minutes, scoring completed circuits. The winner removes a nominee, then a roulette spin randomly selects the replacement.

bb23-event-21.name: Domino Effect
bb23-event-21.family: Domino Effect, How Bad Do You Want It?
bb23-event-21.description: Players build a domino chain through three designated checkpoints. Choosing punishment checkpoints makes a run eligible for the veto; choosing prize checkpoints competes for rewards instead. The fastest successful veto route wins the veto and its associated punishments.
families: How Bad Do You Want It?

bb23-event-22.name: BB NFT's
bb23-event-22.description: Players study animated NFT-style images on the Memory Wall and answer true-or-false questions about their details. Incorrect answers eliminate players; the last remaining contestant becomes HOH.

bb23-event-23.name: Coin of Destiny
bb23-event-23.description: Players spend BB Bucks to roll oversized coins down a table into scoring slots. The highest score earns the right to call a coin toss for the chance to become the anonymous HOH.

bb23-event-24.name: Coin of Destiny (Toss)
bb23-event-24.description: This is the activation stage of Coin of Destiny, following the coin-rolling game. The winner calls heads or tails; a correct call replaces the current HOH with a secret HOH who controls the nominations.

bb23-event-25.name: BB High School Hijinks
bb23-event-25.description: Players inspect photographs from a school-themed sequence and use clues within the pictures to place them in chronological order. The fastest correct arrangement wins the veto and a movie-screening reward.

bb23-event-26.name: The Flying BB-inos
bb23-event-26.description: Players stand on small suspended discs while holding ropes as the apparatus spins and hits obstacles. Falling ends an attempt; the last player remaining wins HOH.

bb23-event-27.name: Micro-Cocktails
bb23-event-27.description: Using tweezers, players stack 21 miniature cocktail glasses into a pyramid. The first correctly completed pyramid wins the veto.

bb23-event-28.name: Crash, Boom, Pow
bb23-event-28.description: Players memorize pictures containing comic-book sound effects and answer questions using the corresponding phrase tiles. The most correct answers wins the double-eviction HOH.

bb23-event-29.name: Logo, Let's Go
bb23-event-29.description: Players race to assemble a large BB Comics logo puzzle and press their buzzer. The first correct completion wins the double-eviction veto.

bb23-event-30.name: The Cluckster
bb23-event-30.description: Players move eggs through chicken-wire mesh using their fingertips, then roll them down a ramp to knock over three levers. The first to lower all three wins HOH.

bb23-event-31.name: BB Comics
bb23-event-31.description: Players inspect comic covers while riding a zipline, distinguish originals from altered duplicates, and reproduce the correct order. The quickest fully correct display wins the veto.

bb23-event-32.name: BB Ballers
bb23-event-32.description: Players first roll small balls up a ramp to knock twelve larger balls off a patch of grass. The two fastest advance, then try to leave the most balls on the grass in ten shots. The higher total wins HOH.

bb23-event-33.name: What The Bleep?
bb23-event-33.description: Players watch clips with words bleeped out and judge whether a proposed replacement matches the original speech. Correct answers earn points; the highest score, or numerical tiebreaker, wins the veto.

bb23-event-34.name: BB: Crime Lab
bb23-event-34.description: Players use a blacklight to find crime-scene evidence and identify matching clues. The fastest correct completion of the lab tasks earns HOH and a screening reward.

bb23-event-35.name: BB Winning Days
bb23-event-35.description: Players recall the day of an event, then carry numbered balls across a seesaw so their sum gives that day. The last correct finisher receives a strike; two strikes eliminate a player. The survivor wins the final veto.

bb23-event-36.name: Bouncy Boat Bash
bb23-event-36.description: In Part 1 of the final HOH, players hold onto a suspended, moving boat. The last person holding on advances directly to Part 3.

bb23-event-37.name: Four of a Kind
bb23-event-37.description: In Part 2 of the final HOH, players turn four slot-machine dials to the houseguest faces answering each clue. The faster correct completion advances to Part 3.

bb23-event-38.name: Houseguest Headliners
bb23-event-38.description: The two final-HOH finalists watch juror videos and identify the false statement about each juror's game. Each correct answer earns a point; the highest score wins the final HOH and the sole eviction vote.

bb22-event-01.name: Star Steppin'
bb22-event-01.description: After a preliminary house-search and ball-maze qualifier, finalists race across star-shaped pedestals, some of which wobble. A fall requires restarting. The quickest completed crossing wins HOH.

bb22-event-02.name: Don't Miss A Beat
bb22-event-02.description: Players listen to a remix of Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star, then press seven buttons to reconstruct the song's sections in order. The fastest correct sequence wins safety for the player and a chosen guest.

bb22-event-03.name: It's Bananas
bb22-event-03.description: Players rock on a giant banana to replenish a short timer, then stack fruit cutouts. They must lock in a score before time expires; the largest valid stack wins the veto.

bb22-event-04.name: Big Brother Watch Party
bb22-event-04.description: Players watch a fictional family's video-chat watch party, then answer true-or-false questions about it. A wrong answer eliminates the player; the last remaining contestant becomes HOH.

bb22-event-05.name: Gettin' Tipsy
bb22-event-05.description: Players arrange colored drinks on matching suspended tables while keeping them balanced. The quickest completed arrangement without drinks falling wins safety and a plus-one safety choice.

bb22-event-06.name: All-Starry Night
bb22-event-06.description: Players stand on sloping platforms while balancing a ball on a handheld flat paddle. Dropping the ball eliminates them; the last person still balancing wins the veto.

bb22-event-07.name: Mug Shots
bb22-event-07.description: Players slide mugs along lanes toward scoring targets. The highest total wins HOH, with completion time separating tied scores.

bb22-event-08.name: Stealing Safety
bb22-event-08.description: Players weave through a laser maze, retrieve a ball from a vault, and return it to the start. Breaking a beam requires resetting the alarm. The fastest successful run wins safety and a plus-one choice.

bb22-event-09.name: Cupcake Clash
bb22-event-09.description: Players move cupcake layers between stands under Tower of Hanoi restrictions, never placing a larger layer on a smaller one. Winners advance through head-to-head rounds; the final winner earns the veto.

bb22-event-10.name: Carnival Quick Shot
bb22-event-10.description: Players roll three balls into target holes. Qualifying heats send the fastest finishers to a final round, where the first player to fill all three targets wins HOH.

bb22-event-11.name: Face the Puppetmaster
bb22-event-11.description: Players remain suspended with a rope for each arm and leg while the ropes shift position. The last person to maintain their hold wins the veto.

bb22-event-12.name: Filter Face-Off
bb22-event-12.description: Two players at a time study filtered houseguest pictures and judge whether a stated count is too high, too low, or correct. The first correct answer advances; winners choose the next pair. The survivor wins HOH.

bb22-event-13.name: The Basement of Power
bb22-event-13.description: Players search a pitch-black basement for power-shaped objects and fit them into matching podiums. Three successful matches award three different secret powers: Blocker, Disruptor, and Replay.

bb22-event-14.name: Mathcathalon
bb22-event-14.description: Players hold two buttons until an equation equals thirteen, then react. A false start or the slowest correct reaction eliminates a player. Eliminated players choose and trade rewards; the final veto holder wins it.

bb22-event-15.name: Power Trip
bb22-event-15.description: Players cling to a tilting billboard through sprays and movement. The last remaining player becomes HOH; the first three to fall become Have-Nots.

bb22-event-16.name: Microbrews
bb22-event-16.description: Using tweezers, players arrange fifteen tiny beer cans into a five-level pyramid. The first completed pyramid wins the veto.

bb22-event-17.name: Hydrant Hustle
bb22-event-17.description: Players collect pieces and assemble a large fire-hydrant puzzle, then press their buzzer. The first correct puzzle wins HOH.

bb22-event-18.name: Tiger Zing
bb22-event-18.description: Each player searches a maze for three alien tigers and delivers them to their proper cages. The quickest completed rescue wins the veto.

bb22-event-19.name: Going for the Green
bb22-event-19.description: Players choose to play a putting course for HOH or for cash, taking three shots into numbered scoring areas. The lowest combined score on the HOH side wins power; the cash side has a separate reward.

bb22-event-20.name: OTEV the Psychedelic Salamander
