bb22-event-20.description: OTEV gives clues, and players search a pile of clothing for the matching tie-dye shirt before returning up the ramp. Incorrect answers and the last returner are eliminated. A separate cash-shirt option requires leaving the veto contest.

bb22-event-21.name: It's All About Will
bb22-event-21.description: Players answer true-or-false questions about Dr. Will's messages. Wrong answers cause elimination; the last remaining player wins the first HOH of the triple eviction.

bb22-event-22.name: Ice in Your Veins
bb22-event-22.description: Players cross a balance beam and rearrange an ice-themed puzzle into a fire-themed veto image. Falling causes elimination. The first completed puzzle, or the last player remaining, wins the veto.

bb22-event-23.name: It's All About You
bb22-event-23.description: In the second triple-eviction HOH quiz, players answer true-or-false questions about their own season. Incorrect responses eliminate players; the last remaining contestant becomes HOH.

bb22-event-24.name: Feet to the Fire
bb22-event-24.description: Players carry puzzle pieces one at a time across a balance beam to build a fire-themed image. Falling eliminates a player; the first correct completion or sole survivor wins the veto.

bb22-event-25.name: Namaste Off the Block
bb22-event-25.description: Players hold prescribed yoga poses while maintaining contact with three buttons. Releasing buttons makes their penalty clock run faster. The worst time is eliminated each round; the lowest-time finalist wins HOH.

bb22-event-26.name: Snapshot Shuffle
bb22-event-26.description: Players retrieve six photographs and use visual clues to arrange the depicted baseball outing in chronological order. The fastest correct sequence wins the veto.

bb22-event-27.name: Stashing Pumpkins
bb22-event-27.description: Players carry pumpkins across a seesaw and balance them in a basket. Touching the ground or dropping a pumpkin requires resetting. The first to transfer all pumpkins wins HOH.

bb22-event-28.name: BB Comics
bb22-event-28.description: Players ride a zipline past comic covers, then reproduce the display using the correct versions in the correct order. Decoy covers contain small differences. The fastest accurate board wins the veto.

bb22-event-29.name: Knight Moves
bb22-event-29.description: Players move around a giant chessboard using a knight's L-shaped move, making used squares unavailable. Anyone unable to move legally is eliminated; the last player with a legal move wins HOH.

bb22-event-30.name: Clash of the Comics
bb22-event-30.description: Players draft four houseguest comic characters and watch them compete in a simulated tournament. The player holding the eventual winning character receives the cash prize; this is not a veto challenge.

bb22-event-31.name: The Fast and the Furriest
bb22-event-31.description: Players run in hamster wheels to set a day counter to the date of a house event. Wrong answers earn strikes, and three strikes eliminate a player. The final survivor wins the season's last veto.

bb22-event-32.name: BB Scary Go Round
bb22-event-32.description: In Part 1 of the final HOH, players stand on suspended spinning discs through slime, rain, and obstacles. Falling ends their attempt. The last remaining player advances to Part 3.

bb22-event-33.name: Camera Hogs
bb22-event-33.description: In Part 2 of the final HOH, players select houseguest cutouts matching clues and arrange three photographs, keeping wandering pigs out of the shot. The faster successful completion advances to Part 3.

bb22-event-34.name: Vinyl Exam
bb22-event-34.description: The two finalists watch jurors make three statements about their games and identify the false statement. Correct answers earn points across eight questions. The highest score wins the final HOH and chooses the final eviction.

bb21-event-01.name: The Search for Camp BB
bb21-event-01.description: Banished players navigate a dark forest, avoiding misleading camps and finding Camp BB. The first three return to the house; the last remains banished.

bb21-event-02.name: Color Wars
bb21-event-02.description: Pairs share suspended logs, trying to hold on while the apparatus moves. Falling eliminates a player individually. The last person still on a log wins HOH.

bb21-event-03.name: Nightmare "This Stinks
bb21-event-03.description: Players smell three trash cans and compare them with possible odor sources. The first to identify all three correctly wins the Nightmare power, which can force new nominations.

bb21-event-04.name: Food Fight
bb21-event-04.description: Players catch falling food in successive rounds, earning points for successful catches. The highest total wins the veto.

bb21-event-05.name: BB Fireworks Quiztacular
bb21-event-05.description: Players watch a fireworks display and answer questions using red, white, or blue. Wrong answers cause elimination; the last remaining player becomes HOH.

bb21-event-06.name: Chaos "For Goodness Snakes
bb21-event-06.description: Players compare live snakes and find the three matching the reference snakes. The fastest correct set wins the Chaos power, allowing a veto-player redraw.

bb21-event-07.name: Froggy Style
bb21-event-07.description: Players stack plastic frogs while periodically refilling a draining water clock. After the refill period ends, the surviving stack determines their score. The largest stack wins the veto and a trip.

bb21-event-08.name: Power Shot
bb21-event-08.description: Players toss an arrow toward numbered target areas. The highest score wins HOH; separate small targets offer cash or safety instead.

bb21-event-09.name: Panic "Madagascar Mayhem
bb21-event-09.description: Players search among hissing cockroaches for picture clues, decode the rebus, and assemble its message with letter tiles. The fastest correct solution wins the Panic power.

bb21-event-10.name: The Haunting of Kaitlyn Herman
bb21-event-10.description: Players collect pieces and rebuild a life-size puzzle of Kaitlyn Herman. The first correctly assembled figure wins the veto.

bb21-event-11.name: Path to Redemption
bb21-event-11.description: Camp Comeback players tilt a long track to guide balls into a container. The first to land six balls within the three-minute challenge returns to the game.

bb21-event-12.name: Patch Perfect
bb21-event-12.description: Players answer questions about displayed merit patches. Incorrect or slow responses eliminate contestants through successive rounds. The first correct response in the final matchup wins HOH.

bb21-event-13.name: Take It Off
bb21-event-13.description: Players remove outer clothing while holding three buttons on a jet ski. Releasing buttons accelerates their penalty clock. The lowest adjusted time wins the veto.

bb21-event-14.name: Pose In Ivy
bb21-event-14.description: Players remain suspended on ropes supporting their hands and feet. The last person holding on wins HOH; eliminated players draw chips that can assign punishments.

bb21-event-15.name: Counting Sheep
bb21-event-15.description: In head-to-head rounds, players herd numbered sheep into a pen so the numbers sum to a target. The first correct total advances, and the final winner receives the veto.

bb21-event-16.name: Camp Expo
bb21-event-16.description: Players study camp photographs and answer true-or-false questions about them. Wrong answers eliminate contestants; the last remaining player wins HOH.

bb21-event-17.name: Tossed In Space
bb21-event-17.description: Players launch objects into a scoring field. The lowest score in each round is eliminated and opens a reward that may be exchanged for an earlier prize. The player holding the veto after all trades wins it.

bb21-event-18.name: Time Me A River
bb21-event-18.description: Players ride a canoe across the course, trying to make their trip last exactly nine seconds. The time closest to nine seconds wins HOH.

bb21-event-19.name: Egg-scape the Coop
bb21-event-19.description: Three viewer-selected players move eggs through chicken wire, then roll them to knock down the four letters in SAFE. First place wins immunity, second receives a punishment, and last becomes a third nominee.

bb21-event-20.name: Egg-scape the Coop
bb21-event-20.description: This row records another outcome of the same Field Trip egg challenge. Players move eggs through wire and knock down SAFE targets; finishing order determines immunity, a punishment, or a special nomination.

bb21-event-21.name: OTEV the Paranoid Pigeon
bb21-event-21.description: OTEV gives clues about earlier competitions. Players find an item bearing the correct competition name and return up the ramp. A wrong answer or last-place return eliminates them; the survivor wins the veto.

bb21-event-22.name: Aug-Toberfest
bb21-event-22.description: Players carry liquid across a slippery lane to fill a beer stein and raise its floating ball. The first to retrieve the ball wins HOH.

bb21-event-23.name: Coral Grief
bb21-event-23.description: Players hang ten differently weighted sea creatures on a suspended mobile while keeping it balanced. The first to place all ten successfully and buzz in wins the veto.

bb21-event-24.name: Prank Shot
bb21-event-24.description: Players roll a ball along a narrowing plank over numbered slots. The highest score wins HOH, while the lowest scores receive a punishment.

bb21-event-25.name: Free The Zing!
bb21-event-25.description: Players control a ball with a lever-and-pulley system, raising it along a wall to knock out 27 camera targets. The first to clear all targets wins the veto.

bb21-event-26.name: Hold On Fright
bb21-event-26.description: Players cling to a moving wall through Halloween-themed distractions. Falling ends an attempt; the last person holding on becomes HOH.

bb21-event-27.name: Hide and Go Veto
bb21-event-27.description: Players secretly hide their life preservers inside the house, then take turns searching for opponents' objects. The owner of the last undiscovered life preserver wins the veto.

bb21-event-28.name: On Thin Ice
bb21-event-28.description: Players assemble an ice-rink puzzle, then use a hockey stick to score a goal. The first to complete both tasks wins the double-eviction HOH.

bb21-event-29.name: What The Bleep?
bb21-event-29.description: Players watch clips of houseguest speech with words removed and judge the missing phrase. Correct answers earn points; the highest total wins the veto.

bb21-event-30.name: BB Flix & Chill
bb21-event-30.description: Players listen to clues about movie preferences and choose the matching fictional poster. The first correct answer scores a point; the first to five points wins HOH.

bb21-event-31.name: BB Comics
bb21-event-31.description: Players inspect houseguest comic covers on a zipline, identify the correct versions, and reproduce their order. The fastest accurate arrangement wins the veto.

bb21-event-32.name: Crash and Turn
bb21-event-32.description: Players stand on suspended discs rotating into a foam truck. Falling causes elimination; the last player remaining wins HOH.

bb21-event-33.name: Change of $cenery
bb21-event-33.description: Players inspect the house and estimate how many details have changed. The closest count wins the cash prize, with the earlier submission breaking a tie.

bb21-event-34.name: Win and You're In
bb21-event-34.description: Players knock down houseguest targets that match a stated criterion. Knocking down an incorrect target requires restarting that round. The fastest completion of three rounds wins the final veto.

bb21-event-35.name: Raiders of the BB Relics
bb21-event-35.description: In Part 1 of the final HOH, players complete an obstacle course and a three-dimensional puzzle, then transport 25 coins one at a time. The first finisher advances to Part 3.

bb21-event-36.name: Foggy Memory
bb21-event-36.family: Who Did What?, Sky High Memory
bb21-event-36.description: In Part 2 of the final HOH, players match pictured events to day numbers and climb a wall to place their answers. The fastest fully correct wall advances to Part 3.

bb21-event-37.name: The Jury Is Out
bb21-event-37.description: The two finalists identify the false statement in each juror's video about their game. Correct responses earn points; the highest score wins the final HOH and chooses the final eviction.

bb20-event-01.name: The Trash Folder
bb20-event-01.description: Eight players search a darkened computer-themed area for seven escape folders. The special escape-and-play folder advances its finder to the safety final; the player without a folder receives a punishment.

bb20-event-02.name: The Trash Folder
bb20-event-02.description: This is the punishment outcome of the same Trash Folder challenge. Eight players search in darkness for seven folders; the player left without one receives the Pinwheel of Doom costume punishment.

bb20-event-03.name: Title Unknown
bb20-event-03.description: In the HouseGuest CAPTCHA qualifier, tethered players gather letters while being lifted and lowered, then spell HOUSEGUEST on their platforms. The first correct word advances to the safety final.

bb20-event-04.name: Title Unknown
bb20-event-04.description: This is the last-place outcome of HouseGuest CAPTCHA. Players collect letters on moving tethers and spell HOUSEGUEST; the last finisher receives the robot punishment.

bb20-event-05.name: Surfing the BB Web
bb20-event-05.description: The two preliminary winners balance on moving surfboards in a web-themed endurance challenge. The last person remaining wins the right to protect two move-in groups, including themselves, from the first eviction.

bb20-event-06.name: Microchip Mayhem
bb20-event-06.description: Players cross balance beams to collect deletion dots and deposit them in opponents' tubes. Ten dots eliminate a player. The final survivor becomes HOH.

bb20-event-07.name: Going Viral
bb20-event-07.description: Five elimination rounds test snake-pit retrieval, cold-water diving, balance under paintball fire, ball transport with shocks, and flavor identification. A player is eliminated each round; the winner of the final flavor task earns the veto.

bb20-event-08.name: Land a Job
bb20-event-08.description: Players launch a ball toward a miniature town. Each landing area has a salary value; the highest salary wins HOH.

bb20-event-09.name: HouseguestsOnly.com
bb20-event-09.description: Players read former houseguests' dating profiles and assign them to compatible date locations. They correct mismatches until the board is complete. The fastest correct arrangement wins the veto.

bb20-event-10.name: Product Launch
bb20-event-10.description: Players watch fictional technology-product launches and answer true-or-false questions about them. Wrong answers eliminate contestants. A numerical tiebreaker resolves a tie for HOH.

bb20-event-11.name: Mamma Mia Mayhem
bb20-event-11.description: Players spin on a disco ball to refill a short timer, then stack champagne glasses. Letting time expire eliminates them unless they accept a Have-Not penalty to return. The first completed tower wins the veto and a trip.

bb20-event-12.name: Out On A Limb
bb20-event-12.description: Players stand on narrow tree ledges while the wall tilts and sprays them. The last person still holding on wins HOH.

bb20-event-13.name: Chop, Bonk, Spank
bb20-event-13.description: Players memorize sequences of choreographed chops, bonks, and spanks, then answer questions about their order. Correct answers earn points; the highest total wins the veto.

bb20-event-14.name: Outside the House
bb20-event-14.description: The evicted player dismantles a life-size puzzle of herself, moves its pieces through a house-shaped opening, and rebuilds it on the other side. Correct completion within two minutes thirty seconds restores her place in the game.

bb20-event-15.name: Information Highway
bb20-event-15.description: Players ride an email-shaped sled from an outbox to an inbox, trying to make the journey last exactly eight seconds. The closest time wins HOH.

bb20-event-16.name: Goober Driver
bb20-event-16.description: Players assemble a continuous road, then drive the evicted-houseguest passengers across town. The fastest correctly completed route and delivery wins the veto.

bb20-event-17.name: GIF That Keeps On Giving
bb20-event-17.description: Players study animated GIFs shown during the week, then answer true-or-false questions about their details. Wrong answers cause elimination; the survivor or tiebreaker winner becomes HOH.

bb20-event-18.name: Crack the Code
bb20-event-18.description: Players unscramble Big Brother-related words in seven timed rounds. Each correct solution earns a point; the highest score wins the secret Hacker power.

bb20-event-19.name: Boom Power Trip
bb20-event-19.description: Players roll and catch a ball repeatedly, racing to reach each round's required count. The last finisher is eliminated and chooses or swaps a reward. Whoever retains the veto after the final exchange wins it.

bb20-event-20.name: #HashtagTooLong!
bb20-event-20.description: In head-to-head rounds, players decode long hashtag clues and select the matching answer. The first correct response eliminates the opponent; an incorrect response eliminates the responder. The last player remaining wins HOH.

bb20-event-21.name: Hack the House
bb20-event-21.description: Players identify rooms from cropped camera images. Each correct room earns a point over seven rounds; the highest score wins the Hacker power.

bb20-event-22.name: OTEV the Sneezy Skunk
bb20-event-22.description: OTEV gives clues identifying pairs of evicted houseguests. Players retrieve the corresponding medicine bottle and return up the ramp. A wrong answer or last return causes elimination; the survivor wins the veto.

bb20-event-23.name: Glow & Flow
bb20-event-23.description: Players carry liquid along a slippery lane to fill a container and retrieve its ball. First to retrieve the HOH ball wins power; another container offers a cash prize.

bb20-event-24.name: Zing Force
bb20-event-24.family: Zingbot Competition, Hide and Go Veto
bb20-event-24.description: Players hide their veto cards inside the house, then take timed turns searching for others' cards. Owners are revealed at the end; the player whose card remains hidden wins the veto.

bb20-event-25.name: Sweet Shot
bb20-event-25.description: Players search candy for tickets, exchange them for balls, and roll toward a narrow perfect-shot target. Landing that shot wins HOH immediately; otherwise the highest score after an hour wins.

bb20-event-26.name: Mission to Planet Veto
bb20-event-26.description: Players catch incoming objects across three alien-themed rounds with different point values, including mouth catches in the final round. Objects touching the ground do not count. The highest total wins the veto.

bb20-event-27.name: Big Top Drop
bb20-event-27.description: Evicted jurors collect balls of their assigned color and carry them back to fill a tube. The first to finish and hit the buzzer returns to the game.

bb20-event-28.name: Pie in the Sky
bb20-event-28.description: Players hold ropes while standing on suspended discs that swing into a giant pie and receive pie filling and custard. The last player remaining wins HOH.

bb20-event-29.name: Control Your Emoji
bb20-event-29.description: Players carry emoji balls across a seesaw and stack them in a message-bubble container. Dropped emojis require restarting. The first to transfer the complete set wins the veto.

bb20-event-30.name: Shell or Highwater
bb20-event-30.description: Players maneuver pearls down a winding seaweed-shaped track into oysters. The first to land three pearls, or the most within three minutes, wins HOH.

bb20-event-31.name: BB Comics
bb20-event-31.description: Players memorize comic covers on video screens, then cross an obstacle course and knock down character cutouts that differ from the originals. The fastest correct run wins the veto. This season uses a course instead of the usual zipline-and-rebuild format.

bb20-event-32.name: Buffering
bb20-event-32.description: Players study competition videos, then answer questions when replayed clips stop at a buffering point. Each correct response earns a point; the highest score wins the double-eviction HOH.

bb20-event-33.name: Block and Roll
bb20-event-33.description: Players arrange blocks to support a track, then roll a ball through it into the target hole. The first successful shot wins the double-eviction veto.

bb20-event-34.name: BB Flix & Chill
bb20-event-34.description: Players listen to movie-selection clues and choose which fictional poster satisfies them. Correct answers earn points; the top performer becomes HOH.

bb20-event-35.name: Your Maze are Numbered
bb20-event-35.description: Players navigate a maze to visit one wizard, two wolves, and three witches in sequence. They must reach each next station within thirty seconds or restart. The fastest complete route wins the veto.

bb20-event-36.name: What The Bleep?
bb20-event-36.description: Players watch houseguest clips with words bleeped out and judge what was originally said. Correct responses score points; the highest total wins HOH.

bb20-event-37.name: Down to the Wires
bb20-event-37.description: Players answer season questions by raising balls on wires and placing them beside the correct competition answers. A wrong or last response earns a strike; two strikes eliminate a player. The survivor wins the final veto.

bb20-event-38.name: Jetpack Attack
bb20-event-38.description: In Part 1 of the final HOH, players cling to moving jetpacks as they fly through the set. The last person holding on advances to Part 3.

bb20-event-39.name: Mount Evictus
bb20-event-39.family: Who Did What?, Sky High Memory
bb20-event-39.description: In Part 2 of the final HOH, players identify four evicted houseguests matching each category and place their names on a climbing wall. The fastest correct completion advances to Part 3.

bb20-event-40.name: Jury Oddcasts
bb20-event-40.description: The two finalists judge whether jurors' recorded statements about their games are true or false. Correct responses score points; a numerical tiebreaker resolves a tie. The winner becomes final HOH.

bb19-event-01.name: Garden of Temptation
bb19-event-01.description: Players privately decide whether to press a button when a flower turns green to claim $25,000. The first accepts the money, must forfeit the first HOH, and triggers a house-wide consequence.

bb19-event-02.name: Tempted by the Fruit
bb19-event-02.description: Players balance on trapezes while holding ropes. The last remaining player is safe; those who fall select apples that may grant safety or place them among the first eviction nominees.

bb19-event-03.name: Hangs in the Balance
bb19-event-03.description: Teams swing to retrieve apples, with the first two teams advancing. One representative per finalist team then balances seven apples on a hanging tree; first to finish becomes HOH. A golden-apple temptation grants safety but eliminates that player's team.

bb19-event-04.name: Fin to Win
bb19-event-04.description: Players collect and stack starfish while refilling a draining water timer. Their stack locks when time runs out; the largest valid stack wins the veto. Taking the golden starfish awards a Never-Not pass instead.

bb19-event-05.name: Sugar Shot
bb19-event-05.description: Players search falling candy for tickets, exchange them for shots, and roll balls toward a heart-shaped target. The first successful center shot wins HOH.

bb19-event-06.name: Path of Least Resistance
bb19-event-06.description: Players move through five areas and answer questions about what they observed. Correct answers unlock shortcuts; mistakes send them through slower tasks. The fastest completed course wins the veto.

bb19-event-07.name: Space Cadets
bb19-event-07.description: Players cling to the side of a moving space station on small footholds. Falling causes elimination; the last remaining player wins HOH.

bb19-event-08.name: Temple of Temptation
bb19-event-08.description: Players repeatedly cross a suspended beam and return to their buzzer, earning a point per trip. Falling resets the score. First to fifty wins the veto; a separate cash temptation requires withdrawing.

bb19-event-09.name: Maze Race
bb19-event-09.family: Pull Some Strings, Roll It Down
bb19-event-09.description: Battle Back players use ropes and pulleys to tilt a maze and guide a ball to its goal. The two fastest evictees advance from the opening round. A later head-to-head replay determines whether the surviving evictee returns to the house.

bb19-event-10.name: Maze Race
bb19-event-10.description: Maze Race uses a rope-controlled tilting board to steer a ball to the finish. It appears in both the opening qualifier and the final Battle Back duel, where the surviving evictee must beat the house's challenger to return.

bb19-event-11.name: Billboard Bashers
bb19-event-11.description: The two qualifying evictees use slingshots to knock out ten billboard targets. The first to clear the board advances to the final Battle Back duel; this round alone does not restore a place in the house.

bb19-event-12.name: What's The Hold Up
bb19-event-12.description: Players press a disc against an overhead board using a long stick. Dropping the disc eliminates them; departing players assign obstacles to others. The last disc held up wins HOH.

bb19-event-13.name: BB Juicy Blast
bb19-event-13.description: Players memorize a sequence of smoothie ingredients and answer questions about it. Wrong answers eliminate contestants; the last remaining player wins the veto.

bb19-event-14.name: Inked & Evicted
bb19-event-14.description: Players inspect photographs of evicted houseguests and answer questions about their details. An incorrect answer causes elimination; the survivor becomes HOH.

bb19-event-15.name: Bowlerina
bb19-event-15.description: Players spin fifteen times to open a brief bowling window, then try to knock down four pins. More spins restore time. The fastest player wins safety; the slowest becomes a third nominee.

bb19-event-16.name: Under the Weather
bb19-event-16.description: Players study weather bulletins, then fill blanks in a scrolling forecast with evicted houseguests' names while enduring a simulated storm. The most correct answers wins the veto.

bb19-event-17.name: Gravestone Golf
bb19-event-17.description: Players putt an eyeball down a graveyard course toward numbered slots. The highest landing score wins HOH.

bb19-event-18.name: Strangest Things
bb19-event-18.description: Players search a dark house for circled letters, unscramble the clue, and retrieve the identified object. The fastest completion wins safety; the slowest becomes a third nominee.

bb19-event-19.name: Strangest Things
bb19-event-19.description: This row represents another result of the same dark-house Temptation challenge. Players decode letters and retrieve an object; the fastest gains safety, while the slowest is nominated.

bb19-event-20.name: OTEV the Possessed Piglet
bb19-event-20.description: OTEV asks questions with numerical answers. Players find the shoe displaying the correct number and race to a remaining stump. Wrong answers or the last return eliminate a player; the survivor wins the veto.

bb19-event-21.name: Hocus Focus
bb19-event-21.description: Players watch magic performances and answer questions about what happened. Incorrect answers eliminate contestants; the last player remaining becomes HOH.

bb19-event-22.name: Where Were You?
bb19-event-22.description: Players recall where they were when specific sounds played and stand in that room on a floor-plan board. Correct answers score points; the highest total wins safety and the lowest becomes a third nominee.

bb19-event-23.name: BB Adventure Tours
bb19-event-23.description: Players shoot arrows at numbered map locations, which become unavailable after being hit. Each round's lowest scorer is eliminated and opens or trades a reward. The final veto holder wins the veto and a dinner invitation.

bb19-event-24.name: Let It Slide
bb19-event-24.description: In head-to-head matches, players slide a disc toward a board's edge without falling off. The closest valid disc advances; winners choose the next pair. The last player remaining wins HOH.

bb19-event-25.name: Kenya Solve It
bb19-event-25.description: Players fit pieces into the outlines of three successive puzzles. The first to complete all three correctly and buzz in wins the double-eviction veto.

bb19-event-26.name: Tales From Decrypt
bb19-event-26.description: Players face off as encrypted messages are gradually revealed and identify the houseguest described. First correct advances; an incorrect answer eliminates the responder. The tournament winner becomes HOH.

bb19-event-27.name: Home Zing Home
bb19-event-27.description: Players carry liquid down a slippery lane to fill a bowl and retrieve its ball. Filling a smaller bowl first unlocks a larger carrying cup. The first to retrieve the main ball wins the veto.

bb19-event-28.name: Everyone's A Wiener
bb19-event-28.description: Players brace themselves inside hot-dog buns using handholds and footholds while the wall moves. The last remaining player wins HOH.

bb19-event-29.name: Hide and Go Veto
bb19-event-29.description: Players hide veto cards inside the house, then take timed turns searching for the others. The player whose card remains undiscovered wins the veto.

bb19-event-30.name: Ready, Set, Woah!
bb19-event-30.description: Players hold two buttons until the screen displays GO, then sprint to a finish button. A false start or last-place finish eliminates them. The survivor wins HOH.

bb19-event-31.name: Punch, Slap, Kick
bb19-event-31.description: Players memorize sequences of simulated punches, slaps, and kicks, then answer questions about them. Correct answers score points; the top score wins the veto, with extra sequences breaking a tie.

bb19-event-32.name: Fake News
bb19-event-32.description: Players decide whether headlines about the season are real or fake. Each correct judgment earns a point; the highest total after seven questions wins HOH.

bb19-event-33.name: Lime Drop
bb19-event-33.description: Players search a ball pit for limes, then return and drop them into a narrow tube. Balls that hit the ground do not count. First to land four and buzz in wins the veto.

bb19-event-34.name: The Revengers
bb19-event-34.description: Players study a trailer featuring former houseguests as superheroes and select characters answering each question. The most correct answers across seven questions wins HOH.

bb19-event-35.name: BB Comics
bb19-event-35.description: Players inspect comic covers while riding a zipline and recreate the correct display, rejecting altered duplicates. The fastest accurate arrangement wins the veto.

bb19-event-36.name: What The Bleep?
bb19-event-36.description: Players watch clips with censored speech and judge whether a proposed phrase matches the original. Correct answers score points; the highest total wins HOH.

bb19-event-37.name: Back to the Veto
bb19-event-37.description: Players turn dials to enter the day of a specified house event. Wrong entries reset their counter; the last correct player receives a strike. Three strikes eliminate a player, and the survivor wins the final veto.

bb19-event-38.name: Tail of the Unicorn
bb19-event-38.description: In Part 1 of the final HOH, players stand on clouds while holding unicorn tails. Letting go ends an attempt; the last person remaining advances to Part 3.

bb19-event-39.name: Knock 'Em Down
bb19-event-39.description: In Part 2 of the final HOH, players knock down houseguest targets that do not fit each scroll's clue. The faster correct completion of three scrolls advances to Part 3.

bb19-event-40.name: The Scales Of Just Us
bb19-event-40.description: The two finalists predict how jurors completed personal statements about their experience. Each correct response earns a point; the highest score wins the final HOH and chooses the final eviction.

bb18-event-01.name: Ride the Rocket
bb18-event-01.description: Teams cling to moving rockets. The last team remaining wins safety for two evictions; earlier team eliminations determine Have-Not status, a punishment, or a shared cash prize.

bb18-event-02.name: Welcome to the Beach
bb18-event-02.description: Three teammates hold ropes supporting a platform while the fourth retrieves and places blocks, rotating roles after each delivery. The first team to build a fifteen-block castle earns safety.

bb18-event-03.name: Welcome Back to the Beach
bb18-event-03.description: The remaining teams assemble a tiered three-dimensional sandcastle puzzle. The first correct completion wins safety; the losing team must face an individual elimination challenge.

bb18-event-04.name: Hit The Road Part 3
bb18-event-04.description: The final team's members balance on tilting islands while moving coconuts into holes spelling SOS, then retrieve a flag. The last finisher is immediately evicted.

bb18-event-05.name: Hit The Road Part 3
bb18-event-05.description: This is the HOH selection following Hit the Road Part 3. After the coconut-balancing challenge eliminates one teammate, the three survivors choose which of them becomes the first HOH; it is not a separate timed contest.

bb18-event-06.name: Take It Off
bb18-event-06.description: Players remove a tracksuit while keeping three buttons pressed in an RV. Releasing buttons accelerates the clock. The shortest adjusted time wins the right to secretly nominate a third houseguest.

bb18-event-07.name: Dizzy Dog
bb18-event-07.description: Players spin fifteen times to refill a 45-second timer, then cross obstacles and stack dog treats. They must spin again before time expires. The first to stack forty treats wins the veto.

bb18-event-08.name: Berry Balanced
bb18-event-08.description: Teams carry berries across balance beams, locking each column after ten berries. Falls empty the unfinished column and eliminate the carrier. After forty berries, the teammate who retrieves the blue berry becomes HOH.

bb18-event-09.name: Berry Balanced
bb18-event-09.description: Two evictees carry twenty berries across balance beams, locking them in ten-berry columns. Falling empties the unfinished column; a poison berry can empty the opponent's current column. The winner advances in Battle Back.

bb18-event-10.name: 18 Dollas
bb18-event-10.description: Players identify six items whose displayed prices total exactly $18. The fastest correct selection wins the secret Roadkill nomination.

bb18-event-11.name: Toe-Zarks
bb18-event-11.description: Players retrieve letter tiles from oversized toes and form a correctly spelled word within twelve minutes. Letters have point values; the highest-scoring word wins the veto.

bb18-event-12.name: Kiss My Ace
bb18-event-12.description: Teammates take turns bouncing balls off oversized rackets toward numbered scoring areas. Each round's lowest scorer is eliminated. The final remaining player becomes HOH and protects their team.

bb18-event-13.name: Kiss My Ace
bb18-event-13.description: Two evictees bounce tennis balls off oversized rackets to knock down five opponent targets. They retrieve missed balls when necessary. The first to clear all targets advances in Battle Back.

bb18-event-14.name: Hornstar
bb18-event-14.description: Players listen to an eight-note horn sequence and recreate it using the correct horns. The fastest accurate replay wins the secret Roadkill nomination.

bb18-event-15.name: Veto-licious
bb18-event-15.description: Players memorize colored ingredient sequences and pour the ingredient answering each question. A wrong choice eliminates them. The last player remaining wins the veto and a team dinner.

bb18-event-16.name: Euro Trippin'
bb18-event-16.description: Players study travel photographs and answer true-or-false questions about their details. Incorrect responses cause elimination; the survivor becomes HOH.

bb18-event-17.name: Euro Trippin'
bb18-event-17.description: Two evictees study photographs cycling across monitors and place houseguest pictures into six answer booths. The first to answer all six questions correctly advances in Battle Back.

bb18-event-18.name: Gasping for Air
bb18-event-18.description: Players hang air fresheners on matching colored lines without dropping them. Fallen fresheners no longer count. The most successfully hung within the time limit, with speed separating equal scores, wins Roadkill.

bb18-event-19.name: Scooper Star
bb18-event-19.description: In head-to-head rounds, players transfer ice-cream scoops one at a time to reproduce a pictured arrangement. Scoops cannot be put on the ground. The final surviving player wins the veto.

bb18-event-20.name: Electric BB Festival
bb18-event-20.description: The final two Battle Back contestants assemble a large festival poster and use audio clues to complete the band schedule. The first correct puzzle restores that evictee's place in the game.

bb18-event-21.name: Watch Your Dubstep
bb18-event-21.description: Players keep one wrist raised while stepping over moving bars. Lowering the arm triggers their confetti box and eliminates them. The last player remaining wins HOH.

bb18-event-22.name: OTEV the Dopest DJ
bb18-event-22.description: OTEV gives musical clues about earlier competitions. Players find the record bearing the correct competition name and return to a remaining spot. The last correct returner is eliminated each round; the survivor wins the veto.

bb18-event-23.name: Perfect Shot
bb18-event-23.description: Players practice freely with a yellow ball, then take one official red-ball shot down a narrow track. A perfect shot wins HOH; if nobody makes it, the highest landing score wins.

bb18-event-24.name: Ready, Set, Woah!
bb18-event-24.description: Players hold starting buttons until GO appears, then sprint to a finish button. Leaving early or finishing last eliminates them. The final survivor wins the veto.

bb18-event-25.name: Harsh Hashtags
bb18-event-25.description: Players stand on hanging discs that spin into punching bags. Falling eliminates a player; the last person remaining wins HOH.

bb18-event-26.name: Hide and Go Veto
bb18-event-26.description: Players secretly hide veto cards in the house, then take turns searching for the others. The owner of the final undiscovered card wins the veto.

bb18-event-27.name: Statcathlon
bb18-event-27.description: Players judge whether numerical claims about the season are higher or lower than the correct figures. A wrong answer eliminates them; the survivor wins the double-eviction HOH.

bb18-event-28.name: Veto Time
bb18-event-28.description: Players search a ball pit for three clocks, returning them one at a time, then retrieve the veto symbol and hit the buzzer. The first to finish wins the veto.

bb18-event-29.name: Hollywood Squirrels
bb18-event-29.description: Players face off to answer questions about a grid of squirrel images. First correct eliminates the opponent; a wrong response eliminates the responder. Winners choose the next pair, and the survivor wins HOH.

bb18-event-30.name: Zingbot For President
bb18-event-30.description: Players launch beanbags at an electoral map; used scoring areas become worth zero. The lowest score leaves each round and selects or trades a prize. The final veto holder wins it.

bb18-event-31.name: Dunk-A-Hunk
bb18-event-31.description: Each player gets five throws at a dunk-tank target with Jessie Godderz on the seat. The most successful dunks wins a technology prize package, not game power.

bb18-event-32.name: Fill Your Pie Hole
bb18-event-32.description: Players choose numbered pies and search them face-first without using their hands. The revealed outcomes assign Have or Have-Not status; the pie numbers also enter a draw for an HOH advantage.

bb18-event-33.name: Fill Your Pie Hole
bb18-event-33.description: This is the bonus reward linked to the pie event, not a second eating contest. A number drawn from the players' pie numbers grants its holder an extra thirty-second solo search in the next HOH challenge.

bb18-event-34.name: Black Box
bb18-event-34.description: Players hold buttons in a pitch-black room, leaving only during announced searches to collect valid discs. Returning late causes elimination. The surviving player with the most discs wins HOH.

bb18-event-35.name: America's Care Package
bb18-event-35.description: Viewers award a care package granting co-HOH power. The recipient gains safety and names one nominee alongside the regular HOH. This is a public-vote reward, not a challenge played by houseguests.

bb18-event-36.name: BB Storm Watch
bb18-event-36.description: Players memorize storm bulletins and fill missing houseguest names into a scrolling forecast while standing in a simulated storm. The most correct blanks wins the veto.

bb18-event-37.name: Welcome to Loch Mess
bb18-event-37.description: Jurors and current players cling to a tilting wall. The last juror still holding on returns to the game; the overall survivor separately wins HOH.

bb18-event-38.name: Welcome to Loch Mess
bb18-event-38.description: This is the HOH outcome of the same Loch Mess wall challenge. Everyone competes to remain on the wall; the last overall player wins HOH, while the longest-lasting juror earns re-entry.

bb18-event-39.name: Santa's Little Counters
bb18-event-39.description: Players estimate holiday-object quantities, then choose to stay or fold. The closest staying estimate earns a candy cane and the farthest is eliminated. First to three candy canes wins the veto.

bb18-event-40.name: Poached Eggs
bb18-event-40.description: Players move eggs through chicken wire with their fingertips, then roll them down a ramp to knock over H-O-H targets. First to clear all three wins HOH.

bb18-event-41.name: Take A Crack At Being Mac
bb18-event-41.family: Take A Crack At Being Mac
bb18-event-41.description: Players use available objects and clues to escape three MacGyver-themed rooms. The fastest successful escape wins the veto and a set visit.
families: Take A Crack At Being Mac

bb18-event-42.name: BB Slide in Theatre
bb18-event-42.description: Players carry butter along a slippery lane to fill a bowl and retrieve its ball. Filling a smaller bowl unlocks a larger scoop. The first main-ball retrieval wins HOH.

bb18-event-43.name: BB Comics
bb18-event-43.description: Players inspect sixteen houseguest comics on a zipline and recreate the correct display while rejecting altered covers. The fastest accurate arrangement wins the veto.

bb18-event-44.name: What The Bleep?
bb18-event-44.description: Players watch clips with bleeped-out words and judge the suggested original phrase. Correct answers score points; the top score or numerical tiebreaker wins HOH.

bb18-event-45.name: Cover Your Bases
bb18-event-45.description: Players step on baseball bases to advance a day counter and identify when house events occurred. The last correct answer gets an out; three outs eliminate a player. The survivor wins the final veto.

bb18-event-46.name: Hang In There Kitty
bb18-event-46.description: In Part 1 of the final HOH, players follow a laser among three endurance stations and assume the required position within fifteen seconds. Falling or arriving late eliminates them; the survivor advances to Part 3.

bb18-event-47.name: Snapshot
bb18-event-47.description: In Part 2 of the final HOH, players select three houseguests matching each clue, load their cutouts into a roller coaster, and photograph them correctly in frame. The faster three-photo completion advances.

bb18-event-48.name: The Scales Of Just Us
bb18-event-48.description: The two finalists predict how jurors finished personal statements about the season. Correct choices earn points; the highest score wins the final HOH and chooses the last eviction.

bb17-event-01.name: Flying Tomatoes
bb17-event-01.description: Players balance on moving perches while plastic tomatoes are launched at them. The first to catch ten tomatoes, or the last player still on a perch, becomes the first HOH.

bb17-event-02.name: UFOh No
bb17-event-02.description: Players cling to poles while harnesses pull them upward. The last person maintaining their hold becomes the second HOH.

bb17-event-03.name: Du-BOB
bb17-event-03.description: Nominee pairs cross balance beams carrying blocks and build a tower matching a blueprint. The first correct tower wins both partners safety and dethrones their nominating HOH.

bb17-event-04.name: Nose-a Scotia
bb17-event-04.description: Players search for letter tiles and build a correctly spelled word. Each letter has a point value; the highest-scoring valid word wins the veto.

bb17-event-05.name: Ginger Fever
bb17-event-05.description: Players compete in two groups, racing to assemble a puzzle. The first correct finisher in each group becomes one of the week's two HOHs.

bb17-event-06.name: Give Me Props
bb17-event-06.description: Partners share oversized clothing and coordinate their movement while aiming nine cameras to match a shot list. The first complete set of correct shots wins both players safety and dethrones their HOH.

bb17-event-07.name: High Maintenance
bb17-event-07.description: Players memorize a seven-item list and inspect an image showing only six. In head-to-head rounds, they retrieve the missing object and buzz in. The final surviving player wins the veto.

bb17-event-08.name: Gronk Pong
bb17-event-08.description: Players launch a ball into a triangle of oversized cups with different point values. The two highest scores become HOHs, with extra shots breaking ties.

bb17-event-09.name: Gronk's A-maze-ing Foam Party
bb17-event-09.description: Partners alternate finding patterned clothing, navigating a foam maze, and escorting the matching person back. The first pair to rescue ten people earns safety and dethrones its nominating HOH.

bb17-event-10.name: Gronk and Roll
bb17-event-10.description: Players roll giant dice by moving inside them, trying to reach the starting platform with a called number facing up. Head-to-head winners advance; the final survivor wins the veto.

bb17-event-11.name: Untitled
bb17-event-11.description: The week's competition winners choose cups at random. One cup contains the winning chip, awarding its holder a cabin on a three-day cruise with Rob Gronkowski.

bb17-event-12.name: Bustin' Moves
bb17-event-12.description: Players watch a 1990s-themed dance and answer true-or-false questions about it. Incorrect answers eliminate contestants; the last two remaining become the week's HOHs.

bb17-event-13.name: Grunge BOB
bb17-event-13.description: Pairs search four grunge-themed areas for keys, unlock a chained mannequin, and carry it to the finish. The first pair to finish wins safety and dethrones its HOH.

bb17-event-14.name: Saved by the Smell
bb17-event-14.description: Players memorize chemical sequences and choose the ingredient answering each question. A wrong choice triggers a splash and elimination. The last player remaining wins the veto.

bb17-event-15.name: Pop Till You Drop
bb17-event-15.description: Players face off to identify whether a song describes an HOH, Battle of the Block, or veto competition. The first correct answer advances; wrong answers eliminate. The final two survivors become HOHs.

bb17-event-16.name: Splashy Headlines
bb17-event-16.description: Pairs throw paint to reveal hidden letters and identify three former houseguests' names. First to solve them all wins both nominees safety and dethrones their HOH, with a dinner reward.

bb17-event-17.name: Get Nutty
bb17-event-17.description: Players roll and catch a plastic acorn along a curved ramp without dropping it. The first to reach 250 consecutive repetitions wins the veto; a drop resets the count.

bb17-event-18.name: On the Edge
bb17-event-18.description: Players stand on a narrow ledge against a tilting wall through sprays and movement. The last person holding on wins HOH.

bb17-event-19.name: Game of Throws
bb17-event-19.description: Players launch darts onto a scoring board. Each round's lowest scorer is eliminated and opens or swaps a prize or punishment. The player holding the veto after the final exchange wins it.

bb17-event-20.name: Midway Mayhem
bb17-event-20.description: Players shuttle liquid along a slippery lane to raise three prize balls. They may collect cash and a Never-Not pass before taking the HOH ball, which ends the challenge.

bb17-event-21.name: BB Comics
bb17-event-21.description: Players inspect seventeen houseguest comic covers from a zipline and recreate the order using the correct versions. The fastest accurate arrangement wins the veto.

bb17-event-22.name: Getting Loopy
bb17-event-22.description: Players study looping videos of earlier house events and answer true-or-false questions about them. Wrong responses eliminate players; the survivor wins the double-eviction HOH.

bb17-event-23.name: Slippery Slope
bb17-event-23.description: Players guide balls down a tilting track into three holes in the required order. Filling a hole out of order eliminates them. First to complete all three wins the veto.

bb17-event-24.name: Mixed Emojis
bb17-event-24.description: In head-to-head matches, players identify the emoji answering a question. The first correct answer advances; an incorrect response eliminates the responder. The tournament winner becomes HOH.

bb17-event-25.name: OTEV the Rockin' Roll
bb17-event-25.description: OTEV gives clues about houseguests, and players retrieve butter containers bearing the correct names. They race back to shrinking numbers of spots; the final survivor wins the veto.

bb17-event-26.name: Ready, Set, Woah
bb17-event-26.description: Players hold buttons until GO appears, then race down their lanes. Releasing early or arriving last eliminates them. The final survivor wins HOH.

bb17-event-27.name: Newly Zingle
bb17-event-27.description: Players examine six faces made from blended houseguest features and identify the three people contributing to each. The fastest fully correct set wins the veto.

bb17-event-28.name: Dizzyland
bb17-event-28.description: Players and returning jurors stand on suspended spinning discs that strike obstacles. The last overall player wins HOH; the longest-lasting juror separately earns re-entry.

bb17-event-29.name: Dizzyland
bb17-event-29.description: This is the re-entry result of the same Dizzyland endurance challenge. Jurors stand on spinning discs and hold ropes; the last juror remaining returns to the game, even if someone else wins HOH.

bb17-event-30.name: Hide and Go Veto
bb17-event-30.description: Players secretly hide veto boxes in the house, then search for others in timed turns. The owner of the last unfound box wins the veto.

bb17-event-31.name: BB Road Trip
bb17-event-31.description: Players study pictures of evicted houseguests on a road trip and answer true-or-false questions about them. Incorrect responses eliminate contestants; the last player remaining becomes HOH.

bb17-event-32.name: Boomerang
bb17-event-32.description: Players roll two balls along a boomerang-shaped track into numbered slots. The greatest combined score wins the veto.

bb17-event-33.name: Starting Lineup
bb17-event-33.description: Players watch a rapid sequence of baseball cards, identify the missing houseguest, and assemble that person's face puzzle. The slowest correct finisher leaves each round; the survivor wins HOH.

bb17-event-34.name: Bowlerina
bb17-event-34.description: Players spin to lower a barrier for a short bowling window, then try to knock down four pins. Winners advance through head-to-head rounds. The final survivor wins the veto.

bb17-event-35.name: Under the Rainbow
bb17-event-35.description: Players maneuver eggs over curved chicken wire and into ten slots using their fingertips. The first to fill all ten wins HOH; a separate slot offers an outing prize.

bb17-event-36.name: Under the Rainbow
bb17-event-36.description: This is the luxury reward within the same egg-moving HOH challenge. The first player to place an egg in the special prize slot wins a trip outside the house; filling the ten main slots awards HOH separately.

bb17-event-37.name: Life in Pieces
bb17-event-37.description: Players cross a balance beam to assemble a puzzle on a magnetic board, returning often to reset its timer. Falling or running out of time releases the pieces. The first completed puzzle wins the veto.

bb17-event-38.name: What The Bleep?
bb17-event-38.description: Players watch censored speech clips and judge whether the suggested missing words are correct. The most points across seven clips wins HOH, with a numerical tiebreaker if needed.

bb17-event-39.name: Martial Smarts
bb17-event-39.description: Players punch or kick a counter to enter the day of a house event. Incorrect entries reset; the last correct response earns a strike. Two strikes eliminate a player, and the survivor wins the final veto.

bb17-event-40.name: How Bout Them Apples
bb17-event-40.description: In Part 1 of the final HOH, players hold onto apple-shaped balls while being dunked in chocolate. The last remaining player advances to Part 3.

bb17-event-41.name: Colossal Crossword
bb17-event-41.family: Who Did What?, Sky High Memory
bb17-event-41.description: In Part 2 of the final HOH, players climb a wall and arrange letters to solve a giant crossword about the season. The faster correct puzzle advances to Part 3.

bb17-event-42.name: Scales Of Just Us
bb17-event-42.description: The two finalists predict the endings of jurors' personal statements. Correct answers earn points; the highest score after eight questions wins the final HOH and chooses the last eviction.

bb16-event-01.name: Go Fly a Kite
bb16-event-01.description: Players balance on a rotating log while keeping a kite from falling onto their sandcastle. The last player maintaining both tasks becomes the first HOH.

bb16-event-02.name: Over the Coals
bb16-event-02.description: Players cling to a large rotating barbecue spit. The last remaining contestant becomes the second HOH.

bb16-event-03.name: The Pouring 20s
bb16-event-03.description: Partners swing toward one another to transfer water between cups, then pour it into a vase. The first vase to release a berry wins both nominees safety and dethrones their HOH.

bb16-event-05.name: Miami Lice
bb16-event-05.description: Players search for letter tiles and spell a word. The longest correctly spelled word wins the veto.

bb16-event-06.name: BB Rager
bb16-event-06.description: Players carry six kegs across a balance beam without stepping off. Separate groups each produce an HOH winner; falling or leaving the beam invalidates a run.

bb16-event-07.name: We Did What?!
bb16-event-07.description: Nominee pairs answer questions about party photographs. Correct answers score points and assign distractions to opponents; mistakes benefit the other team. First to four wins both players safety and dethrones their HOH.

bb16-event-08.name: Big Brother Galaxy
bb16-event-08.description: Players balance ten planets on a hanging galaxy without any touching the ground. First correct completion wins the veto.

bb16-event-09.name: Underwater Polo
bb16-event-09.description: Players hit a polo ball down a ramp into numbered slots. The two highest scores become the week's HOHs.

bb16-event-10.name: Abraca-BOB-ra
bb16-event-10.family: Faster Than A Speeding Veto, Abraca-BOB-ra
bb16-event-10.description: One partner retrieves puzzle pieces while the tether lifts the other to an elevated puzzle board. The first complete puzzle wins both nominees safety and dethrones their HOH.

bb16-event-12.name: Tumblin' Dice
bb16-event-12.description: Players roll giant dice by moving inside them, returning to the starting area with the called number facing up. Head-to-head winners advance; the final survivor wins the veto.

bb16-event-13.name: Deviled Eggs
bb16-event-13.description: Partners use their fingertips to pass eggs through chicken wire and collect them at the end. The first pair to finish twelve eggs becomes the two HOHs.

bb16-event-14.name: Knight Moves
bb16-event-14.description: Nominee pairs move around a giant chessboard using knight moves and make visited spaces unavailable. A player with no legal move is eliminated. The last surviving pair earns safety and dethrones its HOH.

bb16-event-15.name: BB Cup
bb16-event-15.description: Players use mechanical legs to kick balls into a numbered goal. Low scorers leave successive rounds and choose or trade rewards. Whoever holds the veto after the final exchange wins it.

bb16-event-16.name: Country Hits
bb16-event-16.description: Players face off to identify whether country songs describe an HOH, Battle of the Block, or veto challenge. First correct advances; incorrect answers eliminate. The final two survivors become HOHs.

bb16-event-17.name: Wedding Cake Take
bb16-event-17.description: Partners build a giant wedding cake and stand together on top for three seconds. The first successful pair wins safety.

bb16-event-18.name: Sheriff Deputy
bb16-event-18.description: Players rock on horses to refill a short timer, then stack gold bars on an inverted horseshoe. Running out of time requires withdrawal or a slop penalty to return. The first finished stack wins the veto.

bb16-event-19.name: Getting Loopy
bb16-event-19.description: Players study looping clips of house events and answer true-or-false questions. Incorrect answers eliminate them; the last two, after any necessary tiebreaker, become HOHs.

bb16-event-20.name: Domino Effect
bb16-event-20.description: Pairs build a domino chain through three punishment checkpoints to press a buzzer. The first successful chain wins both players safety, dethrones their HOH, and imposes the chosen punishments.

bb16-event-21.name: BB Comics
bb16-event-21.description: Players inspect sixteen houseguest comics from a zipline and reproduce the display using the correct versions. The fastest accurate arrangement wins the veto.

bb16-event-22.name: Mathcathalon
bb16-event-22.description: Players judge numerical claims as more, less, or exactly correct. Wrong answers eliminate; the survivor becomes HOH.

bb16-event-23.name: Best of Duck
bb16-event-23.description: Players search a ball pit for three rubber ducks and return them one at a time to their stand. The first completed set and buzzer press wins the veto.

bb16-event-24.name: BB Tourn-eye-ment
bb16-event-24.description: Head-to-head players answer eye-chart clues with one or two. First correct advances; the final two survivors become HOHs.

bb16-event-25.name: Thursday Night Football
bb16-event-25.family: Pull Some Strings, Thursday Night Football
bb16-event-25.description: Partners pull chains to tilt a board and guide a ball into ten designated holes. The first successful team wins safety and dethrones its HOH, with a football-outing reward.

bb16-event-27.name: OTEV the Pissed-Off Penguin
bb16-event-27.description: OTEV gives clues identifying houseguests. Players retrieve the corresponding drink card and race back to an available spot. Wrong answers and last returns eliminate players; the survivor wins the veto.

bb16-event-28.name: Dead of Household
bb16-event-28.description: Players answer questions about overnight zombie alerts. Incorrect answers eliminate contestants; the last two remaining become HOHs.

bb16-event-29.name: The Black Box
bb16-event-29.description: Nominee pairs search a dark room for bones and return them to a scoreboard. The first team to place five wins both players safety and dethrones their HOH.

bb16-event-30.name: Fix Zingbot
bb16-event-30.description: Players connect cables to complete working circuits and restore Zingbot's lights. The first correctly powered set wins the veto.

bb16-event-31.name: Comeback Fight
bb16-event-31.description: Jurors slide discs onto a spinning turntable. Most remaining after seven rounds earns re-entry; closest-to-center resolves a tie.

bb16-event-32.name: Punching for Days
bb16-event-32.description: Players recall the day of a specified house event and enter the number. The last correct response is eliminated each round; the survivor becomes HOH.

bb16-event-33.name: BBB Sting Operation
bb16-event-33.description: Players estimate quantities on themed sets and choose whether to stay or fold. The closest staying estimate earns a ticket and the farthest is eliminated. First to three tickets wins the veto.

bb16-event-34.name: Sloppy the Snowman
bb16-event-34.description: Players carry liquid across a slippery lane to fill a snowman and retrieve its ball. The first main-ball retrieval wins HOH; a smaller target offers cash with a related punishment.

bb16-event-35.name: BB Blast, Inc.
bb16-event-35.description: Players memorize colored-wire sequences and select the wire answering each question. An incorrect choice eliminates them. The last player remaining wins the veto.

bb16-event-36.name: What The Bleep?
bb16-event-36.description: Players judge whether a suggested word matches censored speech in a houseguest clip. Incorrect answers eliminate contestants; the last player remaining wins HOH.

bb16-event-37.name: Mazed And Confused
bb16-event-37.description: Players guide a ball through three crop-circle mazes. First to reach the final sensor wins the veto.

bb16-event-38.name: Seed-Saw
bb16-event-38.description: Players carry seed balls across a giant shovel-shaped seesaw, balancing them on its spade. A fall or dropped seed requires restarting. First to complete the transfer wins HOH; this original result was later rewound.

bb16-event-39.name: BB Freakshow
bb16-event-39.description: Players identify the three houseguests blended into each face-morph image. The fastest correct set wins the veto. This is the original competition whose week was later rewound.

bb16-event-40.name: Seed-Saw: Rewind
bb16-event-40.description: After the rewind, players repeat the seed-transfer seesaw challenge. They balance all seeds on the shovel and return to the buzzer without dropping them. The first successful run wins the replacement HOH.

bb16-event-41.name: Jury Fury
bb16-event-41.description: Jurors search the house for knockout pucks and use them to eliminate opponents. The surviving juror wins cash, as does the current houseguest who backed that juror.

bb16-event-42.name: BB Freakshow: Rewind
bb16-event-42.description: The veto is replayed after the rewind using a new set of blended houseguest faces. Players identify each face's components against the time to beat. The fastest correct set wins the replacement veto.

bb16-event-43.name: Foggy Memory
bb16-event-43.description: Players judge whether one house event happened before or after another. Correct answers score points; the highest total or numerical tiebreaker wins HOH.

bb16-event-44.name: Stalking the Veto
bb16-event-44.description: Players match houseguest photos to fourteen connected crime-board clues. The first completely correct board wins the final veto.

bb16-event-45.name: Fly High or Bye Bye
bb16-event-45.description: In Part 1 of the final HOH, players hold onto hang gliders while standing on narrow ledges. The last player remaining advances directly to Part 3.

bb16-event-46.name: Ancient BBgypt
bb16-event-46.description: In Part 2 of the final HOH, players climb a pyramid wall and arrange the final nominee pair for each eviction. The faster correct board advances to Part 3.

bb16-event-47.name: Scales Of Just Us
bb16-event-47.description: The two finalists predict how jurors completed personal statements about the season. Correct responses score points, with a numerical tiebreaker if needed. The winner becomes final HOH.

bb15-event-01.name: Popsicle Factory
bb15-event-01.description: Hold onto a giant suspended popsicle while enduring sprays of water. Falling ends a player's attempt; the last person holding on wins HOH.

bb15-event-02.name: Cooler and The Gang
bb15-event-02.description: Teams retrieve cans across the water and build a pyramid on a platform supported by teammates. A collapsed pyramid must be rebuilt. The last team to finish becomes Have-Nots.

bb15-event-03.name: The American Baking Competition
bb15-event-03.description: Retrieve hidden letters from blueberries in batter and build the longest correctly spelled word within 15 minutes to win veto.

bb15-event-04.name: Big Brother BBQ
bb15-event-04.description: Pairs carry barbecue sauce along slippery lanes, passing it between partners to fill a container and release a ball. The first pair to finish chooses which partner becomes HOH.

bb15-event-05.name: In The Balance
bb15-event-05.description: Balance all 10 stuffed animals on a suspended baby mobile without any touching the ground. First finished wins veto.

bb15-event-06.name: Overnight Delivery
bb15-event-06.description: Answer true-or-false questions about deliveries displayed in the backyard overnight. Wrong answers eliminate players; the last remaining player wins HOH, with numerical tiebreakers if needed.

bb15-event-07.name: Scary Dairy
bb15-event-07.description: Pass sour milk between teammates using buckets and fill a milk jug. The first two teams to finish avoid Have-Not restrictions; the last team becomes Have-Nots.

bb15-event-08.name: Keeping Up with the Joneses
bb15-event-08.description: Bounce on a trampoline to glimpse an art collection over a wall, then recreate its arrangement on your own wall. The fastest correct reproduction wins veto.

bb15-event-09.name: Big Brother Royalty
bb15-event-09.description: Predict which houseguest viewers selected for each royal-themed description in an online poll. Incorrect answers eliminate players; the last remaining player wins HOH.

bb15-event-10.name: Funky Froyo
bb15-event-10.description: Teams are weighed, eat frozen yogurt, and are weighed again. The team with the smallest total weight gain becomes the week's Have-Nots.

bb15-event-11.name: Big Brother Election
bb15-event-11.description: Search mud for envelopes containing vote points. Some high-value offers require accepting punishments. The largest final point total wins veto; a separate cash reward is also available.

bb15-event-12.name: Roulette Me Win
bb15-event-12.description: Roll a ball down a sloping lane onto a spinning roulette target. The highest-numbered landing wins HOH.

bb15-event-13.name: Unexpectedly Unforgettable
bb15-event-13.description: Memorize the arrangement of evidence on a desk, then reconstruct it from memory. The last team to restore its display correctly becomes Have-Nots.

bb15-event-14.name: Back In Time
bb15-event-14.description: Assemble a three-dimensional dinosaur egg from puzzle pieces. The first player to complete the egg correctly wins veto.

bb15-event-15.name: Bull in a China Shop
bb15-event-15.description: Stay upright on a rotating log while holding a rope attached to a bull prop. Falling sends the bull into a china cabinet and eliminates the player. Last remaining wins HOH.

bb15-event-16.name: Frog Darts
bb15-event-16.description: Toss frogs onto numbered lily pads. Each round's lowest scorer is eliminated and opens a reward that may be traded for an earlier reward. Whoever holds the veto after all swaps receives it, not necessarily the final toss winner.

bb15-event-17.name: Summer School
bb15-event-17.description: Decide whether the true quantity in each season-related question is more or less than the number given. Incorrect answers eliminate players; the survivor wins HOH.

bb15-event-18.name: Nailed It
bb15-event-18.description: Match differently sized nails to the slots that fit them. The first player to complete the arrangement wins veto.

bb15-event-19.name: Cherry On Top
bb15-event-19.description: In head-to-head rounds, roll a ball along a curved banana track and land it on the sundae. Each successful player advances through the bracket; the final winner becomes HOH.

bb15-event-20.name: BB 'B' Movie
bb15-event-20.description: Estimate quantities in movie-set displays, then stay or fold. Among those staying, the closest guess earns a ticket and the farthest is eliminated; folding avoids that round's risk. Three tickets or being the last player remaining wins veto.

bb15-event-21.name: Way Off Broadway
bb15-event-21.description: In head-to-head rounds, identify whether a song describes an HOH, veto, or Have-Not competition. Survive elimination to win HOH.

bb15-event-22.name: The Black Box
bb15-event-22.description: Teams navigate a dark enclosure with crawl spaces and obstacles, find a key, escape, and stop their timer. The slowest team becomes Have-Nots.

bb15-event-23.name: OTEV the Brokenhearted Beaver
bb15-event-23.description: Listen to OTEV's clue about an evicted houseguest, find the corresponding love letter, and return up the ramp to an available spot. The last player back each round is eliminated; the final survivor wins veto.

bb15-event-24.name: Off The Wall
bb15-event-24.description: Balance on the wall while catching incoming balls. The first eligible player to collect 10 balls, or the last standing, wins HOH. Jurors simultaneously compete for re-entry in this same physical event.

bb15-event-25.name: Off The Wall
bb15-event-25.description: This is the re-entry result of the same wall competition, not an additional challenge. The first juror to catch 10 balls or the last juror standing returns to the house; jurors may also compete for HOH.

bb15-event-26.name: Happy Zing Day
bb15-event-26.description: Send a ball over the ramp and catch it repeatedly. Reach 250 successful passes to win veto; dropping it resets progress.

bb15-event-27.name: Big Hopportunity
bb15-event-27.description: Use your fingers through chicken wire to maneuver eggs along the HOH-shaped maze. Carry each freed egg back by hopping to the basket. First to collect a dozen and ring in wins HOH.

bb15-event-28.name: 10K
bb15-event-28.description: Pop balloons throughout the house to find tokens marked 1, 0, and K. The first person to collect all three wins $10,000; the prize does not grant HOH or veto.

bb15-event-29.name: Bowlerina
bb15-event-29.description: Spin to lower a barrier, then bowl before it rises again. In each head-to-head match, knock down all four pins before the opponent; continue through elimination rounds to win veto.

bb15-event-30.name: Go Fetch!
bb15-event-30.description: Retrieve two buried bones, one at a time, through the doghouse, then fetch a key and buzz in first for HOH.

bb15-event-31.name: The BB500
bb15-event-31.description: Guide a toy car through the maze to its finish. The first player to complete the course wins veto.

bb15-event-32.name: Pixel This!
bb15-event-32.description: Identify competitions as pixelated pictures clear, then assemble their winners' faces. Each round's slowest player is eliminated; the survivor wins HOH.

bb15-event-33.name: Friendly Neighborhood Veto
bb15-event-33.description: Assemble a magnetic puzzle while flying back to reset its timer. Letting time expire drops the pieces; first finished wins veto.

bb15-event-34.name: Before or After
bb15-event-34.description: Answer whether one house event occurred before or after another. Correct responses earn points; the highest score after the questions and any necessary tiebreaker wins HOH.

bb15-event-35.name: Web of Flies
bb15-event-35.description: Match houseguest photographs to the spiderweb's 14 clues. The first correct arrangement wins veto.

bb15-event-36.name: The Greatest Skate
bb15-event-36.description: Skate around the course while holding a moving rope. Last remaining advances directly to final HOH Part 3.

bb15-event-37.name: Under The Sea
bb15-event-37.description: Find houseguest objects and arrange them in eviction order. The faster correct finish advances to final HOH Part 3.

bb15-event-38.name: Tip The Scale
bb15-event-38.description: The two finalists choose between possible endings to jurors' personal statements. Correct predictions earn points. The higher score wins the final HOH and the right to choose the other finalist.

bb14-event-01.name: Teddy Bear Madness
bb14-event-01.description: Teams cross moving mattresses to retrieve three teddy bears and switch off their night-light. The winning team's coach chooses the first HOH; the last-place team's coach must evict one of their own players.

bb14-event-03.name: Big Brother Derby
bb14-event-03.description: Coaches race to pull an opponent's horse tail. Win the final heat to grant one coached player immunity.

bb14-event-04.name: Loose Change
bb14-event-04.description: Search through soap suds for coins and toss them into a vending-machine slot. The first player to deposit exactly $1.30 wins veto.

bb14-event-05.name: Big Brother Break-In
bb14-event-05.description: Recall a burglar's actions in videos shown overnight. Answer guilty or not guilty to each accusation; wrong answers eliminate players. The last remaining player wins HOH.

bb14-event-06.name: Phat Stacks
bb14-event-06.description: Carry stacks of cash, one at a time, across a balance beam and pile them on a pedestal. Touching the ground or dropping cash eliminates a coach. First finished and buzzed in wins, with a choice of protecting a player or trading one.

bb14-event-07.name: Memory Chip
bb14-event-07.description: Retrieve menu tiles hidden in food-filled pools and recreate the reference menu's order. Lock in the arrangement and time; the most correct items wins veto, with speed breaking a tie.

bb14-event-08.name: On Thin Ice
bb14-event-08.description: Take one shot at numbered slots on an ice-themed lane. A miss scores zero; the highest landing score wins HOH.

bb14-event-09.name: Feel The Burn
bb14-event-09.description: Coaches perform as many exercise repetitions as possible at successive timed stations. The lowest count each round is eliminated and opens a prize locker. The surviving coach wins and chooses a coached player to keep safe.

bb14-event-10.name: The Juggler
bb14-event-10.description: Keep two balls moving on separate ramps at the same time. Dropping either ball eliminates the player; the last person still juggling both wins veto.

bb14-event-11.name: Walk The Plank
bb14-event-11.description: Balance on a narrow plank and hold the wall's bar as the apparatus moves. Falling into the water eliminates a player; the last remaining wins HOH.

bb14-event-12.name: Field of Veto
bb14-event-12.description: Launch a ball at a numbered baseball-diamond target. Each round's lowest scorer leaves and selects a reward, with later players able to exchange rewards. The final holder of the veto receives it.

bb14-event-13.name: Big Brother Battle of the Bands
bb14-event-13.description: Identify song clues as HOH, veto, or coaches competitions in head-to-head elimination rounds. The survivor wins HOH.

bb14-event-14.name: Ex-Squeeze Me?
bb14-event-14.description: Teams use absorbent lemon or lime costumes to collect liquid, then squeeze it into containers with teammates' help. Fill the team's container first to avoid Have-Not restrictions.

bb14-event-15.name: Son of Zingbot
bb14-event-15.description: Build a pipeline through six gates and guide an orb through it. First to power Baby Zingbot wins veto.

bb14-event-16.name: Swamped
bb14-event-16.description: Carry liquid in a small cup across a slippery lane to fill a jug and release its cork. The main jug awards HOH; separate smaller jugs offer safety or $10,000.

bb14-event-17.name: Candy Counter
bb14-event-17.description: Estimate quantities in candy displays, then stay or fold. The closest staying guess earns a point; the farthest staying guess is eliminated. Folding avoids both. First to three points wins veto.

bb14-event-18.name: Before or After
bb14-event-18.description: Decide whether one season event occurred before or after another. Wrong answers eliminate players; the last remaining player wins HOH, using a numerical tiebreaker if needed.

bb14-event-19.name: Somewhere Over The Veto
bb14-event-19.description: Retrieve two hidden clovers separately, then the veto sign, and buzz in first to win veto.

bb14-event-20.name: Pull Some Strings
bb14-event-20.description: Use strings to steer a ball up a board. After seeding, win head-to-head target races for HOH.

bb14-event-21.name: Pandora's Crane Game
bb14-event-21.description: Search falling plastic balls for quarters, then use the arcade crane to retrieve a golden veto ball. This awards an additional veto. Its winner gives up participation in the regular veto competition that week.

bb14-event-22.name: Draw Something
bb14-event-22.family: How Bad Do You Want It?
bb14-event-22.description: Identify pictured words and accept associated punishments to earn points. Highest eligible total wins veto; helping another player disqualifies you.
families: How Bad Do You Want It?

bb14-event-23.name: Soak Up the Sun
bb14-event-23.description: Stand on a small suspended disc while holding its rope as the apparatus circles. Falling eliminates the player; the last person remaining wins HOH.

bb14-event-24.name: OTEV the Absent Minded Alien
bb14-event-24.description: Solve OTEV's houseguest riddle, find the corn cob labeled with that person's name, and return up the ramp to an open sack. Each round's last correct return is eliminated. The survivor wins veto.

bb14-event-25.name: Make Your Case
bb14-event-25.description: Identify speakers from their eviction pleas. Correct answers score points; the highest total wins HOH.

bb14-event-26.name: Swimming With Sharks
bb14-event-26.description: Guide a shark fin through a maze, carry it back, and buzz in first for veto.

bb14-event-27.name: Memory Lane
bb14-event-27.family: Cover Your Days, Roll It Down
bb14-event-27.description: Roll balls onto event dates. Each day's error incurs a penalty; the lowest total wins HOH.

bb14-event-28.name: Time Flies
bb14-event-28.description: Fly between a magnetic puzzle and a button that resets its 20-second timer. If time expires, the pieces fall. Complete the puzzle and return to the button first to win veto and a luxury outing.

bb14-event-29.name: Photographic Memory
bb14-event-29.description: Answer true-or-false questions about competition photographs studied earlier. Each correct answer scores one point; the highest total after seven questions and any necessary tiebreaker wins HOH.

bb14-event-30.name: Atomic Veto
bb14-event-30.description: Place houseguest faces into a molecule-shaped puzzle so they satisfy the connected clues. The first fully correct solution wins the season's last veto.

bb14-event-31.name: Hook, Line and Sinker
bb14-event-31.description: Hold a suspended fishing line while being moved around and dunked. The last person holding on wins Part 1 and advances to final HOH Part 3.

bb14-event-32.name: Climb Time
bb14-event-32.description: Climb and clean windows to reveal evictees, then arrange them chronologically. Fastest finish advances to Part 3.

bb14-event-33.name: Jury Statements
bb14-event-33.description: Choose the correct ending to each juror's personal statement from two possibilities. Each correct prediction earns a point; the higher score wins final HOH and chooses the other finalist.

bb13-event-01.name: Going Banana's
bb13-event-01.description: Hold onto a giant hanging banana while being sprayed with chocolate and whipped cream. The last person holding on wins HOH, with their partner also safe under the duos rules.

bb13-event-02.name: Cows On The Moon
bb13-event-02.description: Teams soak up milk in absorbent cow costumes, then have teammates squeeze it into jugs. The first two teams to fill six jugs avoid Have-Not restrictions; the losing team becomes Have-Nots.

bb13-event-03.name: Faster Than A Speeding Veto
