bb13-event-03.description: One partner operates a pulley to raise the other, who works on a suspended puzzle. The first duo to finish wins the shared veto, which can remove a nominated pair together.

bb13-event-04.name: Big Brother Open
bb13-event-04.description: Take one golf putt toward the hole-in-one target. The player whose ball finishes closest to the target wins HOH and safety for their partner.

bb13-event-05.name: March Of The Ants
bb13-event-05.description: Two partners share an ant costume and crawl through a picnic obstacle course, delivering food pieces to their ant hole. The first duo to finish chooses two duos to become Have-Nots.

bb13-event-06.name: Big Brother Candystore
bb13-event-06.description: Chew gum, cross a balance beam, and use the gum to fill in a veto-shaped outline. First to complete the symbol wins veto; under that week's rules, using it removes a nominated duo together.

bb13-event-07.name: Big Brother Online
bb13-event-07.description: Predict viewers' responses to online questions about the houseguests. Wrong answers eliminate players; the last person remaining wins HOH.

bb13-event-08.name: Same Name
bb13-event-08.description: Interpret successive clues to identify a mystery celebrity. The winning guess earns a preview screening of Same Name with selected fellow houseguests; David Hasselhoff is the celebrity revealed.

bb13-event-09.name: Hot Legs
bb13-event-09.description: Pluck letter-bearing hairs from a giant model leg and use the letters to form one word. The longest correctly spelled word wins veto.

bb13-event-10.name: Big Brother Slalom
bb13-event-10.description: Stand on moving skis and hold the poles as the skiing apparatus shifts. Falling eliminates the player; the last remaining skier wins HOH.

bb13-event-11.name: Time's Up
bb13-event-11.description: Bid completion times for recreated challenges. The fastest bidder must succeed or leave; success instead eliminates the slowest bidder. Last remaining wins veto.

bb13-event-12.name: Check Mate
bb13-event-12.description: Face an opponent and identify an evicted houseguest from a clue. A correct first answer advances and lets the winner select the next matchup; a wrong answer eliminates the responder. Last remaining wins HOH.

bb13-event-13.name: Call Your Own Shots
bb13-event-13.description: Teams mix drinks from selected ingredients, then challenge opponents to identify an ingredient. Correct identification earns points, with drinking speed settling ties. The losing team becomes Have-Nots.

bb13-event-14.name: Big Brother Odyssey
bb13-event-14.description: Roll a ball over a two-sided ramp, run around, and catch it repeatedly. Each successful crossing scores; dropping the ball resets the count. First to 300 wins veto.

bb13-event-15.name: That's How We Roll
bb13-event-15.description: Collect balls bearing the 14 original houseguests' names and roll one of each into the target. The most complete set within three minutes wins re-entry; completing all 14 sooner locks in the winning time.

bb13-event-16.name: Count on America
bb13-event-16.description: Estimate quantities in hometown-themed displays. Each round's farthest guess is eliminated; the final survivor wins HOH.

bb13-event-17.name: Big Brother Cornhole
bb13-event-17.description: Toss beanbags at a spinning corn target. Highest score each round leaves and selects or swaps a reward; the final veto holder wins it.

bb13-event-18.name: All Washed Up
bb13-event-18.description: Carry liquid detergent in a small cup along a slippery lane and pour it into a container. Fill it enough to remove the floating ball before anyone else to win HOH.

bb13-event-19.name: Bride of Zingbot
bb13-event-19.description: Fit puzzle panels onto all four sides of a robot frame, then attach its arms and head. First correct assembly wins veto.

bb13-event-20.name: Before or After
bb13-event-20.description: Decide whether one event preceded another. Incorrect answers eliminate players; the last remaining wins HOH.

bb13-event-21.name: Clowning Around
bb13-event-21.description: Find two yellow clown shoes in a ball pit, return them, retrieve the veto symbol, and buzz in first.

bb13-event-22.name: Snake Eyes
bb13-event-22.description: Roll a ball along a winding snake toward its eye. Seeding determines head-to-head matches; win the final match for HOH.

bb13-event-23.name: Duo Do Over
bb13-event-23.description: Cling to a hanging dummy bearing a former partner's face. Last remaining wins veto, usable on both members of a nominated duo.

bb13-event-24.name: Rollin' in the Dough
bb13-event-24.description: Carry doughnuts through a bakery obstacle course. The most delivered within 13 minutes wins HOH.

bb13-event-25.name: OTEV the Sweet-Toothed Shark
bb13-event-25.description: Solve OTEV's houseguest clues and retrieve matching pies. Each round's last correct return leaves; the survivor wins veto.

bb13-event-26.name: Big Brother Fortune Teller
bb13-event-26.description: Recall overnight fortune-teller messages. The most correct answers to six questions wins HOH.

bb13-event-27.name: Big Brother Jukebox
bb13-event-27.description: Arrange houseguest-name blocks to satisfy clues on both sides of a jukebox puzzle. First correct solution wins veto.

bb13-event-28.name: Big Brother Mixer
bb13-event-28.description: Remain on a moving mixer blade longer than the other finalists to advance directly to final HOH Part 3.

bb13-event-29.name: Underwater Maze
bb13-event-29.description: Move 11 HOH portraits into chronological order through an underwater maze. Fastest completion advances to Part 3.

bb13-event-30.name: Jury Statements
bb13-event-30.description: Choose which of two endings matches each juror's personal statement. Correct predictions earn points. The higher score wins final HOH and decides which other houseguest reaches the final two.

bb12-event-01.name: Hot Dog! We Have a Weiner
bb12-event-01.family: Hot Dog! We Have a Weiner
bb12-event-01.description: Teams use pulleys to carry members across the yard on a giant hot dog. The first team to get everyone across wins. Earlier finishers receive cash prizes; its final rider becomes HOH.
families: Hot Dog! We Have a Weiner

bb12-event-02.name: Sweet Tooth
bb12-event-02.description: Teams crawl through caramel to search a popcorn pit for plastic teeth. The first two teams to collect eight teeth avoid Have-Not restrictions; the remaining team becomes Have-Nots.

bb12-event-03.name: Cinco de Mayo(nnaise)
bb12-event-03.description: Break mayonnaise-filled pinatas to find letter tiles and use them to form a word. The longest correctly spelled word wins veto.

bb12-event-04.name: Majority Rules
bb12-event-04.description: Predict how most players will answer questions about the houseguests. Players in the minority are eliminated; a tied vote eliminates nobody. The survivor, or tiebreaker winner, becomes HOH.

bb12-event-05.name: BB Stick ‘Em Up
bb12-event-05.description: Tape a teammate to a wall, then spray opposing teams' players with water to loosen their tape. The team whose player remains attached longest chooses a team to become Have-Nots.

bb12-event-06.name: Big Brother Stockades
bb12-event-06.description: Remain in stocks holding a briefcase while estimating elapsed time. Drop the briefcase to lock in a finish. The time closest to one hour without exceeding it wins veto.

bb12-event-07.name: Hang Ten
bb12-event-07.description: Stay on a moving surfboard as it shifts in and out of the wall. The last remaining player wins HOH. Early eliminations become Haves; later eliminations, excluding the winner, become Have-Nots.

bb12-event-08.name: Veto of Fortune
bb12-event-08.description: Estimate quantities in large displays and choose to stay or fold. The closest staying guess earns a point, while the farthest is eliminated. Folding avoids both outcomes. First to three points wins veto.

bb12-event-09.name: BB Knockouts
bb12-event-09.description: Identify competition clues as HOH, Have-Not, or veto in head-to-head matches. Winners choose subsequent opponents; the last remaining player wins HOH.

bb12-event-10.name: Big Brother Cop Course
bb12-event-10.description: Teams maneuver a plastic police car through an obstacle course against the clock. The fastest team wins a screening of The Other Guys with the HOH.

bb12-event-11.name: The Wizards of Pinball
bb12-event-11.description: Shoot a pinball toward the center of a numbered target. The least accurate player each round leaves and selects a reward, which later players can swap for. The final veto holder receives the power.

bb12-event-12.name: True Colors
bb12-event-12.description: Stand on a narrow ledge around a giant paint can while holding its rail. The last player remaining wins HOH; the first to drop becomes the week's Have-Not.

bb12-event-13.name: Lover's Lane
bb12-event-13.description: Bowl for 45 seconds, then choose an opponent to try to beat that pin total. The loser is eliminated. Continue through challenges until one player remains and wins veto.

bb12-event-14.name: Oh What A Tangled Web
bb12-event-14.description: Move through a giant web to free the length of rope attached to you. The first person to untangle the rope completely and finish wins HOH and chooses three Have-Nots.

bb12-event-15.name: Ready Set Zing!
bb12-event-15.description: Carry pieces individually across a balance beam to assemble four puzzles spelling VETO. Falling eliminates a player; first complete set wins veto.

bb12-event-16.name: Big Brother Says
bb12-event-16.description: Recall the previous day's Big Brother Says instructions and actions. Answer true or false; a wrong answer eliminates the player. The last remaining contestant wins HOH.

bb12-event-17.name: The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly
bb12-event-17.family: The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly
bb12-event-17.description: Each opposing trio drinks three shots, including one unpleasant drink. Guess which player received the bad drink to earn points. The losing team becomes Have-Nots.
families: The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly

bb12-event-18.name: Big Brother Zoo
bb12-event-18.description: Start with veto points and respond to offers: accepting punishments adds points, while taking prizes costs points. The largest remaining total wins veto.

bb12-event-19.name: Delivering the Goods
bb12-event-19.family: How Bad Do You Want It?
bb12-event-19.description: Answer a clue by finding two houseguest names hidden in packing peanuts, returning one at a time. The first correct pair locked in wins HOH; locking in a wrong answer eliminates the player.
families: How Bad Do You Want It?

bb12-event-20.name: Before or After
bb12-event-20.description: Use a staircase to answer whether one season event happened before or after another. Wrong answers eliminate players; the last remaining wins veto.

bb12-event-21.name: Big Brother Blackjack
bb12-event-21.description: Within five shots, land balls on two cards totaling 21. The least successful player leaves each round; the survivor wins HOH.

bb12-event-22.name: OTEV the Broadway Clam
bb12-event-22.description: OTEV sings clues about pairs of evicted houseguests. Find the CD whose combined-name title matches the pair and return to a place on the ramp. The last correct return each round leaves; the survivor wins veto.

bb12-event-23.name: Big Brother Christmas
bb12-event-23.description: Work Christmas ornaments through a wire fence with your fingers and place them into the tree's holders. After placing every ornament, move the star to the top and buzz in first to win HOH.

bb12-event-24.name: Hide And Seek
bb12-event-24.description: Hide an individual coin somewhere in the house during a 90-second turn. Everyone then searches for the coins. The owner of the last coin found wins $10,000.

bb12-event-25.name: Big Brother Marquee
bb12-event-25.description: Arrange movie posters so both pictured houseguests match the clues above and below each slot. First correct board wins veto.

bb12-event-26.name: Rumble in the Big Brother Jungle
bb12-event-26.description: Remain on a suspended swing as it repeatedly strikes padded walls. The last finalist holding on wins Part 1 and advances directly to final HOH Part 3.

bb12-event-27.name: It's Alive
bb12-event-27.description: Identify both houseguests in each of five merged faces within two minutes. Most correct wins, with speed breaking ties, and advances to Part 3.

bb12-event-28.name: Jury Statements
bb12-event-28.description: Select the correct ending to statements made by the six jurors. Correct predictions earn points; the higher score, or numerical tiebreaker winner, becomes final HOH and selects the other finalist.

bb11-event-01.name: The Wedgie
bb11-event-01.description: Players hang from oversized underwear while gripping toilet seats. The last surviving clique earns entry for its assigned returning player, who becomes HOH. That returning player and the clique receive safety; the endurance survivor does not personally become HOH.

bb11-event-02.name: Big Brother Rave
bb11-event-02.description: Connect pipes to spell HAVE and channel glowing liquid onto a wheel. The last clique to complete a working pipeline becomes Have-Nots.

bb11-event-03.name: Pop Goes the Veto
bb11-event-03.description: Pop pimples on a giant face to find letter tiles. Use the collected tiles to spell a word; the longest correctly spelled word wins veto.

bb11-event-04.name: Most Likely To…
bb11-event-04.description: Guess which clique viewers selected for each scenario. A correct response lets the player eliminate someone else; an incorrect response eliminates that player. The final survivor wins HOH.

bb11-event-05.name: The Ugly Truth
bb11-event-05.description: Predict answers given by members of the opposite sex. The winning man and woman earn a screening of The Ugly Truth and jointly choose a clique to become Have-Nots.

bb11-event-06.name: The Ugly Truth
bb11-event-06.description: This records the Have-Not consequence of the same Ugly Truth luxury challenge, not a second competition. Its male and female winners choose which clique receives the week's Have-Not restrictions.

bb11-event-07.name: The Big Brother Mint
bb11-event-07.description: Gather coins to match an announced dollar amount within the round's time limit. The player whose collected value is farthest from the target is eliminated; the last remaining wins veto.

bb11-event-08.name: Buzzworthy
bb11-event-08.description: Launch a ball toward a honeycomb-shaped arrangement of buckets. The landing closest to the central target wins HOH.

bb11-event-09.name: Backyard Bash
bb11-event-09.description: A representative from each clique tries to load opposing teams' cans with plastic ice cubes. The clique whose can contains the most cubes loses and becomes Have-Nots.

bb11-event-10.name: When Pigs Fly
bb11-event-10.description: Search mud for truffles carrying point values and select four to keep. Add the chosen values; the highest total wins veto. Some choices also carry prizes or punishments.

bb11-event-11.name: Big Brother Graduation
bb11-event-11.description: Balance on a suspended graduation-cap platform while the apparatus spins and a padded diploma strikes the players. Falling eliminates a player; the last remaining wins HOH.

bb11-event-12.name: Vini Vidi Veto
bb11-event-12.description: Estimate quantities in displays and decide whether to stay or fold. The closest staying answer earns a point and the farthest is eliminated. Folding avoids elimination but earns nothing; accumulate the required points or outlast the field to win veto.

bb11-event-13.name: Say What
bb11-event-13.description: Answer true-or-false questions about viewer messages played overnight. Incorrect answers eliminate contestants; the last remaining player wins HOH.

bb11-event-14.name: The Goods
bb11-event-14.description: Pack a station wagon with items carrying different point values. Only items successfully fitted inside count. The higher-scoring team wins a screening of The Goods; the losing side receives Have-Not restrictions.

bb11-event-15.name: The Goods
bb11-event-15.description: This is the Have-Not outcome of the same Goods car-packing challenge, not a separate physical event. The team with fewer points from the items packed into its wagon becomes Have-Nots.

bb11-event-16.name: BB Farms
bb11-event-16.description: Move eggs through wire fencing with your fingers, then carry them across the bacon-shaped course. First to deliver 12 eggs wins veto.

bb11-event-17.name: Hit the Road
bb11-event-17.description: In head-to-head rounds, identify whether a clue refers to an HOH, Have-Not, or veto competition. A correct first answer advances and selects the next matchup; a wrong answer eliminates the responder. Last remaining wins HOH.

bb11-event-18.name: HOH Invitational Golf Tournament
bb11-event-18.description: Putt at a windmill target. Each round's highest score leaves and selects or swaps a reward. The final holder of the HOH key becomes HOH.

bb11-event-19.name: Before or After
bb11-event-19.description: Decide whether one house event happened before or after another. Incorrect answers eliminate contestants; the remaining player, or tiebreaker winner, receives veto.

bb11-event-20.name: Can Do
bb11-event-20.description: Drop soda cans from an elevated platform into a narrow tube. First to stack 24 cans wins HOH; if time expires, the largest stack wins. The two lowest totals receive Have-Not restrictions.

bb11-event-21.name: Let's Get Bananas
bb11-event-21.description: Solve OTEV's rapped houseguest clues and retrieve the corresponding named bananas. Each round's last correct return is eliminated; the survivor wins veto.

bb11-event-22.name: The S'More the Merrier
bb11-event-22.description: Carry hot chocolate in a mug back and forth along a slippery graham-cracker lane. Fill the far container until its floating marshmallow can be removed; first to do so wins HOH.

bb11-event-23.name: Blast Off
bb11-event-23.description: Identify the two houseguests blended into each alien face. Fastest correct completion of all six images wins veto and an entertainment-system prize.

bb11-event-24.name: Fact or Fiction
bb11-event-24.description: Classify seven statements as fact or fiction. Correct answers earn points; the highest score, or tiebreaker winner, becomes HOH.

bb11-event-25.name: Veto Block Party
bb11-event-25.description: Stack houseguest-name blocks so each row satisfies the clues on both sides. First to complete the correct arrangement wins the final veto and the resulting power over the final-four eviction.

bb11-event-26.name: Log Jam
bb11-event-26.description: Stay on a rotating log while gripping a suspended key. Letting go or falling eliminates the player; the last remaining advances directly to final HOH Part 3.

bb11-event-27.name: Heads Will Roll
bb11-event-27.description: Roll balls labeled with HOH names into numbered holes to recreate the season's HOH order. The most correct placements within two minutes wins Part 2 and advances to Part 3.

bb11-event-28.name: Jury Statements
bb11-event-28.description: Choose between two possible endings to jurors' statements. Correct predictions earn points; the higher score, or tiebreaker winner, becomes final HOH and chooses the other finalist.

bb10-event-01.name: Houseguests First Impression Votes
bb10-event-01.description: Before entering the house or speaking with one another, houseguests cast secret votes based solely on first impressions. The player receiving the most votes becomes the first HOH; this is a vote, not a physical challenge.

bb10-event-02.name: Buggin' Out
bb10-event-02.description: Teams pull suspended cars back and forth across the yard, leaving one teammate behind at each end. The first team to finish wins food, while its last rider wins a car. The losing team eats slop.

bb10-event-03.name: Sweet Dreams, Honey
bb10-event-03.description: Crawl through honey and search among pillows for stuffed bears. The first player to find and retrieve five bears wins veto.

bb10-event-04.name: Majority Rules
bb10-event-04.description: Predict which of two houseguests the majority will choose for each scenario. Players answering with the minority are eliminated; tied votes eliminate nobody. The last remaining player or tiebreaker winner becomes HOH.

bb10-event-05.name: Stop Your Wining!
bb10-event-05.description: Teams collect wine flowing from overhead barrels and transfer it into bottles. The team with more wine at the finish earns food; the losing team is placed on slop.

bb10-event-06.name: License to Veto
bb10-event-06.description: Decode license plates into Big Brother phrases. Correct answers earn points; wrong answers eliminate players. Highest remaining score after nine rounds, or the sole survivor, wins veto.

bb10-event-07.name: Alien Abduction
bb10-event-07.description: Face off in pairs to identify which room a missing household object came from, or whether it was not missing. Correct first answers advance and select the next matchup; wrong answers eliminate. The survivor wins HOH.

bb10-event-08.name: BB Valley High Sock Hop
bb10-event-08.description: Partners on opposite sides of a wall describe socks and find matching pairs. Place each pair on the board to earn the food associated with that space for the house.

bb10-event-09.name: The Garden of Veto
bb10-event-09.description: Lie in a flower bed while being watered and estimate the passage of one hour. Leave to lock in your time. The closest finish without exceeding one hour wins veto.

bb10-event-10.name: Livin' On the Edge
bb10-event-10.description: Stand on the narrow ledge of a tilting building facade and hold its bar. Falling ends a player's attempt; the last remaining wins HOH.

bb10-event-11.name: Big Brother Slapshot
bb10-event-11.description: Shoot toward the net's center. Each round's farthest shot is eliminated and earns a swappable reward. Whoever holds the veto after all exchanges receives it.

bb10-event-12.name: Rude Awakening
bb10-event-12.description: Recall viewer wake-up messages played during the night and answer true-or-false questions about them. Wrong answers eliminate players; the last remaining wins HOH.

bb10-event-13.name: In the News
bb10-event-13.description: Returning houseguests present purported outside-world news. Decide which stories are true. Correct guesses earn food for designated days; incorrect guesses leave the house on slop for those days.

bb10-event-14.name: Cry Me a Veto
bb10-event-14.description: Chop onions and transport them to either a veto bin or a mystery-prize bin. The heaviest veto bin wins the power; the two heaviest mystery bins earn their associated rewards or punishments.

bb10-event-15.name: Diary Room Confession
bb10-event-15.description: Identify which evicted houseguest made each Diary Room remark. A correct first answer lets the responder eliminate another player; an incorrect answer eliminates the responder. Last remaining wins HOH.

bb10-event-16.name: Big Brother Rock, Paper, Scissors
bb10-event-16.description: Play a food-themed version of rock-paper-scissors using slop, pig ears, and crickets. A round winner must eat the corresponding food to score for the team. The losing team receives the slop diet.

bb10-event-17.name: Haunted Yard
bb10-event-17.description: Estimate quantities in spooky displays, then stay or fold. The closest staying guess earns a point and the farthest is eliminated; folding avoids both. Three points or surviving the field wins veto.

bb10-event-18.name: King of the Jungle
bb10-event-18.description: Cling to a jungle-vine rope swing as it moves and strikes padded scenery. The last houseguest holding on wins HOH.

bb10-event-19.name: One Giant Leap
bb10-event-19.description: Travel on a harness across the course to collect pieces and assemble a flag puzzle. Winners of the opening heats face each other in a final race; the final winner receives veto.

bb10-event-20.name: Big Brother Headlines
bb10-event-20.description: Predict which houseguest viewers chose for each imaginary future headline. Correct predictions score points; the highest score after seven questions and any tiebreakers wins HOH.

bb10-event-21.name: Veto In a Haystack
bb10-event-21.description: Search haystacks for two veto medallions and return them one at a time. The first player to deliver both wins veto.

bb10-event-22.name: Days Go Bye
bb10-event-22.description: Roll a ball into the date an event occurred. Each day's error adds a penalty; the lowest total wins HOH.

bb10-event-23.name: Rock A Bye Veto
bb10-event-23.description: Identify the two houseguests whose features were blended into each baby picture. The fastest correct identification of all the images wins veto.

bb10-event-24.name: Freeze Frame
bb10-event-24.description: Answer true-or-false questions about photographs of earlier competitions. Correct answers score points; the highest total after seven questions wins HOH.

bb10-event-25.name: Luxury Competition
bb10-event-25.description: Solve a hidden phrase using backyard props while irrelevant clues are gradually covered. Each player has three guesses within three hours. The winner earns a private beach trip and may invite a remaining houseguest or a juror.

bb10-event-26.name: Stairway to Veto
bb10-event-26.description: Match houseguest names to two clues on each staircase step. Complete every step correctly and reach the buzzer to win the final veto.

bb10-event-27.name: On a Wing and Prayer
bb10-event-27.description: Balance on a moving model airplane without falling. The last finalist remaining wins Part 1 and advances directly to final HOH Part 3.

bb10-event-28.name: BB Knockout
bb10-event-28.description: For each week, knock down houseguest cutouts while leaving only that week's HOH and final nominees standing. Complete all rounds correctly in the faster time to advance to final HOH Part 3.

bb10-event-29.name: Jury Statements
bb10-event-29.description: Choose which of two endings completes each juror's statement. Correct predictions earn points; the higher score wins final HOH and the right to select the other finalist.

bb9-event-01.name: Falling For You
bb9-event-01.description: One partner hangs from a harness while supporting the other above the ground. The last intact pair wins Power Couple and the authority to evict a pair. Retrieving a pillow and then winning also earns $10,000.

bb9-event-02.name: Do You Know Your Partner?
bb9-event-02.description: Answer questions about your partner's relationship preferences and compare answers. The couple with the most matches wins joint HOH.

bb9-event-03.name: In Sickness and in Health
bb9-event-03.description: One partner holds a button while strapped to a rotating heart; the other spins the apparatus. The first pair to reach 300 rotations without releasing the button wins the shared veto.

bb9-event-04.name: Big Brother Democracy
bb9-event-04.description: Couples choose between two proposed house rewards or punishments. Matching the majority earns a point, and the selected option affects the house. The highest-scoring couple wins joint HOH.

bb9-event-05.name: What a Catch!
bb9-event-05.description: Teams keep nets raised while opponents load them with fish. As nets become too heavy to hold, players are eliminated. The surviving team earns food; the losing team eats slop.

bb9-event-06.name: Communication Breakdown
bb9-event-06.description: Search packing peanuts for electrical cables and connect four poles to the generator using the correct lengths. The first couple to complete the circuit wins the shared veto and unlocks outside-world information for the house.

bb9-event-07.name: Words of Love
bb9-event-07.description: Answer questions about quotations displayed around the house. Correct answers allow an opponent to be eliminated. Separate men's and women's rounds produce finalists; the final winner earns joint HOH for their couple.

bb9-event-08.name: Big Aspara-Guess!
bb9-event-08.description: Estimate a partner's weight by gathering an equivalent weight of asparagus. Coming within 10 pounds earns the food groups assigned to that couple for the house.

bb9-event-09.name: Cupid is as Cupid Does
bb9-event-09.description: One partner delivers puzzle pieces and uses a harness to raise the other into position to assemble them. The first couple to finish the puzzle wins shared veto.

bb9-event-10.name: Time After Time
bb9-event-10.description: Answer questions comparing the order of events in the house. Correctly recall which happened earlier or later to remain in contention for HOH.

bb9-event-11.name: A Little 'Fon Will 'Due' Ya!
bb9-event-11.description: Teams search chocolate pools for letters and spell food names. The team with more correctly spelled words wins, but receives only the foods it named; the losing team eats slop.

bb9-event-12.name: Color of Veto
bb9-event-12.description: Use an oversized cue to shoot toward a pool-table target. Each round's farthest shot is eliminated and selects or swaps a reward. The final holder of the veto receives it, even if another player wins the shooting portion.

bb9-event-13.name: Big Brother Disco
bb9-event-13.description: Stand upright on a small platform above a suspended disco ball while holding its chain as the apparatus spins. Falling eliminates the player; the last remaining wins HOH.

bb9-event-14.name: Trapped in the Cage
bb9-event-14.description: Transfer wooden blocks, two at a time, across balance beams. Falling or dropping a block eliminates you; first finished or last remaining wins veto.

bb9-event-15.name: En Garde
bb9-event-15.description: In head-to-head matches, identify which evicted houseguest made a Diary Room remark. A correct first answer advances and selects the next pairing; a wrong answer eliminates the responder. Last remaining wins HOH.

bb9-event-16.name: Big Brother Blackjack
bb9-event-16.description: Identify three displayed cards whose values total 21 to earn chips toward a movie screening. The winner may risk that screening in a bonus blackjack hand for a larger prize; losing transfers the screening to the opposing players.

bb9-event-17.name: Club Evel
bb9-event-17.description: Finish unpleasant drink mixtures to earn croquet attempts. Use those attempts to score on the course; the highest total wins veto. Beating the host's benchmark also awards a guitar and amplifier.

bb9-event-18.name: Big Brother Election
bb9-event-18.description: Predict viewers' answers to presidential-election-themed questions about the houseguests. Each correct answer advances the player; the highest score after seven questions wins HOH.

bb9-event-19.name: To Slop or Not to Slop
bb9-event-19.family: To Slop or Not to Slop
bb9-event-19.description: Secretly select a food or slop card and hide it in a watermelon for the reveal. The choice made by the larger group receives slop; choosing with the smaller group earns normal food.
families: To Slop or Not to Slop

bb9-event-20.name: Big Brother Boardwalk
bb9-event-20.description: Estimate quantities in boardwalk displays, then stay or fold. The closest staying guess earns a point and the farthest is eliminated. Folding earns nothing but avoids elimination. First to three points wins veto.

bb9-event-21.name: More...or Less
bb9-event-21.description: Decide whether the true number in each statement is higher or lower than the number given. Correct answers score points; the first player to seven wins HOH.

bb9-event-22.name: A True Big Brother Mash
bb9-event-22.description: Sculpt mashed potatoes into channels that guide gravy into labeled containers. Filled containers earn their associated food groups or household prizes.

bb9-event-23.name: The Rainmaker
bb9-event-23.description: Recall the day of a house event, find a rock marked with that date, and return it to OTEV. Each round eliminates the last correct return, or the least accurate answer when several are wrong. The survivor wins veto.

bb9-event-24.name: Glass Houses
bb9-event-24.description: Hold onto supports inside a suspended glass box after its floor opens. Falling from the box eliminates the player; the last remaining wins HOH.

bb9-event-25.name: PoTV
bb9-event-25.description: Use nine remote controls to change nine screens until their pieces form one complete image. Fastest correct solution wins veto.

bb9-event-26.name: Fact or Fiction
bb9-event-26.description: Judge statements about the house and houseguests as fact or fiction. Correct answers earn points; the highest score after the questions and any tiebreaker wins HOH.

bb9-event-27.name: What Happens In Vegas...
bb9-event-27.description: Pairs break prop bottles to find dice rings, then place them on a game board. A selected occupied space determines the winning pair, who receive a screening of What Happens in Vegas.

bb9-event-28.name: Big Brother Derby
bb9-event-28.description: Match each juror's face with two corresponding clues on a racehorse. Complete the horses in eviction order; the fastest fully correct set wins the final veto.

bb9-event-29.name: Up a Creek
bb9-event-29.description: Hold onto a rope while riding a board against rushing water. The last finalist retaining their grip wins Part 1 and advances directly to final HOH Part 3.

bb9-event-30.name: Who's the Guinea Pig Now?
bb9-event-30.description: Rotate a giant guinea-pig wheel to guide HOH-name balls out of its maze, then arrange them chronologically. Fastest completion advances to Part 3.

bb9-event-31.name: Jury Statements
bb9-event-31.description: Choose between two endings to each juror's personal statement. Correct predictions score points; the higher score wins final HOH and the right to select the other finalist.

bb8-event-01.name: Mushroom Madness
bb8-event-01.description: Pairs combine a quiz with endurance: one partner answers questions while the other rides a giant mushroom. Wrong answers speed up its rotation. The last pair survives; the three hidden houseguests choose which partner becomes HOH.

bb8-event-02.name: Butter Me Up
bb8-event-02.description: Teams collect butter from teammates' bodies and transfer it into a popcorn tub. The greater weight of butter wins food; the losing side eats slop.

bb8-event-03.name: Hide and Seek Veto
bb8-event-03.description: Each player secretly hides a named veto box inside the house. Players then take turns searching for boxes. The owner of the last undiscovered box wins veto.

bb8-event-04.name: Majority Rules
bb8-event-04.description: Predict the majority's answers to questions about the houseguests. Minority answers eliminate players, while tied votes eliminate nobody. The last remaining player or tiebreaker winner becomes HOH.

bb8-event-05.name: Name That Pie
bb8-event-05.description: Teams bid how few bites they need to identify a pie's two ingredients. A successful identification earns a point; failure awards the point to opponents. The first team to seven wins food.

bb8-event-06.name: Cutthroat Christmas
bb8-event-06.description: Slide a curling stone toward the center of an icy target. The farthest stone each round is eliminated and earns a reward that later players may swap for. The final veto holder receives the power.

bb8-event-07.name: Getting Schooled
bb8-event-07.description: Answer true-or-false questions about the house and its events, grouped into school-subject categories. Wrong answers eliminate players; the last remaining wins HOH.

bb8-event-08.name: Mission InPastaBowl
bb8-event-08.description: Partners search separate bowls of giant pasta for meatballs labeled with foods. Finding a matching pair earns that food for the house; collect as many pairs as possible before time expires.

bb8-event-09.name: Mad Hatter
bb8-event-09.description: Stand on a pedestal while balancing a martini glass on your head. Other houseguests may distract competitors. The last person still balancing the glass wins veto.

bb8-event-10.name: Eliminator
bb8-event-10.description: Answer questions about evicted houseguests. A correct first answer allows another contestant to be eliminated; an incorrect answer eliminates the responder. The survivor wins HOH.

bb8-event-11.name: Humpty Scramble
bb8-event-11.description: Pairs search for puzzle pieces matching their assigned color and assemble an egg. The first pair to finish wins food and chooses five houseguests to eat slop.

bb8-event-12.name: Vincent Van Veto
bb8-event-12.description: Decode pictures into Big Brother phrases to earn game currency. Wrong answers eliminate players, and optional prizes cost currency. The eligible player with the most money left wins veto.

bb8-event-13.name: Times Up
bb8-event-13.description: Hang upside down from a rocking pendulum while keeping the torso below the designated bar. Falling or violating the position rule eliminates a player; the last remaining wins HOH.

bb8-event-14.name: The Numbers Don't Lie
bb8-event-14.family: How Bad Do You Want It?
bb8-event-14.description: Bid willingness to accept punishments. Lowest bids eliminate; highest bids incur the penalty. The final round awards veto for the largest promised sacrifice of potential prize money.
families: How Bad Do You Want It?

bb8-event-15.name: Let's Make a Duel
bb8-event-15.description: Face opponents in head-to-head questions identifying evictees' Diary Room statements. Correct first answers advance and select subsequent matchups; wrong answers eliminate the responder. The survivor wins HOH.

bb8-event-16.name: For Those About to Slop
bb8-event-16.description: Teams smash prop guitars to find dollar-sign tokens. The first to collect 20 wins food; the losers eat slop. A hidden slop pass can protect its holder from the restriction.

bb8-event-17.name: Shot For Shot
bb8-event-17.description: Drink unpleasant mixtures to earn croquet attempts, then use those attempts to score through wickets and against the finishing stake. The largest total wins veto.

bb8-event-18.name: Strange Visitors
bb8-event-18.description: Recall details of unusual visitors who entered the house the previous day. Answer true or false; wrong answers eliminate contestants. The final survivor wins HOH.

bb8-event-19.name: Slop Pong
bb8-event-19.description: Teams play an oversized pong-style throwing game with volleyballs. The first team to score 10 points earns normal food; the losing team eats slop.

bb8-event-20.name: Big Brother Speedway
bb8-event-20.description: Estimate the percentage of viewers who gave particular survey answers. Each round's farthest estimate is eliminated. The final two earn an outside trip, while the overall winner also receives veto.

bb8-event-21.name: Tanks For the Memories
bb8-event-21.description: Predict how evicted houseguests answered personal questions. Wrong answers drop the contestant into a water tank and eliminate them. The last player remaining wins HOH.

bb8-event-22.name: Shop 'til You Drop
bb8-event-22.description: Men and women compete to find letters on their clothing, remove those garments, and arrange the letters into three Big Brother-related words. The winning side receives a timed shopping spree.

bb8-event-23.name: Catscratch Veto
bb8-event-23.description: OTEV announces an answer; find a hidden rat bearing the matching riddle and return it. Each round's last return leaves; the survivor wins veto.

bb8-event-24.name: Big Brother Tea Party
bb8-event-24.description: Carry tea in a tiny cup across a slippery lane into a tank. Fill it enough to release a ball and take the ball to the finish first for HOH. A smaller container offers a phone call.

bb8-event-25.name: Janelle-O-Vision
bb8-event-25.description: After spinning for 60 seconds, identify the paired faces in swirling images. Most correct within four minutes wins veto.

bb8-event-26.name: Before or After
bb8-event-26.description: Decide which of two house events happened earlier. Correct answers earn points; the highest total after eight questions wins HOH.

bb8-event-27.name: Niagara Balls
bb8-event-27.description: Search thousands of falling rubber balls for green ones. First to stack eight green balls in a tube and buzz in wins veto.

bb8-event-28.name: Picture This
bb8-event-28.description: Study photographs of previous competitions, then answer questions about their details. The most correct answers, or numerical tiebreaker winner, wins HOH.

bb8-event-29.name: Big Brother Decoder
bb8-event-29.description: Match evicted houseguest faces to paired clues, then rotate the decoder to obtain corresponding digits. Use the digits to reveal the number of seconds spent in the house; first correct completion wins veto.

bb8-event-30.name: The Bunny Hop
bb8-event-30.description: Stand on a carrot-shaped platform, hold a suspended key, and jump over a circling rabbit obstacle. Falling, releasing the key, or stopping the obstacle eliminates the player. Last remaining advances to final HOH Part 3.

bb8-event-31.name: Chain of Commands
bb8-event-31.description: Collect puzzle pieces from one water tank and assemble them in another, connecting HOH portraits in chronological order. The faster correct completion advances to final HOH Part 3.

bb8-event-32.name: Jury Statements
bb8-event-32.description: Choose the correct ending to each juror's personal statement from two options. Correct predictions earn points; the higher score wins final HOH and selects the other finalist.

bb7-event-01.name: Falling Stars
bb7-event-01.description: Two groups take turns balancing on pedestals and launching a swinging meteor at the other group. Each group's last survivor becomes Co-HOH. The two winners must agree on both nominations or become the nominees themselves.

bb7-event-02.name: One Man's Trash Is Another Man's Veto
bb7-event-02.family: One Man's Trash Is Another Man's Veto
bb7-event-02.description: Search a yard full of discarded Big Brother props for veto symbols and return them to your dumpster. The first competitor to collect six symbols wins the veto.
families: One Man's Trash Is Another Man's Veto

bb7-event-03.name: Alison Rules
bb7-event-03.description: Predict the true-or-false answers Alison gave after her eviction. An answer that does not match hers eliminates the player; the last remaining competitor becomes HOH.

bb7-event-04.name: Slop 'Til You Drop
bb7-event-04.description: Two teams search slop for rubber rats without using their hands. Teammates work in pairs joined at the hips. The team collecting more rats earns normal food, while the losing team eats slop.

bb7-event-05.name: Big Brother Golf Classic
bb7-event-05.description: Hit oversized golf balls toward a target. Less accurate shots add penalty balls to your tube, while the best zone lets you give a ball to an opponent. Seven penalty balls eliminate a player; the final survivor wins veto.

bb7-event-06.name: Pay Attention
bb7-event-06.description: Watch footage of earlier competitions, then answer A-or-B observation questions. Wrong answers eliminate players; the surviving contestants face a numerical tiebreaker if needed to determine HOH.

bb7-event-07.name: Balanced Diet
bb7-event-07.description: Partners guide a bowling ball up a ramp while avoiding holes. Reaching the top earns normal food and a catered meal for their assigned day; a ball falling into a food zone determines that day's more limited menu.

bb7-event-08.name: How Bad Do You Want It?
bb7-event-08.family: How Bad Do You Want It?
bb7-event-08.description: Stay in the veto contest by completing increasingly unpleasant tasks and accepting punishments. Refusing or failing a task eliminates a player. The final tie is decided by who commits to the most consecutive days on slop.
families: How Bad Do You Want It?

bb7-event-09.name: Define & Dismiss
bb7-event-09.description: Recall the decorative words and definitions displayed in the house. The first correct response lets that player eliminate an opponent; an incorrect response eliminates the person who buzzed in. The final survivor becomes HOH.

bb7-event-10.name: Food Fight
bb7-event-10.description: Find the specially marked star ball among balls dropped into the yard. Each round's finder secures normal food and selects another player to eliminate onto slop for the week.

bb7-event-11.name: Torture Test
bb7-event-11.description: Identify Big Brother words or phrases as their letters appear in reverse order. Correct answers allow distracting handicaps to be assigned to opponents. The first player to identify three phrases wins veto.

bb7-event-12.name: Pit Stop
bb7-event-12.description: Teams race to assemble a car. The faster team earns an advance screening of Talladega Nights. Unable to play because of his foot injury, Boogie shares the reward if the team he selected wins.

bb7-event-13.name: Caught In a Web
bb7-event-13.description: Remain on a giant suspended spider web longer than everyone else. Dropping off eliminates a player. Early dropouts can claim mystery eggs containing prizes or nothing, while the final survivor becomes HOH.

bb7-event-14.name: Grave Mistakes
bb7-event-14.family: How Bad Do You Want It?
bb7-event-14.description: Players lie in separate graves and choose whether to accept offers. Punishments increase their veto-point totals; luxuries cost points. The competitor finishing with the highest total wins veto.
families: How Bad Do You Want It?

bb7-event-15.name: The Ghosts of Big Brother Past
bb7-event-15.family: The Ghosts of Big Brother Past
bb7-event-15.description: Answer true-or-false questions about ghostly visitors and the house seance. Wrong answers eliminate players; an all-correct round eliminates the slowest. Buzzer failures invalidated Erika's initial HOH result.
families: The Ghosts of Big Brother Past

bb7-event-16.name: The Ghosts of Big Brother Past" (Redo)
bb7-event-16.family: The Ghosts of Big Brother Past" (Redo)
bb7-event-16.description: The replacement HOH quiz uses A-or-B questions about the seance. Wrong answers eliminate players. Janelle wins the replay after the original buzzer-based contest was voided.
families: The Ghosts of Big Brother Past" (Redo)

bb7-event-17.name: Big Brother Bakery
bb7-event-17.description: Prepare a three-course meal using slop for former houseguests Nicole, Jun and Marvin to judge. Their evaluations determine food privileges and bonus meals for the house during the coming week.

bb7-event-18.name: Anything You Can Do, I Can Do Veto
bb7-event-18.family: Anything You Can Do, I Can Do Veto
bb7-event-18.description: Watch former houseguests demonstrate timed challenges, then bid a completion time. The selected bidder attempts the task: meeting the bid allows an opponent's elimination, while missing it eliminates the bidder. The final survivor wins veto.
families: Anything You Can Do, I Can Do Veto

bb7-event-19.name: Untitled
bb7-event-19.description: Interpret a series of visual clues and submit a guess for the hidden phrase. Boogie solves 'You reap what you sow' first, earning the secret Coup d'Etat power to replace nominees at an eligible upcoming eviction.

bb7-event-20.name: Prom Night
bb7-event-20.description: Predict which houseguest viewers selected for various prom-style superlatives. Each correct answer moves a player forward; the best score, with a numerical tiebreaker if needed, earns HOH.

bb7-event-21.name: Gnome Is Where the Veto Is
bb7-event-21.family: Gnome Is Where the Veto Is
bb7-event-21.description: Build a reaching tool from supplied objects to retrieve a bag containing a key. Unlock yourself and place the veto around the log first to win.
families: Gnome Is Where the Veto Is

bb7-event-22.name: Revenge of the Gnomes
bb7-event-22.description: Judge gnome-themed statements about the season and house as true or false. Incorrect answers eliminate players and earn a pie to the face. The final survivor becomes HOH.

bb7-event-23.name: Voo Doo Dolls
bb7-event-23.description: Solve OTEV's riddle, find the doll representing the correct former houseguest, and race back to a kneeling spot. There is one fewer spot than players. Survive every elimination round to win veto.

bb7-event-24.name: But First
bb7-event-24.description: Decide whether two season events are described in the correct chronological order. Answer true or false by stepping up or down. Incorrect answers eliminate players until one remains as HOH.

bb7-event-25.name: Birds and the Bees
bb7-event-25.description: Use absorbent costumes to soak up nectar and transport it across the yard. Filling reward containers earns food and bonuses for the house, including special treats and a slop pass.

bb7-event-26.name: Two Faced
bb7-event-26.description: Identify the two evicted houseguests whose facial features have been combined in each image. Correctly solve the entire set in the shortest time to win veto.

bb7-event-27.name: Battle of the Sexes
bb7-event-27.description: Identify whether each statement about the season refers to male or female houseguests. Correct answers earn points; the highest score wins this double-eviction HOH.

bb7-event-28.name: I'm Knots About Veto
bb7-event-28.description: Work your way through two large knots in a rope to free the veto symbol attached to it. The first player to release the symbol and finish wins veto.

bb7-event-29.name: Big Brother Bowl
bb7-event-29.description: Estimate the day on which each named season event occurred. Every day of error adds a penalty yard. The player with the smallest accumulated error finishes closest to the goal and becomes HOH.

bb7-event-30.name: When the Stars Align
bb7-event-30.description: Arrange houseguest faces around a star-shaped puzzle so that every linked clue is satisfied. Individual clues can fit multiple people, but the whole layout must be correct. Finish first to win veto.

bb7-event-31.name: Mount HoH
bb7-event-31.description: Final HOH, Part 1: balance on the volcano while continuously holding your key. Letting go or falling eliminates a player. The last person remaining advances directly to Part 3.

bb7-event-32.name: Fly By Night
bb7-event-32.description: Final HOH, Part 2: while suspended above a ring, adjust mirrors to reflect a laser through past winners in season order. The faster successful player advances to Part 3.

bb7-event-33.name: Jury Statements
bb7-event-33.description: Final HOH, Part 3: choose the correct ending to statements recorded by jurors. Each match earns a point. The higher score wins the last HOH and the decision of whom to take to the Final Two.

bb6-event-01.name: Wipe Out
bb6-event-01.description: The winning team from the coconut-passing food round stays on its surfboard for an endurance contest. The last eligible player to remain on the board becomes the first HOH.

bb6-event-02.name: Wipe Out
bb6-event-02.description: Teams of seven balance on surfboards, passing coconuts from the rear to the front for a teammate to throw into a goal. The better-scoring team earns normal food and enters the HOH stage; the losers receive peanut butter and jelly.

bb6-event-03.name: Rec-Tangled
bb6-event-03.description: Work alongside your selected partner to untangle a rope holding a veto symbol. The first individual to release the symbol and place it on the finishing pole wins veto.

bb6-event-04.name: Fast & Easy
bb6-event-04.description: Answer true-or-false questions about the house. A wrong answer eliminates a player; if everyone is correct, the slowest response is eliminated instead. The last remaining contestant becomes HOH.

bb6-event-05.name: Snack Shack from Hell
bb6-event-05.description: Partners attempt to eat unpleasant dishes representing different food groups. Completing a dish earns that food category for the house for the week.

bb6-event-06.name: High and Dry
bb6-event-06.description: Carry water along a suspended zipline route and pour it into a tank to raise a floating ball. Retrieve the ball and complete the finish in the shortest time to win veto.

bb6-event-07.name: Majority Rules
bb6-event-07.description: Answer opinion questions the way you expect most other contestants to answer. Minority answers eliminate players. The last survivor, or the winner of the remaining players' numerical tiebreaker, becomes HOH.

bb6-event-08.name: Will Spell for Food
bb6-event-08.description: Correctly spell food-related words to remove losing spaces from a wheel. A final spin decides the week's food privileges: an emptied space wins normal food, while a remaining penalty space means peanut butter and jelly.

bb6-event-09.name: Knight Moves
bb6-event-09.description: Move around a giant chessboard using a knight's L-shaped move. Previously used squares become unavailable. A player unable to make another legal move is eliminated; the last mobile player wins veto.

bb6-event-10.name: Power Roller
bb6-event-10.description: Roll a ball along a lane toward its end hole without letting it fall into any hole. The valid ball finishing closest to the target earns its player HOH.

bb6-event-11.name: Matching the Munchies
bb6-event-11.description: Complete food-themed statements and try to match answers supplied by a houseguest panel. Successful matches earn food for designated days; the challenge also offers access to a mystery safe.

bb6-event-12.name: Couch Potato
bb6-event-12.description: Throw tennis balls at a television's controls to switch it on and change channels. The first competitor to reach Channel 5 wins veto.

bb6-event-13.name: Big Brother Movie Marquee
bb6-event-13.description: Two teams install light bulbs in a large movie marquee to reveal its hidden message. The first team to complete the message earns a screening of Four Brothers.

bb6-event-14.name: Eliminator
bb6-event-14.description: Buzz in to answer questions about earlier house events. A correct answer lets you remove an opponent; a wrong answer removes you. The final player left wins HOH.

bb6-event-15.name: Conveyer Belch
bb6-event-15.description: Teams eat sweets delivered on a conveyor belt. Uneaten leftovers are weighed afterward. The team wasting less food earns normal meals, while the other team receives peanut butter and jelly.

bb6-event-16.name: A Lotta Piñata
bb6-event-16.description: Privately distribute ten candies among at least two players' pinatas. After every turn, the pinatas are opened; the total nearest 20 without exceeding it wins veto.

bb6-event-17.name: Pressure Cooker
bb6-event-17.description: Remain inside a glass enclosure while continuously pressing your button. Releasing it eliminates you and triggers a mystery prize or punishment. The last player holding a button wins HOH.

bb6-event-18.name: Coast for the Most
bb6-event-18.description: Slide coasters bearing evicted houseguests' faces toward the rings corresponding to their eviction weeks. Accurate placements earn points, and the highest accumulated score wins veto.

bb6-event-19.name: Face the Facts
bb6-event-19.description: Answer questions about earlier competitions by displaying the appropriate evicted houseguest's face, or the 'none' option. Wrong answers eliminate players. A numerical tiebreaker resolves the remaining tie for HOH.

bb6-event-20.name: Goal For It
bb6-event-20.description: Shoot hockey pucks into six goals in the required left-to-right order. Each competitor plays against the clock; the fastest completed run wins veto.

bb6-event-21.name: On the House
bb6-event-21.description: Buzz in on questions about household objects and details. Correct answers earn points; wrong answers eliminate the responder. The highest score after ten questions wins HOH.

bb6-event-22.name: Get Your Pairings
bb6-event-22.description: Retrieve houseguest portraits from the pool and arrange each person beside their secret partner on a board. Complete all of the pairings in the shortest time to win veto.

bb6-event-23.name: High, Low
bb6-event-23.description: For each numerical claim about the season, decide whether the actual answer is higher or lower and step accordingly. Incorrect answers eliminate players; the surviving player wins HOH, with a tiebreaker if necessary.

bb6-event-24.name: Playing Dirty
bb6-event-24.description: Search a mud-filled lane for keys, use them to unlock veto symbols, and carry the released symbols to your frame. Complete the required collection first to win veto; a specially designated symbol also unlocks a bonus reward.

bb6-event-25.name: Playing It Straight
bb6-event-25.description: Take two bowling-ball rolls along a narrow beam. Landing zones determine each roll's points. The highest combined score wins HOH.

bb6-event-26.name: Roll Me a Veto
bb6-event-26.description: Wager casino chips before dice select a week and competition category. Correctly naming the relevant winner increases your chips; wrong answers lose the bet. Finish with the largest chip total to win veto.

bb6-event-27.name: Magnetic Attraction
bb6-event-27.description: Use colored magnets to identify houseguests from their pre-show questionnaire answers. Each correct selection earns a point; the highest score wins HOH.

bb6-event-28.name: Morph 'O' Matic
bb6-event-28.description: Study six composite portraits and identify the three houseguests blended into each one. The competitor who correctly identifies every face in the shortest time wins veto.

bb6-event-29.name: Before or After
bb6-event-29.description: Decide whether one event happened before or after another during the season. Each correct answer earns a point. The highest score after seven questions wins HOH.

bb6-event-30.name: The Missing Link
bb6-event-30.description: Place evicted houseguests' faces into a chain so the people on either side of each clue satisfy it. Several people may fit an individual clue, but the complete arrangement must work. Finish first to win veto.

bb6-event-31.name: The Key of Being Safe
bb6-event-31.description: Final HOH, Part 1: balance on a giant safe's dial while holding your key. Falling or releasing the key eliminates you; the last survivor advances to Part 3.

bb6-event-32.name: Pad-Locked
bb6-event-32.description: Final HOH, Part 2: solve clues about the season to determine a giant padlock's combination. Set the digits correctly and open the lock before your opponent to advance to Part 3.

bb6-event-33.name: Jury Statements
bb6-event-33.description: Final HOH, Part 3: choose the correct endings to statements recorded by jurors. Correct matches earn points, with a numerical tiebreaker if needed. The winner becomes the last HOH and chooses the other finalist.

bb5-event-01.name: Hungry Hungry Helix
bb5-event-01.description: Carry food-labeled balls through a rotating DNA-shaped obstacle within the time limit to stock the house. A special ball gives its finder a choice: keep the earned food or accept $10,000 and put everyone on peanut butter and jelly.

bb5-event-02.name: Treadmills of Terror
bb5-event-02.description: Pairs combine a quiz with treadmill endurance. One partner answers questions; mistakes increase the speed of the other's treadmill. The last pair remaining faces a deciding question to determine which partner becomes HOH.

bb5-event-03.name: Margarita Madness
bb5-event-03.description: Work together to fill an oversized margarita glass before the ten-minute deadline. Completing the task unlocks the hot tub and earns a margarita party for the house.

bb5-event-04.name: Flaringo Toss
bb5-event-04.description: Throw hoops over flamingos to set a score, then challenge another competitor to match or beat it. The lower-scoring player is eliminated, while a tie keeps both in. The final survivor wins veto.

bb5-event-05.name: Majority Rules
bb5-event-05.description: Predict the majority response to opinion questions about the houseguests. Anyone answering outside the majority is eliminated. Surviving players face a numerical tiebreaker if needed to decide HOH.

bb5-event-06.name: Catapoultry
bb5-event-06.description: Launch rubber chickens toward nests labeled with food items. Successful landings add those foods to the week's menu. Hitting the bad-egg space wipes out the food accumulated so far.

bb5-event-07.name: Snag the Veto
bb5-event-07.description: Untangle the rope trapping a veto symbol. The first competitor to free and retrieve the symbol wins the Power of Veto.

bb5-event-08.name: High, Low
bb5-event-08.description: Decide whether the true number in each season-related question is higher or lower than the number supplied. Step up or down to answer; survive the incorrect-answer eliminations to become HOH.

bb5-event-09.name: Alphabet Soup
bb5-event-09.description: Search a giant bowl of tomato alphabet soup for letters and use them to spell foods. The house receives the food items that players successfully spell.

bb5-event-10.name: Bluff Me a Veto
bb5-event-10.description: Players take turns reading questionnaire answers, either truthfully or with a bluff. Opponents wager a chip on truth or bluff; incorrect guesses give the chip to the reader. The most chips after two rounds wins veto.

bb5-event-11.name: I Have a Secret
bb5-event-11.description: Stand on a small pedestal while holding the button on your life-size cutout. Releasing the button or violating the stance rules eliminates you. The longest-lasting player wins HOH.

bb5-event-12.name: This Little Piggy Won the Veto
bb5-event-12.description: Secretly distribute thirteen coins among at least two players' piggy banks. After all contributions, the player whose bank contains the most coins without exceeding 20 wins veto.

bb5-event-13.name: Home Is Where the Answer Is
bb5-event-13.family: Home Is Where the Answer Is
bb5-event-13.description: Answer true-or-false questions testing your memory of the Big Brother house. Wrong answers eliminate players; the last person remaining becomes HOH.
families: Home Is Where the Answer Is

bb5-event-14.name: Fast Times and Custard Pie
bb5-event-14.description: Search unpleasant pies for cards granting permission to eat. Finding an eat card secures normal food for that player; those without one receive peanut butter and jelly.

bb5-event-15.name: Pop Goes the Veto
bb5-event-15.description: Throw darts at balloons concealing the contestants' faces. When every balloon associated with a player is popped, that player loses eligibility to win. The last face still covered by a balloon wins veto.

bb5-event-16.name: The Puck Stops Here
bb5-event-16.description: Slide a puck along a shuffleboard-style alley, using the rebound to approach the boundary of the blue scoring area. The best valid placement nearest that line earns HOH.

bb5-event-17.name: Backyard Burger Bonanza
bb5-event-17.description: Two teams gather and catch oversized hamburger ingredients, then assemble complete burgers. The team producing more burgers earns normal food; the losing team receives peanut butter and jelly.

bb5-event-18.name: A Very Veto Christmas
bb5-event-18.description: Open paired Christmas gifts containing hidden veto-point values, revealing only part of your total. Further gift selections and steals can change the standings. The player holding the most veto points at the end wins.

bb5-event-19.name: Admit One
bb5-event-19.description: Teams assemble a film-strip puzzle, then send a teammate to search a huge bowl of M&M's for a golden candy. The first team to finish earns a screening of Without a Paddle.

bb5-event-20.name: Who Said It?
bb5-event-20.description: Identify which evicted houseguest gave each answer on a pre-show questionnaire. Display the corresponding face to respond. Wrong answers eliminate players; the last survivor or tiebreak winner becomes HOH.

bb5-event-21.name: Smoothies from Hell
bb5-event-21.description: Drink a blended version of your requested meal within the allotted time. Each successful player earns normal food for the house on the day assigned to that player.

bb5-event-22.name: The Web
bb5-event-22.description: Move lettered balls through a rubber-band web, then unscramble the letters into a word. Faster teamwork earns more household prizes; the quickest individual ball retrieval earns a $1,000 online shopping spree.

bb5-event-23.name: Morph 'O' Matic
bb5-event-23.description: Identify the three houseguests blended into each of six composite faces. Correctly solve the full set faster than the other competitors to win veto.

bb5-event-24.name: Putting for Power
bb5-event-24.description: Compete in heats to putt a ball up a sloping course into the hole. The first successful player from each heat advances. In the final, sink the most balls within sixty seconds to become HOH.

bb5-event-25.name: Ice Ice Veto
bb5-event-25.description: Use water guns to melt an ice block containing the veto. Freeing a marked tool-access piece allows additional equipment to be used. The first competitor to release the veto medallion wins.

bb5-event-26.name: Chemical Reaction
bb5-event-26.description: Answer questions about earlier events by selecting and pouring a chemical solution. A blue reaction signals a correct answer; an unchanged mixture signals a mistake. Survive the quiz to win HOH.

bb5-event-27.name: Bounced
bb5-event-27.description: Bounce balls through six separate targets. Each competitor completes the course individually, and the shortest successful time wins veto.

bb5-event-28.name: Ready, Set, Gone
bb5-event-28.description: Recall objects secretly removed from the house. Buzzing in correctly earns a point; an incorrect answer eliminates you. The highest score after eight questions wins HOH.

bb5-event-29.name: Caged
bb5-event-29.description: Use the materials inside your cage to construct a tool that can reach its key. Retrieve the key, unlock the cage, and activate the finishing switch before anyone else to win veto.

bb5-event-30.name: Before or After
bb5-event-30.description: Determine whether one event occurred before or after another during the season. Each correct answer scores a point, and the highest total after eight questions wins HOH.

bb5-event-31.name: Trashin' the Fashion
bb5-event-31.description: Sacrifice unwanted clothing by destroying the selected items in exchange for a replacement-clothes shopping spree. The challenge trades old wardrobe pieces for new ones rather than awarding game power.

bb5-event-32.name: Socket to Me
bb5-event-32.description: Ten light boxes represent the season's competition weeks. Connect electrical cords beneath the correct houseguest portraits to link the veto winners in chronological order. The fastest correct circuit wins the final veto.

bb5-event-33.name: Earthquake
bb5-event-33.description: Final HOH, Part 1: maintain your balance on the moving earthquake apparatus while keeping hold of your key. Falling or releasing it eliminates you. The last remaining player advances directly to Part 3.

bb5-event-34.name: Twisted Twosomes
bb5-event-34.description: Final HOH, Part 2: slide houseguest portraits along a DNA-shaped puzzle to match both people named by each clue. Complete every pairing first to advance to Part 3.

bb5-event-35.name: Encore Presentation
bb5-event-35.description: Final HOH, Part 3: select the correct endings to six statements made by jurors. The higher score, or numerical tiebreak winner, becomes the final HOH and chooses the other finalist.

bb4-event-01.name: X Marks The Spot
bb4-event-01.description: Balance on two sloping beams while answering questions about fellow houseguests' pre-show responses. The group earns food if no more than two players fall.

bb4-event-02.name: Who's Ya Chum?
bb4-event-02.description: Pairs compete in an endurance test: one partner kneels on a button while the other sits beneath a bucket of fish chum. Releasing the button dumps the chum and eliminates the pair. Scott, who sits out, selects the HOH from the surviving pair.

bb4-event-03.name: Spuds
bb4-event-03.description: Partners represent food groups. One throws potatoes into a basket, aiming to match the other's weight within 25 pounds. Successful pairs earn their assigned food category.

bb4-event-04.name: Feeling Knotty
bb4-event-04.description: Untie knots in the rope attached to your waist to create enough slack to reach a central post. Place your veto symbol on the post before anyone else to win.

bb4-event-05.name: Majority Rules
bb4-event-05.description: Predict how most competing houseguests will answer opinion questions. Minority answers eliminate players. The last survivor, or winner of a numerical tiebreaker, becomes HOH.

bb4-event-06.name: Clash Of The Casseroles
bb4-event-06.description: Teams identify the meat and vegetable ingredients in casseroles and record their answers on a menu board. The first completely correct board wins normal food; the other team receives peanut butter and jelly.

bb4-event-07.name: Duck Ball
bb4-event-07.description: Throw rubber ducks toward a target for points. The inner cylinder awards three points and an extra throw, the veto symbol two, and the outer ring one. The best total wins veto, with a tiebreaker if needed.

bb4-event-08.name: Everything In 3's
bb4-event-08.description: Three groups of three answer buzzer questions. Each group's first correct responder advances to the final. The first finalist to answer two questions correctly becomes HOH.

bb4-event-09.name: Paratroopers
bb4-event-09.description: Catch descending toy paratroopers using military helmets. Each carries a food label; successful catches earn the corresponding foods for the house that week.

bb4-event-10.name: Niagara Balls
bb4-event-10.description: Collect green balls from a shower of differently colored balls and place them in your V-shaped holder. The first competitor to collect ten green balls wins veto.

bb4-event-11.name: Spin-O-Matic
bb4-event-11.description: After thirty seconds spinning in a chair, carry a champagne glass on a tray to the finish and ring a bell. Dropping the glass disqualifies the run. The fastest successful player earns a gourmet dinner with a guest.

bb4-event-12.name: Around The Water Cooler
bb4-event-12.description: Guide ping-pong balls from a large water-cooler jug into the cylinder below you. The contestant landing the most balls in the cylinder within one minute becomes HOH.

bb4-event-13.name: Laying Pipe
bb4-event-13.description: Teams assemble pipes and joints along a course to route running water to a rubber duck. Float your duck across the finish first to earn normal food; the losing team receives peanut butter and jelly.

bb4-event-14.name: Snake In The Grass
bb4-event-14.description: Take turns uncovering squares of artificial grass to reveal hidden houseguest portraits. Revealing all four portraits of a contestant eliminates that person. The last contestant with a portrait still concealed wins veto.

bb4-event-15.name: Who Said It?
bb4-event-15.description: Identify who gave each pre-show questionnaire answer, choosing among the evicted houseguests and outgoing HOH. Incorrect answers eliminate contestants until one remains as the new HOH.

bb4-event-16.name: 50 Ways To Cook A Houseguest
bb4-event-16.description: Pairs recreate oversized recipes, with one person acting as chef and the other dressed as an ingredient. Complete the required assembly within ten minutes to earn the associated meals for the house.

bb4-event-17.name: Foam Party
bb4-event-17.description: While covered in foam, houseguests remove supplied clothing to find letters, then use those letters to spell the required word. This is a cooperative luxury challenge, with a reward for completing the task.

bb4-event-18.name: Quoridor
bb4-event-18.description: Race across a giant Quoridor board. On each turn, move one square or place a fence to delay opponents, without completely blocking anyone's route. Heat winners meet in a final; reaching the opposite side first wins veto.

bb4-event-19.name: Steel Cage Match
bb4-event-19.description: Endure confinement in three progressively smaller cages. Enough contestants must drop out before the survivors can move to the next cage. Do not sleep or touch the ground below; the last person remaining in the final cage wins HOH.

bb4-event-20.name: Clambake From Hell
bb4-event-20.description: Eat an unpleasant seafood-themed dish within the allotted time. Each player's successful completion earns normal food for the house on an assigned day; a failed dish leaves that day on peanut butter and jelly.

bb4-event-21.name: Video Veto
bb4-event-21.description: Arrange cameras and monitors so the season's first five veto winners appear in chronological order. The player completing the correct sequence in the shortest time wins veto.

bb4-event-22.name: Black HoHle
bb4-event-22.description: Roll a ball along a lane toward a hole, trying to finish as close as possible without dropping in. The nearest valid ball wins HOH.

bb4-event-23.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
bb4-event-23.description: Before nominations are revealed, privately consider offers of veto in exchange for putting the other houseguests on peanut butter and jelly. The required duration decreases across offers; Jee accepts the one-week version and receives veto.

bb4-event-24.name: Attack Of The Gnomes
bb4-event-24.description: Smash garden gnomes to uncover tickets. Black tickets eliminate players; collecting three gold tickets first wins meals from McDonald's to share with a chosen houseguest.

bb4-event-25.name: Disappearing Act
bb4-event-25.description: Recall household objects that secretly disappeared during the week. Buzzing in correctly earns a point; a wrong answer eliminates you. The highest score after eight questions wins HOH.

bb4-event-26.name: Big Brother Ball Room
bb4-event-26.description: Search a ball pit for food-labeled balls. Place them in a tube in alphabetical order within five minutes to earn those foods for the house.

bb4-event-27.name: Where in the World is Jun?
bb4-event-27.family: Where in the World is Jun?
bb4-event-27.description: Work out where the absent Jun has gone and identify both the event and city. Each player gets one guess; the earliest correct answer wins veto. If nobody succeeds, Jun receives it. Her destination is the MTV Video Music Awards in New York.
families: Where in the World is Jun?

bb4-event-28.name: Dearly Departed
bb4-event-28.description: Choose the correct endings to eight statements made by members of the jury. Each correct match earns a point. The highest total becomes HOH.

bb4-event-29.name: Mexotic Dinner
bb4-event-29.description: Break pinatas and gather as many pesos as possible during a brief collection window. The combined haul determines normal food and bonus restaurant dinners for the week.

bb4-event-30.name: Final Veto
bb4-event-30.description: Place the two original nominees for each week beside the matching staircase step. Correct pairs illuminate steps. Light all eight steps and reach the diamond first to win the season's final veto.

bb4-event-31.name: Escape From Big Brother
bb4-event-31.description: Race through an escape-themed obstacle course while wearing a ball and chain. The two fastest finishers earn a Goodyear Blimp ride over Los Angeles.

bb4-event-32.name: On The House
bb4-event-32.description: Final HOH, Part 1: stand on a small house's roof while keeping hold of your key in its nomination box. Sitting, kneeling, sleeping or releasing the key eliminates you. The last survivor advances to Part 3.

bb4-event-33.name: Runaway Jury
bb4-event-33.description: Throw your colored Velcro balls at a mime's suit. The first player to make three balls stick wins a Runaway Jury screening with a guest, plus an invitation to the film's Hollywood premiere.

bb4-event-34.name: Unexpected Relations
bb4-event-34.description: Final HOH, Part 2: attach houseguest faces to the corners of five X-shaped puzzles so that every diagonal clue is satisfied. The first fully correct arrangement advances its player to Part 3.

bb4-event-35.name: Exact Match
bb4-event-35.description: Final HOH, Part 3: Alison predicts Justin's yes-or-no answers, while Jun predicts Jee's. Correct matches earn points across eight questions, followed by a numerical tiebreaker if necessary. The winner becomes final HOH and chooses the other finalist.

bb3-event-01.name: Untitled
bb3-event-01.description: Fill a shopping bag with groceries, choose a partner, and climb together into a tree-mounted nest before the ninety-second deadline. Completing the opening group challenge lets the house keep the collected food.

bb3-event-02.name: Untitled
bb3-event-02.description: After the grocery challenge, pairs remain in their nests for an endurance bonus. The last pair still in a nest earns $3,000 for each week both partners remain in the game; the prize stops growing when either is evicted.

bb3-event-03.name: Wheel Of First Impressions
bb3-event-03.description: Match descriptive cards to houseguests, then spin a wheel to select someone who eliminates one of the named contestants. When two remain, the eliminated houseguests vote for which finalist becomes the first HOH.

bb3-event-04.name: Saving Face
bb3-event-04.description: Launch balls at opponents' portrait targets. Once three balls fill a person's tube, that player can no longer win. The last eligible contestant receives the Silver Veto, which cannot be used to save its holder.

bb3-event-05.name: Luau Luxury
bb3-event-05.description: Teams identify five items that have been removed from the house. The winning team receives a luau dinner, while the losing team watches without sharing the reward.

bb3-event-06.name: In the House
bb3-event-06.description: Identify the room associated with each household object or event. Select the matching room symbol to answer. Incorrect answers eliminate players until one remains as HOH.

bb3-event-07.name: Architectural Digestion
bb3-event-07.description: Two teams weigh themselves, then eat a giant brownie house without using their hands. The team showing the greater qualifying weight gain earns normal food; the other team receives peanut butter and jelly.

bb3-event-08.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
bb3-event-08.description: Each player starts with a mystery box and negotiates trades or deals for other boxes. When the boxes are opened, whoever holds the one containing the Silver Veto wins it. The holder cannot use this veto on themselves.

bb3-event-09.name: One Step Beyond
bb3-event-09.description: While blindfolded, answer true-or-false questions and advance one step for each correct response. Reach the finish or lead after eight questions to win HOH; a numerical tiebreaker settles a tie.

bb3-event-10.name: Gastronomic Batik
bb3-event-10.description: Fit large, irregularly shaped food tokens into a glass container. Successfully placed pieces earn their named foods for the week, with a special token offering an additional meal reward.

bb3-event-11.name: Pool Sharks
bb3-event-11.description: Use a cue ball to knock opponents' portrait balls off a giant pool table and into the swimming pool. The last player whose ball remains wins the Silver Veto, usable only on another nominee.

bb3-event-12.name: Face Off
bb3-event-12.description: Answer questions using paddles showing evicted houseguests, the outgoing HOH, or none of the above. Wrong answers eliminate players. The final survivor or numerical tiebreak winner becomes HOH.

bb3-event-13.name: "I Can Eat Anything Better Than You
bb3-event-13.family: "I Can Eat Anything Better Than You
bb3-event-13.description: Opposing teammates bid how many bites of an unpleasant food they can eat within a time limit. Meeting the accepted bid earns their team a point; failing gives the point to the other team. The winning team avoids peanut butter and jelly.
families: "I Can Eat Anything Better Than You

bb3-event-14.name: Turnover
bb3-event-14.description: Take turns moving one adjacent square on a giant board. Squares left behind are flipped and cannot be used again. Players with no legal move are eliminated; the final survivor wins the Silver Veto.

bb3-event-15.name: Gutter Ball
