bb3-event-15.description: Roll a ball along a narrow runway, aiming to stop nearest its far end. A ball that falls off is out. The closest valid roll earns HOH.

bb3-event-16.name: Ballast
bb3-event-16.description: Carefully pull food-labeled logs from a packed circular structure. Each successful removal earns its food, but dislodging the remaining logs ends the opportunity to collect more.

bb3-event-17.name: Clockwork
bb3-event-17.description: Watch snapshots of earlier house events, then arrange those events chronologically. Correct sequence positions earn points. A further round resolves the leaders' tie for the Silver Veto.

bb3-event-18.name: HouseGuest Soup
bb3-event-18.description: Remain seated in a large tub as the water becomes increasingly unpleasant with added substances. Standing, leaving or falling asleep eliminates a player. The last person still in the tub becomes HOH.

bb3-event-19.name: Whirlwind Booth
bb3-event-19.description: Enter a booth filled with swirling bills and catch as many as possible. White bills contribute to the household food budget, while green bills represent cash prizes.

bb3-event-20.name: Untitled
bb3-event-20.description: Find hidden CD cases around the house and assemble them to reveal a message. Completing the group puzzle earns a live backyard performance by Sheryl Crow.

bb3-event-21.name: A Slippery Proposition
bb3-event-21.description: Slide headfirst on your stomach toward the far end of a slippery runway. The top of your head determines your finishing mark. The closest slide that does not cross the line wins the Silver Veto.

bb3-event-22.name: Who Said It?
bb3-event-22.description: Identify which evicted houseguest made each quoted remark, displaying the appropriate face or the none-of-the-above option. Wrong answers eliminate players; the last contestant remaining wins HOH.

bb3-event-23.name: Making the Donuts
bb3-event-23.description: Complete a seven-minute relay transporting oversized doughnuts across the yard. Each successful delivery earns its associated food; one special doughnut earns a supply of doughnuts and coffee.

bb3-event-24.name: Gnome Drop
bb3-event-24.description: Answer multiple-choice questions by cutting the matching cord on an opponent's suspended gnome. Only the correct cord supports the gnome, so a right answer makes it fall and eliminates its owner. The last hanging gnome wins the Silver Veto.

bb3-event-25.name: Evicted Statements
bb3-event-25.description: Judge true-or-false statements based on information from evicted houseguests about those still playing. An incorrect answer eliminates you. The last remaining contestant becomes HOH.

bb3-event-26.name: Sweet Surprise
bb3-event-26.description: Search pies in a reopened bedroom for seven medallions, each representing a day of the week. Find them within ninety seconds to earn normal food on those days; any unfound medallion leaves its day on peanut butter and jelly.

bb3-event-27.name: Big Brother Charm School
bb3-event-27.description: Navigate an obstacle course while balancing the veto on your head. Touching or dropping it adds fifteen seconds. The best adjusted time wins the Silver Veto; the top two finishers also receive massages.

bb3-event-28.name: Freezeframe
bb3-event-28.description: Watch footage of earlier house events until the picture freezes, then choose what happened next from three options. Incorrect answers eliminate players; the final survivor wins HOH.

bb3-event-29.name: Dinner Party From Hell
bb3-event-29.description: Eat the unpleasant dishes served at a themed dinner party within the challenge's requirements to earn normal food. The house fails this attempt and receives peanut butter and jelly for the week.

bb3-event-30.name: Laser Labyrinth
bb3-event-30.description: Follow the eviction-order portraits through a laser obstacle course. Wrong portraits add one minute; breaking a beam or touching a black area adds fifteen seconds. The fastest adjusted run wins the Golden Veto, which may save its holder.

bb3-event-31.name: ...And Then There Were Four
bb3-event-31.description: Answer questions about the four remaining houseguests with a number from zero to four. Each correct answer earns a point; the highest total wins HOH.

bb3-event-32.name: Untitled
bb3-event-32.description: Find hidden phones to qualify for a call and a gift for a loved one. Players then privately consider cash offers that would cancel everyone else's prizes. A number hidden on each phone breaks ties among accepting players; Amy wins the exclusive package.

bb3-event-33.name: Squeeze Play
bb3-event-33.description: Wear absorbent sponge suits to soak up water and transport it to collection pools. The amount successfully transferred determines the food earned for the house.

bb3-event-34.name: Surf's Up
bb3-event-34.description: Stay balanced on the surfboard apparatus longer than the other contestants. The two successful endurance players earn a temporary trip outside the house for a cruise.

bb3-event-35.name: HoH Lifeboat
bb3-event-35.description: Final HOH, Part 1: stay in a lifeboat while continuously holding your key in the nomination box. Releasing the key or leaving eliminates you. The longest-lasting player advances directly to Part 3.

bb3-event-36.name: Household Chores
bb3-event-36.description: Final HOH, Part 2: complete household chores and season-memory tasks within seven minutes, including laundry, a sandwich and winner-order puzzles. The best task completion, with speed deciding a completed run, advances to Part 3.

bb3-event-37.name: Jury Statements
bb3-event-37.description: Final HOH, Part 3: identify which of the final three each evicted houseguest described with a given adjective. Correct answers earn points across nine questions. The higher score wins the last HOH and chooses the other finalist.

bb2-event-01.name: All Stuffed Up
bb2-event-01.description: Pack the groceries and all twelve houseguests into a Buick Rendezvous and remain inside together for sixty seconds. Completing this group stage lets the house keep the food for the week.

bb2-event-02.name: All Stuffed Up
bb2-event-02.description: After the group completes the grocery stage, remain inside the packed vehicle longer than anyone else. Leaving eliminates a player; the final occupant wins the Buick Rendezvous.

bb2-event-03.name: Wheel Of First Impressions
bb2-event-03.description: Spin a wheel for descriptive traits and nominate houseguests who fit them. The others vote on which selected person they prefer as HOH, eliminating the less-supported candidate. A final vote between the two survivors determines the first HOH.

bb2-event-04.name: Dirty Dozen
bb2-event-04.description: Search a muddy pool for keys bearing houseguests' names. The HOH starts alone; finding another person's key lets that person join the search. Recover all twelve name keys within six minutes to unlock the hot tub.

bb2-event-05.name: Birds Eye View
bb2-event-05.description: While the HOH is kept apart, the group uses their bodies to form letters spelling a desired gourmet food. The HOH must identify the word from an elevated viewpoint for the house to receive it.

bb2-event-06.name: To the Mat
bb2-event-06.description: Answer questions about the house and houseguests while blindfolded, using your position on or off a mat. Wrong answers eliminate players. The final survivor or numerical tiebreak winner becomes HOH.

bb2-event-07.name: Pound of Flesh
bb2-event-07.description: Men and women form separate teams and estimate their own body weights before being weighed. Compare each team's estimated and actual totals. The smaller error earns normal food; the other team receives peanut butter and jelly.

bb2-event-08.name: Ride the Bull
bb2-event-08.description: Men and women compete in mechanical-bull riding. Qualifying riders must last through timed rounds as the bull becomes harder to ride. The winning team earns the ingredients for a barbecue dinner.

bb2-event-09.name: By the Numbers
bb2-event-09.description: Answer numerical questions about the remaining houseguests using paddles numbered zero through nine. Incorrect answers eliminate players. The last survivor, with a tiebreaker if required, becomes HOH.

bb2-event-10.name: Catch of the Day
bb2-event-10.description: Catch yellow balls thrown into the yard, each labeled with a grocery item. Successful catches earn those foods for the week; balls that hit the ground do not count.

bb2-event-11.name: Cross Dressing
bb2-event-11.description: Teams exchange red and blue outfits across a clothesline, then dress in the clothing passed to them. The first team to finish changing wins laundry service for the week.

bb2-event-12.name: Higher/Lower
bb2-event-12.description: For each question, decide whether the correct numerical answer is above or below the suggested number. Step up for higher or down for lower. Survive the incorrect-answer eliminations to win HOH.

bb2-event-13.name: "Food Pyramid
bb2-event-13.description: Each houseguest represents a food group and answers three questions. At least two correct answers secure that category for the household's weekly menu.

bb2-event-14.name: Spinning Discs
bb2-event-14.description: Throw blank CDs toward a bowl floating in the swimming pool. The contestant landing the most discs in the bowl wins a personal stereo and the selected music CD.

bb2-event-15.name: Face the Facts
bb2-event-15.description: Identify the houseguest referred to by each question using a cube showing earlier evictees, the outgoing HOH and a blank option. Wrong answers eliminate players; the last one remaining becomes HOH.

bb2-event-16.name: The Perfect Meal
bb2-event-16.description: Drink a blended version of your favorite complete meal within five minutes and keep it down. Success earns normal food for your assigned day; failure leaves the household on peanut butter and jelly that day.

bb2-event-17.name: Rescue 911
bb2-event-17.description: Teams of men and women enter the house blindfolded to locate decorated rescue dummies and bring them outside. The first team to rescue its required dummies wins the members' selected luxury gifts.

bb2-event-18.name: Pushing It to the Limit
bb2-event-18.description: Slide your house key along a tabletop lane toward the HOH end zone. The closest valid key wins, but a slide that overshoots the far boundary is eliminated.

bb2-event-19.name: A Is For Apple
bb2-event-19.description: Climb into an oversized cereal bowl and retrieve plastic letters. Within your turn's time limit, name foods beginning with the selected letters to add them to the household's weekly menu.

bb2-event-20.name: All the News That Fits
bb2-event-20.description: Pairs decide whether supplied news headlines describe real events from outside the house. The best-scoring pair earns a brief visit to the Diary Room with current newspapers, magazines and televised news.

bb2-event-21.name: Blockbuster
bb2-event-21.description: Break through a block of ice to release the movie ticket frozen inside. The first player to retrieve and submit the ticket wins an American Pie 2 screening and may choose a guest.

bb2-event-22.name: An Offer Almost Too Good to Refuse
bb2-event-22.family: An Offer Almost Too Good to Refuse
bb2-event-22.description: Find hidden peanut-butter jars, then privately consider increasing cash offers in exchange for putting the house on peanut butter and jelly. If several players accept, their jar numbers determine the winner. Bunky accepts and receives $5,000.
families: An Offer Almost Too Good to Refuse

bb2-event-23.name: Big Brother Road Trip
bb2-event-23.description: First, answer questions about evicted houseguests' home states by driving a remote-controlled car to the correct marker. The two top scorers advance to a driving course, where they must clear state-themed obstacles in eviction order. The final winner becomes HOH.

bb2-event-24.name: Big Brother Jenga
bb2-event-24.description: Build a tower from oversized blocks bearing food categories, then carefully move blocks from the lower levels to the top. Successful placements and removals earn food; play ends when the tower collapses.

bb2-event-25.name: The Great Escape
bb2-event-25.description: Inflate helium balloons and attach them to a basket carrying your personalized doll. The first two players to lift their baskets above the house's fence line earn a helicopter tour of Los Angeles.

bb2-event-26.name: Strange Bedfellows
bb2-event-26.description: Remain on a backyard waterbed while continuously holding your key in the nomination box. Leaving, sleeping or letting go eliminates a player. The last contestant remaining wins HOH; optional prizes tempt players to drop out.

bb2-event-27.name: Shop 'til You Drop
bb2-event-27.description: Gather groceries from stocked shelves and carry them through a backyard obstacle course. The house keeps the items successfully delivered to the shopping cart before time expires.

bb2-event-28.name: Fire and Ice
bb2-event-28.description: Houseguests face visiting Survivor contestants. Each team, initially tied together, collects letter blocks to spell its show's name, then frees itself and retrieves keys from an icy pool. The first team to hang all its keys wins $15,000.

bb2-event-29.name: Crack the Code
bb2-event-29.description: Pair with a visiting Survivor contestant to decode a scrambled clue describing somewhere in the house. Find the hidden computer mouse at that location first to earn a brief look at fan websites.

bb2-event-30.name: Untitled
bb2-event-30.description: Fill one basket with food and another with mystery luxury items, then hold both baskets out to your sides for ninety seconds. Keeping them raised for an extra thirty seconds earns an additional item in each basket.

bb2-event-31.name: Final HoH Part 1
bb2-event-31.description: Final HOH, Part 1: identify which of the final three each evicted houseguest described with a given word. Correct answers score points carried into Part 2; winning this round alone does not guarantee advancement.

bb2-event-32.name: Final HoH Part 2
bb2-event-32.description: Final HOH, Part 2: complete seven household chores in order within six minutes, earning a point for each completed task. Add these points to Part 1. The two highest combined totals advance to Part 3.

bb2-event-33.name: Final HoH Part 3
bb2-event-33.description: Final HOH, Part 3: answer questions about the houseguests and season events for points, with a numerical tiebreaker if needed. The winner becomes the last HOH and chooses which remaining opponent to evict.
